attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rate record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context about this rate record, such as negotiation history, special conditions, client-specific billing instructions, or exceptions to standard rate policy.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: pro_bono_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate record applies to pro bono work (True), where the hourly_rate may be zero or nominal. Used for pro bono hour tracking and ABA 50-hour pro bono reporting.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1; Law Society of England and Wales Pro Bono Protocol

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure or billing basis against which the rate is applied. Most commonly per hour for standard timekeeping, but may be per day, per matter, per month, or fixed for AFA structures.

attributes.name: rate_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary ceiling applied to this rate arrangement. Applicable for capped fee or AFA structures where total billing under this rate cannot exceed a defined threshold.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.5; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Business classification indicating the commercial basis of the rate: standard firm rate, client-negotiated rate, preferred panel rate, pro bono (zero or reduced), or secondment arrangement.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; SRA Code of Conduct; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this rate record within the billing system (e.g., STD-PRTNR-2024, CLI-ABC-ASSOC). Used for LEDES electronic billing submissions and rate reconciliation.
attributes.references: LEDES 1998B; UTBMS; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied from the standard rate to arrive at the negotiated hourly rate for this client or matter. Used for rate realization analysis and profitability reporting (RPE, PPP, PEP KPIs).
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; Elite 3E Billing

attributes.name: rate_floor_amount
attributes.description: Minimum monetary floor for this rate arrangement. Used in contingency or success-fee structures where a minimum guaranteed fee applies regardless of outcome.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.5; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_increase_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in the hourly rate compared to the prior rate record for this timekeeper/client/matter combination. Used for rate increase tracking, client notification compliance, and year-over-year rate analytics.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules 1.5; SRA

attributes.name: rate_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this rate. Supports annual rate increase cycles and client rate negotiation planning.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate record. Rates must be approved before being applied to time entries. Superseded rates are replaced by a newer version; expired rates have passed their effective end date.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; Elite 3E; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee arrangement type governing this rate. Supports standard hourly, blended rate pools, contingency, flat fee, Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA), and capped fee structures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hourly|blended|contingency|flat_fee|afa|capped|success_fee|retainer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; UTBMS; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this rate record originated (Elite 3E, Aderant Expert, or manually entered). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: source_system_rate_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or identifier of this rate record in the originating operational system (Elite 3E or Aderant Expert). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: The timekeeper's published standard rack rate before any client-specific negotiation or discount. Retained alongside the negotiated hourly_rate to enable rate discount analysis and realization reporting.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; Elite 3E; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: timekeeper_level
attributes.description: Professional classification or seniority tier of the timekeeper at the time this rate was set. Used for rate benchmarking, PPP/PEP analytics, and UTBMS task-based billing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equity_partner|non_equity_partner|of_counsel|senior_associate|associate|paralegal|legal_assistant|staff_attorney|trainee — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UTBMS Timekeeper Classification; Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; ABA

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS task code scoping this rate to a specific task category (e.g., L110 Fact Investigation, L210 Pleadings). Enables task-based billing and rate differentiation by activity type as required by corporate clients.

attributes.name: wip_rate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is the currently active rate used for WIP (Work in Progress) valuation on time entries. Only one rate per timekeeper/client/matter combination should be flagged True at any point in time.
attributes.references: Elite 3E; Aderant Expert Rate Management; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_rate_timekeeper_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer timekeeper_rate record that replaced this one when a rate was updated or renegotiated. Enables full rate history chain traversal for audit and billing dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; Elite 3E; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or location associated with this rate (e.g., NYC, LON, HKG). Rates may vary by office due to local market conditions and overhead structures.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Granular transactional record of billable and non-billable time recorded by timekeepers against a matter. Captures UTBMS task and activity codes, narrative descriptions, hours worked, billable hours, billing rate at time of entry, WIP value, and timekeeper identity. Supports LEDES export format for electronic billing. Tracks entry status through draft, submitted, approved, billed, and written-off lifecycle stages. Primary source record for WIP accumulation and invoice generation.

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each time entry record. Primary key for the time_entry data product in the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Attorneys record billable time directly against litigation dockets for LEDES billing, client reporting, and matter profitability analysis. Essential for court-related time tracking and outside counsel

attributes.name: hearing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.hearing. Business justification: Time entries for hearing preparation, attendance, and follow-up reference specific hearings for accurate UTBMS task coding, client transparency, and billing guideline compliance in litigation matters.

attributes.name: legal_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.legal_document. Business justification: Time entries reference specific documents worked on (drafting motions, reviewing contracts, redlining agreements). Required for task-based billing, UTBMS coding validation, and detailed client reporti

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter against which this time entry is recorded. Every billable or non-billable time entry must be associated with an active matter.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: primary_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or other professional) who performed and recorded the work. Used for rate lookup, WIP accumulation, and productivity reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: primary_timekeeper_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.timekeeper_rate. Business justification: Time entries are billed using specific rate card entries. Currently time_entry has billing_rate (amount) and timekeeper_level (string) but no FK to the authoritative rate record. Adding timekeeper_rat

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client associated with the matter for which time is being recorded. Denormalized from the matter for direct billing and reporting queries.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry was approved by the responsible billing attorney or billing supervisor. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status and authorizes inclusion in prebilling and invoicing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert Prebilling; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: billable_hours
attributes.description: Hours approved for billing to the client after any reductions, write-downs, or non-billable designations applied during the prebilling review process. May differ from hours_worked due to courtesy reductions, write-downs, or billing guidelines. Used as the basis for WIP value calculation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling; Elite 3E; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: billed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry was included in a finalized invoice and transitioned to billed status. Used for WIP clearance, revenue recognition timing, and billing cycle reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing Module; Aderant Expert; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_guideline_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been reviewed and confirmed as compliant with the client's outside counsel billing guidelines (True) or flagged as non-compliant (False). Non-compliant entries may be subject to write-down or rejection by the client.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC) Billing Guidelines; Elite 3E

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry record was first created in the source system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the billing rate and WIP amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters and cross-border transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES 1998B; Elite 3E Multi-Currency

attributes.name: entry_method
attributes.description: Method by which the time entry was captured in the system. Manual entries are typed directly; timer entries are captured via running timer tools; mobile entries are submitted via mobile app; bulk_import entries are loaded from external sources; api entries are submitted programmatically.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Practice Management

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for the time entry as generated by the practice management system (e.g., Elite 3E or Aderant Expert). Used in prebilling, invoice line references, and LEDES export.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the time entry as it progresses through the WIP management and billing workflow. Draft entries are in progress; submitted entries await approval; approved entries are ready for invoicing; billed entries have been included on an invoice; written_off entries have been removed from WIP; rejected entries require correction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|billed|written_off|rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert Prebilling; UTBMS Standard

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee arrangement governing this time entry. Determines how the entry contributes to billing and revenue recognition. AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) entries may include capped fees, fixed fees, or success fees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hourly|flat_fee|contingency|blended_rate|afa|pro_bono|retainer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E AFA Module; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Actual hours spent performing the work as recorded by the timekeeper, prior to any billing adjustments. Typically recorded in tenths of an hour (0.1 increments) per standard legal billing practice. Serves as the raw input before billable hours are determined.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert; Elite 3E

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is designated as billable to the client (True) or non-billable (False). Non-billable entries may include pro bono work, administrative time, or courtesy write-offs. Drives WIP accumulation and invoice inclusion logic.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: is_contingency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is recorded under a contingency fee arrangement (True), where billing is conditional on case outcome. Contingency entries accumulate WIP but are not invoiced until the contingency event occurs. Supports AFA tracking.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5(c); Elite 3E AFA Module

attributes.name: ledes_line_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Line Item Number
attributes.description: The line item number assigned to this time entry in the LEDES electronic billing file submitted to the client or client billing system. Required for LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML format compliance and for reconciliation of electronic billing submissions.
attributes.references: LEDES 1998B Standard; LEDES Oversight Committee; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: lpp_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the narrative or details of this time entry are subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) or attorney-client privilege protections (True). LPP-protected entries require restricted access controls and must be handled in compliance with privilege preservation obligations during eDiscovery and regulatory inquiries.
attributes.references: Legal Professional Privilege (LPP); ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6; GDPR Article 9; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry record was last modified in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description of the legal work performed, as entered by the timekeeper. Appears on client invoices and prebilling reports. Subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) protections. Must be sufficiently detailed to satisfy ABA Model Rule 1.5 billing transparency requirements and client billing guidelines.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Legal Professional Privilege (LPP); Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: no_charge
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been designated as no-charge (True), meaning the work was performed but will not be billed to the client. Distinct from non-billable entries; no-charge entries may appear on invoices at zero value for transparency.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the phase or stage of the matter to which this time entry belongs (e.g., pleadings, discovery, trial, closing). Used in Legal Project Management (LPM) for budget tracking against matter phases and milestone-based billing.
attributes.references: UTBMS Phase Codes; Elite 3E Matter Management; Legal Project Management (LPM) Standards

attributes.name: practice_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the practice group or department (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, IP, Employment) to which the timekeeper belongs at the time of entry. Supports practice group profitability reporting and resource allocation analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: pro_bono_category
attributes.description: Classification of the pro bono service type when the time entry is designated as pro bono (e.g., access to justice, nonprofit representation, government service). Null for non-pro-bono entries. Supports ABA pro bono reporting requirements and firm CSR metrics.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1 (Pro Bono Publico Service); Law Society of England and Wales Pro Bono Protocol; Elite 3E

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system from which this time entry record was sourced into the data lakehouse. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across the billing technology stack.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timekeeper formally submitted the time entry for approval. Marks the transition from draft to submitted status. Used for timekeeping compliance monitoring and late submission reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: task_description
attributes.description: Structured description of the specific legal task performed, distinct from the free-text narrative. May be derived from or supplement the UTBMS task code with matter-specific context. Used in task-based matter management and Legal Project Management (LPM) reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; Elite 3E Matter Management; Legal Project Management (LPM) Standards; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardized activity code describing the specific activity performed within the task (e.g., A101 for Plan and Prepare, A102 for Research, A103 for Draft/Revise). Used in conjunction with utbms_task_code for granular task-based billing analysis and LEDES export.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; LEDES 1998B Standard; ABA; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: utbms_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Expense Code
attributes.description: UTBMS expense code applicable when the time entry is associated with a disbursement or expense component (e.g., E101 for Copying, E106 for Computer Research). Nullable for pure time entries with no expense component.

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardized task code classifying the type of legal work performed (e.g., L110 for Fact Investigation, L120 for Analysis/Strategy, B110 for Retention/Billing). Required for LEDES electronic billing submissions and task-based matter management reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; LEDES 1998B Standard; ABA; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: wip_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of unbilled work represented by this time entry, calculated as billable_hours multiplied by billing_rate. Represents the WIP balance contribution of this entry. Reduced to zero when the entry is billed or written off.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert; ABA Model Rules 1.5; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the legal work was actually performed. This is the principal business event date for the time entry, distinct from the date the entry was created or submitted in the system. Critical for WIP aging, billing period cutoffs, and matter chronology.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert; LEDES 1998B; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: write_down_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount by which the original WIP value of this entry was reduced during prebilling review or billing adjustment. Represents the difference between the originally recorded WIP value and the amount actually billed. Used for realization rate analysis and partner performance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E WIP Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Financial Management

attributes.name: write_down_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for any write-down applied to this time entry (e.g., client discount, billing guideline non-compliance, courtesy reduction, duplicate entry). Required for realization analysis and billing adjustment reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E WIP Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Financial Management

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period or billing cycle to which this time entry is allocated. Defines the cutoff for WIP inclusion in a billing run and supports period-close reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing Module; Aderant Expert; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period or billing cycle to which this time entry is allocated. Used for period-based WIP reporting, billing cutoff management, and monthly/quarterly revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing Module; Aderant Expert; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or practice location associated with this time entry. Used for office-level revenue reporting, profitability analysis, and jurisdictional billing compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; Law Society of England and Wales; State Bar Associations

products.name: wip_ledger
products.description: Accumulated Work in Progress ledger representing unbilled time and disbursements for each matter. Tracks WIP balance by timekeeper, matter, billing period, and fee arrangement type. Provides the authoritative WIP snapshot used in prebilling and financial reporting. Captures WIP aging buckets, write-up/write-down adjustments, and transfer history. Critical for PPP (Profit Per Partner), PEP (Profit Per Equity Partner), and RPE (Revenue Per Employee) financial KPI calculations.

attributes.name: wip_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each WIP ledger entry. Primary key for the wip_ledger data product in the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: WIP accumulates against litigation matters with dockets. Essential for matter-level WIP aging, prebilling review, litigation profitability tracking, and partner oversight of court-related unbilled wor

attributes.name: originating_partner_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner who originated (brought in) the client relationship for this matter. Used for origination credit allocation in partner compensation models and business development reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the practice group (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, IP, Employment) to which this WIP entry is attributed. Enables practice group-level WIP analysis, revenue forecasting, and PPP/PEP segmentation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: primary_time_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.time_entry.time_entry_id — WIP ledger entries accumulate from time entries. This FK enables WIP drill-down to source transactions and supports WIP aging analysis.

attributes.name: primary_wip_matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the matter against which this WIP entry is recorded. Matters are the primary billing unit in legal practice management.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: primary_wip_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or other fee earner) who generated this WIP entry. Drives timekeeper-level WIP analysis and RPE calculations.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client associated with the matter for which WIP is being tracked. Used in client-level WIP reporting and PPP/PEP calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical aging classification of the WIP entry based on wip_age_days. Used in WIP aging reports for financial management, partner reviews, and collections strategy. Buckets align with standard legal industry WIP aging reporting conventions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the WIP entry was approved for billing or the write-off/write-down was authorised. Used in billing workflow tracking and SOX compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 302 and 404

attributes.name: billing_office_code
attributes.description: Reference to the firm office responsible for billing this WIP entry. Used for office-level revenue attribution, PPP/PEP calculations by office, and financial reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: billing_rate
attributes.description: The standard billing rate per hour applied to this WIP entry, expressed in the matter currency. Reflects the timekeeper's rate for the applicable billing period and client rate agreement. Confidential as it reflects negotiated client pricing.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WIP ledger record was first created in the source practice management system. Provides the authoritative record creation audit timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this WIP entry (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters and cross-border client engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the WIP entry was recorded in the practice management system. May differ from work_date due to late time entry. Used for compliance monitoring of timekeeping policies and WIP aging from entry perspective.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the WIP entry amount from the matter currency to the firm's functional reporting currency at the time of entry. Used for consolidated financial reporting and multi-currency WIP analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ISO 4217; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Number of billable hours recorded for this WIP entry. Applicable when wip_type is 'time'. Expressed in decimal hours (e.g., 1.50 = 1 hour 30 minutes). Null for disbursement and fixed-fee entries.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WIP entry is designated as billable to the client (True) or non-billable/internal (False). Non-billable WIP is tracked for cost management and matter profitability analysis but excluded from client invoices.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: is_contingency_accrual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WIP entry represents an accrued contingency fee amount (True) that is not yet realised pending case outcome. Contingency WIP is tracked separately for financial reporting and is only recognised as revenue upon successful resolution.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WIP ledger record was most recently updated in the source practice management system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Matter phase code identifying the stage of the legal engagement to which this WIP entry belongs (e.g., pleadings, discovery, trial). Used in matter budgeting, phase-based billing, and LPM (Legal Project Management) reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; UTBMS; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this WIP ledger entry was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability in the Silver layer of the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: standard_amount
attributes.description: The WIP value calculated at the timekeeper's standard rack rate (hours_worked multiplied by standard_rate). Used to measure the variance between standard and billed value, supporting write-up/write-down analysis and profitability reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: The timekeeper's published standard rack rate per hour before any client-specific discounts or negotiated rate agreements are applied. Used to calculate write-up/write-down variance against billing_rate for financial KPI reporting including RPE.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardised activity code describing the specific activity performed within a task (e.g., A101 for Plan and Prepare, A102 for Research). Complements the task code for granular task-based billing and client invoice compliance.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: utbms_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Expense Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardised expense code for disbursement and expense WIP entries (e.g., E101 for Copying, E106 for Online Research). Populated only when wip_type is 'disbursement' or 'expense'.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardised task code classifying the legal work performed (e.g., L110 for Fact Investigation, L120 for Analysis/Strategy). Enables task-based billing analysis, client reporting, and benchmarking against industry spend data.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: wip_accumulates_disbursement
attributes.description: FK to billing.disbursement.disbursement_id — WIP ledger entries also accumulate from disbursements. This FK enables complete WIP composition analysis.

attributes.name: wip_age_days
