attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The official date the invoice was issued to the client. This is the principal business event date used for revenue recognition, aging calculations, and LEDES e-billing submission headers.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable invoice reference number assigned by the billing system (e.g., Elite 3E or Aderant Expert). Used on all client-facing documents, LEDES e-billing submissions, and payment remittances.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard; UTBMS

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the invoice. Drives AR aging, collections workflow, and revenue recognition. Valid states: draft (prebill stage), issued (sent to client), disputed (client raised objection), paid (fully settled), partially_paid (partial remittance received), written_off (uncollectable balance removed), credited (credit note applied). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|disputed|paid|partially_paid|written_off|credited — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document. Standard is a regular bill; credit_note is a negative invoice reversing or adjusting a prior bill; proforma is a preliminary estimate; interim is a progress bill on a long-running matter; final closes out all WIP on a matter.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: is_electronic_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is subject to electronic billing via a LEDES-compliant e-billing portal. True = invoice must be submitted electronically; False = paper or email delivery.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Board; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: ledes_format_version
attributes.description: Version of the LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard) format used for electronic billing submission to corporate clients or insurance carriers. Null if invoice is not submitted via e-billing portal.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Board; LEDES 1998B Standard; UTBMS

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total amount due from the client after applying fees, disbursements, discounts, and taxes. This is the amount the client is expected to remit: (fees_amount + disbursements_amount - discount_amount + tax_amount).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this invoice (net_amount minus amount_paid). Drives AR aging buckets and collections prioritisation. Updated upon each payment application.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms applicable to this invoice as defined in the letter of engagement (LOE) or client billing agreement (e.g., net_30 = payment due within 30 days of invoice date).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: Number of times this invoice has been resubmitted to the e-billing portal following a rejection. Tracks resubmission history for operational efficiency and client relationship management.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Board; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this invoice (e.g., VAT, GST, or applicable sales tax). Calculated based on the taxable fee and disbursement amounts and the applicable tax rate for the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR; SOX; jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO country or state/province code identifying the tax jurisdiction governing the tax calculation on this invoice. Determines applicable VAT, GST, or sales tax rules.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2/Alpha-3; GDPR; jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Applicable tax rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.2000 for 20% VAT) used to calculate the tax_amount on this invoice. Varies by jurisdiction and service type.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR; jurisdiction-specific VAT/GST regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the invoice record in the billing system. Tracks status changes, payment applications, dispute updates, and write-off entries.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount written off on this invoice as uncollectable or as a billing adjustment. Impacts WIP write-off reporting and partner profitability metrics (PPP, PEP).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Narrative or coded reason for the write-off (e.g., client insolvency, fee dispute settlement, courtesy adjustment, billing error). Required for financial audit trail and partner approval workflows.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: billing_fee_arrangement_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.fee_arrangement.fee_arrangement_id — Invoices are generated under the terms of a fee arrangement. This FK enables fee cap compliance checking and AFA billing validation.

attributes.name: invoice_prebill_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.prebill.prebill_id — Invoices are generated from approved prebills. This link closes the prebill-to-invoice lifecycle and enables tracking of which prebills have been finalized.

attributes.name: billing_office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office responsible for billing this invoice. Used for office-level revenue reporting, GL allocation, and multi-office financial consolidation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this invoice. Together with billing_period_start, defines the WIP window captured on this bill.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this invoice. Defines the range of time entries, disbursements, and WIP included in the bill.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

products.name: invoice_line
products.description: Individual line item on a legal invoice representing a single time entry, disbursement, or flat fee component. Captures UTBMS task code, activity code, timekeeper, narrative, quantity, rate, amount, tax code, and line-level write-up/write-down adjustments. Provides the granular detail required for LEDES electronic billing submissions and client billing guideline compliance. Each line traces back to an originating time entry or disbursement record.

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each invoice line item within the billing domain. Primary key for the invoice_line data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Invoice line items reference dockets for detailed billing transparency, LEDES format compliance, and client billing guideline validation in litigation matters.

attributes.name: from_time_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.time_entry.time_entry_id — Invoice lines that represent billed time must trace back to their originating time entry for audit trail, LEDES compliance, and dispute resolution. This is the core traceability link in legal billing.

attributes.name: hearing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.hearing. Business justification: Line items for hearing-related work (preparation, appearance, follow-up) reference specific hearings for client transparency, UTBMS compliance, and billing guideline validation.

attributes.name: ip_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ip.asset. Business justification: Invoice line items in IP matters routinely specify which patent, trademark, or copyright the work/expense relates to for client billing guideline compliance, LEDES submission requirements, and portfol

attributes.name: legal_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.legal_document. Business justification: Invoice line items reference supporting documents (engagement letters for rate justification, court orders for fee awards). Required for LEDES billing compliance, billing guideline validation, and dis

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter or case to which this billing line item is attributed. Enables matter-level revenue reporting, WIP reconciliation, and client billing guideline compliance checks.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: primary_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header/detail relationship for invoice line aggregation and LEDES electronic billing submissions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or other fee earner) who performed the work represented by this line item. Used for timekeeper-level billing analysis, rate compliance, and RPE/PPP/PEP KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; UTBMS

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the billing partner, billing coordinator, or supervisor who approved this line item for inclusion on the invoice during the prebilling review process. Supports billing approval workflow audit trails.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this line item was approved during the prebilling review workflow. Used for billing cycle time analysis and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: The gross amount billed to the client for this line item after applying the billing rate to the quantity, and before any write-up or write-down adjustments. Expressed in the invoice currency. Core monetary fact for revenue recognition and AR reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: billing_guideline_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item has been validated as compliant with the client's outside counsel billing guidelines (OCGs). False indicates a potential guideline violation (e.g., block billing, excessive hours, non-compliant timekeeper rate) that may result in client rejection or reduction.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: billing_guideline_exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this line item was flagged as non-compliant with client billing guidelines. Populated when billing_guideline_compliant is False. Used by billing coordinators to resolve exceptions before invoice submission.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: billing_rate
attributes.description: The hourly billing rate applied to this line item in the invoice currency, as agreed in the engagement letter or client rate schedule. Confidential as it reflects negotiated client-specific pricing. Null for disbursement and flat fee lines.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: client_rejected
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was rejected by the client or their legal spend management system after invoice submission. Rejected lines require resolution (write-off, resubmission, or dispute) and are excluded from collected revenue until resolved.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: client_rejection_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the client or their e-billing platform for rejecting this line item. Populated when client_rejected is True. Used to identify systemic billing guideline compliance issues and improve future billing quality.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center or profit center code associated with the practice group or office responsible for this line item. Used for internal profitability reporting, partner compensation calculations, and PPP/PEP financial KPI attribution.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this invoice line record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and billing cycle time analysis in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5; ISO 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which this line item is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters and foreign currency realization reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert this line item from the billing currency to the firm's functional currency at the time of invoicing. Relevant for international matters billed in a currency other than the firm's base currency. Null for lines in the functional currency.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of fee arrangement under which this line item is billed. Reflects the engagement-level fee structure: hourly (standard time-based), contingency (success-based), flat_fee (fixed price), Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA), blended_rate (single rate across timekeepers), or capped_fee (hourly with a ceiling). Drives billing logic and revenue recognition treatment.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: from_disbursement
attributes.description: FK to billing.disbursement.disbursement_id — Invoice lines representing expenses must trace back to the originating disbursement record. Required for LEDES compliance and client billing guideline validation.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the revenue or expense for this line item is posted in the firm's financial system. Enables reconciliation between the billing sub-ledger and the GL for financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: The number of hours recorded for this time-based line item, expressed in decimal format (e.g., 1.50 for one hour thirty minutes). Null for disbursement and flat fee lines. The billable unit of measure for time charges before rate application.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: ledes_export_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Export Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this line item was last exported in a LEDES electronic billing file for submission to the client or their e-billing platform. Null if the line has not yet been exported. Used to track LEDES submission status and prevent duplicate submissions.
attributes.references: LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: ledes_line_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Line Item Number
attributes.description: The line item number as formatted and exported in the LEDES electronic billing file submitted to the client or their legal spend management platform. Ensures traceability between the internal billing record and the external LEDES submission.
attributes.references: LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; Legal Services Board

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this line item within the parent invoice. Used to maintain the presentation order of line items on the invoice as rendered to the client and in LEDES output files.
attributes.references: LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the invoice line item within the billing lifecycle. Draft lines are in prebilling review; approved lines are ready for invoice generation; billed lines have been sent to the client; written_off lines have been removed from AR; on_hold lines are pending client or internal review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice line item indicating whether it represents a time charge, a disbursement/expense, a flat fee component, an Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) component, a tax charge, or a credit adjustment. Drives downstream billing logic and LEDES field mapping.
attributes.references: LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; UTBMS; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: lpp_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the narrative or details of this line item are subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) and must be redacted or withheld in any disclosure to third parties. Critical for eDiscovery, regulatory investigations, and client data sharing compliance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Law Society of England and Wales; Legal Services Board; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this invoice line record was last modified in the billing system. Tracks prebilling edits, write-up/write-down adjustments, and status changes for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5; ISO 27001

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: The descriptive text narrative for this line item as it appears on the client invoice. Describes the legal work performed or disbursement incurred. Subject to billing guideline requirements for narrative specificity. May be edited from the original time entry description during prebilling review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount for this line item after applying write-up/write-down adjustments to the billed amount. This is the amount that contributes to the invoice total and is recognized as revenue. Equals billed_amount plus write_up_down_amount.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: original_narrative
attributes.description: The unedited narrative text from the originating time entry or disbursement record before any prebilling edits were applied. Retained for audit trail purposes and to support billing guideline compliance reviews comparing original versus billed descriptions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: The matter phase or stage code to which this line item is attributed (e.g., Phase 1 - Due Diligence, Phase 2 - Negotiation). Used in phased billing arrangements and Legal Project Management (LPM) budget tracking to allocate costs to defined matter phases.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity or unit count for this line item. For time lines this mirrors hours_worked; for disbursement lines it represents the number of units (e.g., pages copied, miles travelled). Used in conjunction with billing_rate to derive the billed amount.
attributes.references: LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; UTBMS; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: sources_disbursement
attributes.description: FK to billing.disbursement.disbursement_id — Invoice lines that represent billed disbursements must trace back to the originating disbursement record for cost recovery tracking and LEDES compliance.

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: The timekeeper's standard rack rate at the time of billing, before any client-specific discounts or negotiated rate reductions. Used to calculate write-up/write-down variance and to support rate realization analysis for PPP and RPE KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount applicable to this line item (e.g., VAT, GST, or sales tax) calculated based on the applicable tax code and jurisdiction. Null if the line item is tax-exempt. Required for tax reporting and compliance with jurisdiction-specific tax regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR; PCI DSS; jurisdiction-specific tax authority requirements; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this line item identifying the applicable tax rate and jurisdiction rule (e.g., VAT20, EXEMPT, ZERO). Drives automated tax calculation in Elite 3E and supports VAT/GST return preparation and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR; jurisdiction-specific tax authority requirements

attributes.name: timekeeper_level
attributes.description: The seniority classification of the timekeeper who performed the work on this line item (e.g., partner, senior associate, associate, paralegal). Denormalized from the timekeeper record for billing analytics and client billing guideline compliance without requiring a join. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: partner|senior_associate|associate|paralegal|trainee|of_counsel|staff_attorney|law_clerk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: UTBMS activity code describing the specific activity performed within the task (e.g., A101 for Plan and Prepare, A102 for Research). Used alongside the task code in LEDES billing files to provide granular task-based cost management data to clients.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: utbms_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Expense Code
attributes.description: UTBMS expense code classifying the type of disbursement on this line item (e.g., E101 for Copying, E106 for Computer Research). Populated only for disbursement line types. Required for LEDES electronic billing of expense items.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS task code classifying the legal work performed on this line item (e.g., L110 for Fact Investigation, L210 for Pleadings). Mandatory for LEDES electronic billing submissions and client billing guideline compliance. Sourced from the UTBMS code set maintained by the ABA and ACCA.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: wip_amount
attributes.description: The original Work in Progress (WIP) value of this line item at the standard billing rate before any prebilling adjustments, write-ups, or write-downs. Used to calculate the realization rate (net_amount / wip_amount) and to reconcile WIP balances in the general ledger.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the legal work or disbursement represented by this line item was performed. Distinct from the invoice date. Used for WIP aging analysis, billing guideline compliance (e.g., time entry submission within N days of work), and matter timeline reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for any write-off or write-down applied to this line item (e.g., CLIENT_DISPUTE, BILLING_ERROR, COURTESY_REDUCTION, BUDGET_CAP). Populated when write_up_down_amount is negative. Supports write-off analysis and partner compensation adjustments.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: write_up_down_amount
attributes.description: The monetary adjustment applied to this line item at the prebilling or billing stage. A positive value represents a write-up (increase above standard); a negative value represents a write-down (reduction below standard). Critical for realization rate analysis and partner compensation calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: invoice_time_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating time entry record from which this invoice line was generated. Provides full traceability from the billed line back to the WIP time entry in Elite 3E. Null for disbursement or flat fee lines.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: billing_disbursement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating disbursement or expense record from which this invoice line was generated. Null for time-based or flat fee lines. Enables disbursement traceability and client cost recovery reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoice lines, capturing how received funds are distributed across outstanding invoices and line items. Tracks allocated amount, allocation date, allocation type (full, partial, retainer drawdown, trust transfer), and any unapplied balance. Ensures accurate AR aging and supports complex multi-matter payment scenarios common in large corporate client relationships.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment allocation record. Primary key for the payment_allocation data product in the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IOLTA or client trust account from which funds were drawn for this allocation, when allocation_type is 'trust_transfer'. Required for trust accounting compliance and state bar regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts); State Bar Associations; American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equity or responsible partner accountable for the matter associated with this allocation. Drives PPP (Profit Per Partner) and PEP (Profit Per Equity Partner) financial KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; PPP (Profit Per Partner); PEP (Profit Per Equity Partner)

attributes.name: billing_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the responsible billing timekeeper (attorney or legal professional) associated with the matter for which this allocation is being applied. Used for revenue attribution and RPE (Revenue Per Equity Partner) reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; RPE (Revenue Per Equity Partner)

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Payment allocations are applied to invoices for specific dockets. Required for matter-level AR accuracy, client account reconciliation, and litigation profitability tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice against which this allocation is applied. Supports multi-invoice payment scenarios common in large corporate client matters.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific invoice line item against which this allocation is applied. Enables granular line-level allocation tracking for task-based billing under UTBMS standards.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter associated with this payment allocation. Supports multi-matter payment scenarios where a single client payment is distributed across multiple active matters.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the practice group (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, IP, Employment) associated with the matter for which this allocation is applied. Enables practice group-level AR aging and collections analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity making the payment. Enables client-level AR aging analysis and supports consolidated billing for clients with multiple matters.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: retainer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retainer account from which funds were drawn when allocation_type is 'retainer_drawdown'. Tracks the drawdown of pre-paid retainer balances against earned fees.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment being applied to the referenced invoice or invoice line. Core financial field for AR aging, cash application, and revenue recognition. Must be positive and not exceed the payment's unapplied balance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: allocated_amount_base
attributes.description: The allocated amount expressed in the firm's functional (base) currency after applying the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, PPP, PEP, and RPE KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the payment allocation was applied to the invoice. Determines the AR aging bucket reduction and is the principal event date for cash application reporting and period-end close.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this payment allocation record, used in client communications, remittance advice reconciliation, and audit trails. Typically follows firm-defined numbering conventions in Elite 3E or Aderant Expert.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment allocation record. 'posted' indicates funds have been applied to the invoice; 'reversed' indicates a corrective reversal has been processed; 'pending' indicates awaiting approval or trust transfer confirmation; 'voided' indicates the allocation was cancelled; 'unapplied' indicates funds received but not yet matched to an invoice.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the payment is being applied. 'full' covers the entire outstanding balance; 'partial' covers a portion; 'retainer_drawdown' applies funds held in a retainer account; 'trust_transfer' applies funds from an IOLTA trust account; 'write_off_offset' offsets a previously written-off amount; 'credit_memo' applies a credit note against the invoice balance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts); Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this payment allocation, particularly relevant for trust transfers and write-off offsets that require partner or billing manager sign-off per firm policy.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; American Bar Association (ABA); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the billing manager, partner, or authorized approver who approved this payment allocation. Required for audit trail and compliance with firm billing governance policies.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the payment allocation was approved by the authorized approver. Part of the allocation lifecycle audit trail.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this payment allocation record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for financial records.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency billing in international legal matters, particularly relevant for ICC and LCIA arbitration matters.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; International Chamber of Commerce (ICC); LCIA (London Court of International Arbitration)

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Any prompt-payment or negotiated discount applied at the time of payment allocation, reducing the effective amount required to satisfy the invoice balance. Tracked separately from write-offs for financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the allocated amount from the payment currency to the firm's functional currency at the time of allocation. Relevant for cross-border matters billed in non-functional currencies.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The billing fee arrangement type governing the invoice to which this allocation is applied. Supports analysis of cash collection performance across different fee structures including AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement), contingency, and hourly billing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement); American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: gl_post_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from allocation_date due to period-end cutoff rules or delayed GL posting. Critical for financial period reconciliation and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: invoice_balance_after
attributes.description: The remaining outstanding invoice balance immediately after this allocation is applied. Enables real-time AR aging bucket calculation and identifies fully satisfied versus partially paid invoices.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: invoice_balance_before
attributes.description: The outstanding invoice balance immediately prior to this allocation being applied. Provides a point-in-time snapshot for audit trail purposes and supports AR aging reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: is_auto_allocated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation was applied automatically by the billing system (True) or manually by a billing administrator (False). Supports audit trail requirements and cash application workflow quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: is_trust_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation has been reviewed and confirmed as compliant with applicable trust accounting rules (True) or flagged for review (False). Required for IOLTA compliance and state bar regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts); State Bar Associations; American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: ledes_billing_period
attributes.description: The billing period (YYYY-MM) associated with the invoice to which this allocation is applied, formatted per LEDES standards. Supports electronic billing reconciliation with corporate clients and insurance carriers.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this payment allocation record was last updated. Supports change data capture, audit trail requirements, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by billing staff regarding this payment allocation, such as client instructions, special payment conditions, or dispute context. Supports collections workflow and client communication documentation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: remittance_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or description provided by the client on their remittance advice, used to match the payment to the correct invoice(s). Critical for automated cash application and reconciliation in LEDES-compliant billing workflows.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for reversing this payment allocation (e.g., returned check, incorrect invoice, client dispute). Populated only when allocation_status is 'reversed'. Supports collections and dispute resolution workflows.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: reversed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this payment allocation was reversed. Populated only when allocation_status is 'reversed'. Used for AR aging correction and period-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this payment allocation record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Elite 3E and Aderant Expert in hybrid or transitioning environments.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this payment allocation record in the originating source system (e.g., Elite 3E transaction ID or Aderant Expert allocation key). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: unapplied_balance
attributes.description: The portion of the payment that remains unallocated after this allocation record is processed. A non-zero value indicates funds on account that require further application to outstanding invoices or return to the client.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which the funds were considered cleared and available, as confirmed by the bank or payment processor. Used for trust accounting reconciliation and IOLTA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts); FATF (Financial Action Task Force); Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: wip_cleared_amount
attributes.description: The amount of WIP (Work in Progress) cleared from the matter's WIP ledger as a result of this payment allocation. Relevant for revenue recognition and matter profitability reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; WIP (Work in Progress)

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The amount written off in conjunction with this payment allocation, representing the difference between the invoice balance and the payment received when a partial settlement is accepted. Impacts PPP and PEP calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: billing_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payment record from which funds are being allocated. Links this allocation to the originating payment transaction.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Reference to the firm office or practice group location associated with the matter for which this allocation is applied. Supports office-level revenue and collections performance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

products.name: ar_balance

attributes.name: billing_timekeeper_id

attributes.name: docket_id

Real business process: claim impact on receivables requires linking AR balances to claims for financial reporti

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: AR balances are monitored by practice area for collections prioritization, write-off authority, and cash flow forecasting. Practice area leaders manage collections strategy and approve write-offs with

attributes.name: primary_ar_matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific legal matter against which the outstanding balance is recorded. Enables matter-level AR aging and WIP reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Matter Management Module

attributes.name: primary_ar_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equity or non-equity partner responsible for the client relationship and accountable for collections on this AR balance. Used in PPP and PEP reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Timekeeper Management; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: write_off_id

attributes.name: ar_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this AR balance record. Used in client statements, collection correspondence, and LEDES electronic billing submissions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed billing cycle frequency for this matter as specified in the Letter of Engagement (LOE). Determines invoice generation cadence and expected AR turnover.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Billing Module; Aderant Expert — Rate Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: bucket_0_30_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the outstanding balance aged 0 to 30 days from the invoice date. Used in the standard AR aging report for partner financial reviews and PPP/PEP calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: bucket_31_60_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the outstanding balance aged 31 to 60 days from the invoice date. Elevated aging bucket that may trigger initial collection outreach per firm collections policy.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: bucket_61_90_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the outstanding balance aged 61 to 90 days from the invoice date. Triggers escalated collection action and partner notification under standard firm collections protocols.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: bucket_over_90_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: AR Aging Bucket Over 90 Days Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the outstanding balance aged more than 90 days from the invoice date. Highest-risk aging bucket; typically triggers write-off evaluation, external collections referral, or matter suspension.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: client_matter_number
attributes.description: Combined client-matter reference code (e.g., 12345.001) as used in Elite 3E and on client invoices. Standard identifier for cross-referencing billing records with matter management systems.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Client/Matter Management Module

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current collections lifecycle state of the AR balance record. Drives workflow routing in Aderant Expert collections management and partner escalation processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current|overdue|in_dispute|sent_to_collections|written_off|settled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: Aderant Expert — Collections Module; Elite 3E AR Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: collections_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the collections team or responsible partner regarding collection activity, client commitments, payment plans, or dispute context for this AR balance.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert — Collections Module; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AR balance record was first created in the system, typically upon invoice posting. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOX and data governance compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: credit_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment is contractually due, as specified in the Letter of Engagement (LOE) or client billing agreement (e.g., 30, 45, 60). Drives due date calculation and overdue determination.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; Law Society of England and Wales — Billing Guidance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the invoice and AR balance are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — GL Module; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The net outstanding amount currently owed by the client on this AR record after applying all payments, credits, and write-offs to date. The authoritative balance figure for collections management and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: days_outstanding
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed since the invoice date. Used as the primary aging metric for AR bucket assignment and collections prioritisation. Recalculated daily during Silver layer processing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has formally disputed this invoice or AR balance. When true, collections activity is paused pending resolution and the record is flagged for billing partner review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Categorised reason for the client's invoice dispute. Populated when dispute_flag is true. Supports root-cause analysis of billing disputes and UTBMS task code compliance reviews. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_dispute|task_code_error|rate_discrepancy|duplicate_invoice|scope_dispute|other — promote to reference product if additional reasons are required]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual payment due date for the invoice as defined by the credit terms in the Letter of Engagement (LOE). Determines overdue status and triggers collection workflows.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Law Society of England and Wales — Billing Guidance

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the billing currency to the firm's functional reporting currency at the time of invoice generation. Required for multi-currency AR consolidation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — GL Module; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The billing fee structure governing this matter's invoicing. Determines how WIP is converted to billed amounts and how AR is recognised. Supports AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement), contingency, hourly, flat fee, blended rate, and retainer models.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Billing Module; Aderant Expert — Rate Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: interest_accrued
attributes.description: Contractual interest amount accrued on the overdue AR balance where the Letter of Engagement (LOE) provides for late payment interest. Tracked separately from the principal balance for financial reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Law Society of England and Wales — Billing Guidance; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: iolta_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts (IOLTA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AR balance is associated with funds held in an IOLTA trust account. When true, payment processing must comply with IOLTA rules and state bar trust accounting regulations.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15; State Bar Associations — Trust Accounting Rules; IOLTA Program Guidelines

attributes.name: last_collection_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent collections outreach activity (call, email, or letter) made to the client regarding this outstanding balance. Supports collections workflow management and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert — Collections Module; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the most recent payment applied to this AR balance. Supports cash flow analysis and collections follow-up.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received and applied against this AR balance. Used in collections management to assess client payment behaviour and prioritise outreach.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent client account statement was generated and dispatched for this AR balance. Used to track statement cycle compliance and client communication history.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; Aderant Expert — Collections

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AR balance record, including payment applications, write-offs, credit adjustments, or status changes. Required for incremental Silver layer processing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: matter_type_code
attributes.description: Classification code for the type of legal matter (e.g., M&A, Litigation, IP Prosecution, Employment Advisory) associated with this AR balance. Enables matter-type segmentation in AR analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Matter Management Module; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System

attributes.name: original_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The gross billed amount on the original invoice before any payments, credits, or write-offs are applied. Denominated in the billing currency. Forms the basis for AR aging and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Billing Module; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: total_credits_applied
attributes.description: Cumulative value of credit notes, billing adjustments, and courtesy discounts applied against this AR balance. Distinct from write-offs; represents negotiated or corrective reductions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: total_payments_applied
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of all client payments applied against this AR balance record to date. Reconciles original invoice amount to current outstanding balance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — AR Module; GAAP ASC 310; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating invoice that generated this AR balance record. Supports invoice-level aging and dispute tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System — Billing Module; LEDES Electronic Billing Standard

products.name: write_off
products.description: Transactional record of WIP or AR amounts formally written off or written down following partner approval. Captures write-off type (WIP write-off, bad debt write-off, courtesy discount, billing guideline reduction), original amount, write-off amount, write-off reason code, approving partner, approval date, and GL impact. Critical for realization rate calculations, profitability analysis, and financial period close.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each write-off or write-down transaction record in the billing system. Primary key for the write_off data product.

attributes.name: billing_timekeeper_id

attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: docket_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.indemnity_claim. Business justification: Write-offs may be linked to PI claims (settlement amounts, defence costs, fee reductions). Real business process: claim financial impact tracking requires linking write-offs to claims for reserve mana

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter against which the write-off is recorded. Enables matter-level profitability analysis, realization rate calculations, and WIP aging reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: organisation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.organisation. Business justification: Write-off approval thresholds and bad debt reserves are managed at organisation level for corporate groups. Tracking the organisation enables consolidated write-off reporting, credit risk assessment a

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Write-offs require practice area leader approval and impact practice area P&L. Practice area determines approval authority thresholds, write-off policies, and profitability reporting used in partner c

attributes.name: primary_write_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or other fee earner) whose time or expense entry is being written off. Used for individual realization rate analysis and productivity reporting. Null for matter-level or invoice-level write-offs not attributable to a single timekeeper.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity associated with the write-off. Supports client-level write-off trend analysis, relationship management reporting, and bad debt exposure tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Intapp Conflicts

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_register. Business justification: Material write-offs (especially pattern write-offs by timekeeper or client) are risk events requiring registration for trend analysis, partner accountability, and realization rate monitoring. Firms es

attributes.name: reversed_write_off_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original write-off record that this entry reverses. Populated only when is_reversal is True. Enables audit trail linking between original write-offs and their reversals for GL reconciliation and financial period close.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: wip_ledger_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.wip_ledger.wip_ledger_id — WIP write-offs must reference the WIP ledger entry being written off. Critical for realization rate calculations and ensuring WIP balances are properly reduced.

attributes.name: write_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice from which an AR write-off or billing guideline reduction originates. Null for WIP write-offs that have not yet been billed. Links write-off to the originating billing event for AR aging and collections reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value formally written off or written down, expressed in the billing currency. Must be less than or equal to original_amount. This is the primary financial impact figure used in realization rate, profitability, and financial period close reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approving partner formally authorized the write-off. May differ from write_off_date if approval precedes the accounting period posting. Critical for partner approval audit trails and governance compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SOX

attributes.name: client_agreed_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated or agreed billing rate for the timekeeper applicable to this client/matter at the time of the write-off. Enables analysis of rate realization versus standard rates and identification of billing guideline-driven write-offs.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E; AFA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this write-off record was first created in the system of record. Represents the audit trail creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per firm data conventions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the write-off amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency matters and cross-border client billing. Enables currency-normalized financial reporting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the write-off amount to the firm's functional (home) currency at the time of posting. Relevant for multi-currency matters. Null for write-offs already denominated in the functional currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of fee arrangement under which the matter was being billed at the time of write-off. Contextualizes the write-off within the billing structure (e.g., AFA budget overrun write-offs differ analytically from hourly rate cap write-offs). Supports AFA performance and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement); LEDES

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The firm's fiscal year and month in which the write-off is recognized for financial reporting purposes, formatted as YYYY-MM. Derived from gl_posting_date but stored explicitly to support period-based aggregation and financial close reporting without date arithmetic.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The write-off amount converted to the firm's functional (home) currency using the exchange_rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, partner compensation calculations (PPP/PEP), and firm-wide realization rate analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the write-off is posted to the General Ledger. Determines the financial period (month/quarter/year) in which the write-off impacts the firm's P&L and balance sheet. May differ from write_off_date due to period-end cut-off rules.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: hours_written_off
attributes.description: The number of billable hours associated with the write-off, applicable when the write-off relates to time entries. Null for expense or disbursement write-offs. Used to calculate effective realization rates and to measure the volume of written-off effort.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off record is a reversal of a previously posted write-off (True) or an original write-off entry (False). Reversals restore WIP or AR balances and must be tracked separately for accurate net write-off reporting and GL reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or commentary entered by billing staff, the approving partner, or finance team regarding the write-off. May include client negotiation context, matter budget discussions, or collections history relevant to bad debt write-offs.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: The gross value of the WIP or AR balance before the write-off is applied, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the full amount at standard rates prior to any reduction. Used as the denominator in realization rate calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES; GAAP

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the write-off (e.g., client billing guideline non-compliance, rate cap exceeded, duplicate entry, uncollectable debt, client relationship courtesy, matter budget overrun). Sourced from Elite 3E or Aderant Expert reason code tables. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_guideline|rate_cap|duplicate_entry|bad_debt|courtesy|budget_overrun|staffing_level|task_not_approved — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; UTBMS

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the billing timekeeper or approving partner describing the specific circumstances justifying the write-off. Supplements the structured reason_code with contextual detail for audit and partner review purposes.

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code

attributes.name: utbms_task_code

attributes.name: wip_entry_date

attributes.name: write_down_amount
attributes.description: The partial reduction amount when a write-down (as opposed to a full write-off) is applied. Represents the difference between original_amount and the revised billable amount. Null for full write-offs. Supports partial realization analysis.

attributes.name: write_off_category
attributes.description: Distinguishes whether the write-off applies to professional fees (timekeeper charges), disbursements (client-incurred costs), firm expenses, accrued interest on overdue AR, or tax components. Drives GL account mapping and realization rate segmentation.

attributes.name: write_off_date

attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the write-off transaction, typically generated by Elite 3E or Aderant Expert. Used in partner approval workflows, GL postings, and audit trails. Format: WO-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: evergreen_flag

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag

attributes.name: kyc_verified_flag

attributes.name: last_replenishment_date
