products.name: guideline
products.description: Master record of client-specific billing guidelines and outside counsel guidelines (OCG) that govern invoice compliance requirements. Captures guideline source (client-issued OCG, engagement letter, standing instruction), rule type (rate cap, timekeeper approval, task code restriction, narrative requirement, block billing prohibition, expense limit), effective date, and enforcement action. Used during prebilling review and LEDES submission validation to flag non-compliant entries before invoice issuance.

attributes.name: guideline_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each billing guideline record. Primary key for the billing_guideline data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: contract_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Billing guidelines are contractual obligations embedded in or referenced by service agreements. Invoice review validates billing against contractual guidelines, disputes cite agreement clauses, guidel

attributes.name: doc_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.doc_template. Business justification: Billing guidelines mandate specific invoice templates, narrative formats, or LEDES formats. Essential for automated billing compliance, client-specific formatting requirements, and reducing billing re

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific matter to which this guideline applies. When populated, the guideline is matter-specific; when null, the guideline applies at the client level across all matters.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: organisation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client for whom this billing guideline applies. Links the guideline to the client master record for enforcement during prebilling review and LEDES submission validation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Billing guidelines are often practice-area-specific (e.g., IP guidelines differ from litigation). Practice area determines applicable guidelines, rate caps, and compliance rules used in invoice valida

attributes.name: superseded_by_guideline_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer billing_guideline record that replaces this one when guideline_status is superseded. Enables version chain traceability for audit and historical billing compliance review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: afa_type
attributes.description: The fee arrangement type governed by this guideline. Identifies whether the guideline applies to hourly billing, a flat fee, contingency, blended rate, capped fee, or success fee arrangement. Aligns with the firm's AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) billing model.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: applies_to_expenses
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing guideline applies to expense/disbursement entries in addition to or instead of time entries. When True, expense line items are subject to the same rule enforcement during prebilling review.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Prebilling; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: applies_to_time_entries
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing guideline applies to time entries. When True, time entry records are subject to the rule enforcement during prebilling review and LEDES submission validation.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Prebilling; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the partner, billing manager, or client representative who approved this billing guideline for enforcement. Provides accountability and audit trail for guideline activation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing guideline was formally approved for enforcement. Distinct from effective_from, which is the date the rule becomes binding on billing entries.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: block_billing_prohibited
attributes.description: Indicates whether block billing (combining multiple tasks into a single time entry without itemisation) is prohibited under this guideline. When True, prebilling review must flag any time entries containing multiple tasks in a single narrative.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: budget_cap_amount
attributes.description: Total matter-level or phase-level budget ceiling imposed by the client under this guideline. When WIP (Work in Progress) approaches or exceeds this cap, alerts are triggered for partner review before further billing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this billing guideline record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this billing guideline becomes binding and enforceable. Time entries and expenses incurred on or after this date are subject to the rule. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this billing guideline ceases to be enforceable. Null indicates an open-ended guideline with no defined expiry. Used to determine which version of a guideline applies to a given billing period.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: enforcement_action
attributes.description: The system action triggered when a non-compliant entry is detected during prebilling review or LEDES submission validation. hard_block prevents invoice issuance; soft_warning alerts the billing team; write_off automatically reduces the entry; require_approval routes to partner; flag_for_review marks for manual review.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Prebilling; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any agreed exceptions or carve-outs to this billing guideline, such as approved deviations negotiated with the client or specific matter circumstances where the rule does not apply.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: expense_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum allowable disbursement or expense amount per transaction or per category as defined by this guideline. Populated when rule_type is expense_limit. Used to flag non-compliant expense entries during prebilling review.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: guideline_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the billing rule, including any conditions, exceptions, or qualifications. Provides the complete business context for the guideline as communicated by the client or as agreed in the engagement letter.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: guideline_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or short title of the billing guideline, such as 'Block Billing Prohibition' or 'Senior Associate Rate Cap'. Used for display in prebilling dashboards and compliance reports.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: guideline_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating document or instrument from which this billing guideline derives its authority. Values: ocg (client-issued Outside Counsel Guidelines), engagement_letter (Letter of Engagement / LOE), standing_instruction (ongoing client instruction), matter_specific_agreement (matter-level side agreement), court_order (court-mandated billing restriction).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: guideline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing guideline. Active guidelines are enforced during prebilling review. Superseded guidelines are retained for historical audit. Pending_approval guidelines are awaiting client or partner sign-off before enforcement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: invoice_submission_deadline_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days after the billing period end date within which the firm must submit an invoice to the client. Late submissions beyond this threshold may be subject to write-off or rejection per the OCG.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: invoice_submission_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency at which invoices must be submitted to the client under this guideline. Governs billing cycle compliance and WIP (Work in Progress) management cadence.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Billing

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code) to which this billing guideline applies. Relevant for multi-jurisdictional matters where different billing rules may apply per jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; International Bar Association (IBA); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this billing guideline was reviewed for continued applicability and accuracy. Supports periodic OCG review cycles and ensures guidelines remain current with client instructions.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: ledes_billing_format
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Billing Format
attributes.description: The required LEDES electronic billing format version mandated by the client for invoice submission under this guideline. Governs the file format used when submitting invoices electronically to the client or their e-billing platform.
attributes.references: LEDES Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard; Aderant Expert Billing

attributes.name: minimum_time_increment_mins
attributes.description: The minimum billable time increment in minutes permitted under this guideline (e.g., 6 minutes = 0.1 hour, 15 minutes = 0.25 hour). Time entries rounded to increments larger than this value may be flagged as non-compliant.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Time Entry

attributes.name: narrative_min_length
attributes.description: Minimum number of characters required in a time entry or expense narrative to satisfy the client's narrative requirement under this guideline. Entries with narratives shorter than this threshold are flagged during prebilling review.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: new_timekeeper_rate_freeze
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has imposed a rate freeze on newly introduced timekeepers, requiring them to bill at the same rate as the timekeeper they replace or at a pre-agreed rate. Common OCG provision to control staffing cost escalation.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: ocg_section_reference
attributes.description: Specific section, clause, or paragraph number within the OCG document that contains the rule captured by this guideline record. Supports precise audit trail and dispute resolution when a billing entry is challenged.
attributes.references: iManage Work Document Management System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: rate_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum hourly billing rate permitted under this guideline for the applicable timekeeper level or role. Populated only when rule_type is rate_cap. Enforced during prebilling review to flag time entries exceeding the agreed rate ceiling.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_cap_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the rate_cap_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required when rate_cap_amount is populated to ensure multi-currency billing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: rate_increase_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice the firm must provide to the client before implementing a rate increase under this guideline. Enforces the client's OCG requirement for rate change notification.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the client or law firm to uniquely reference this Outside Counsel Guideline (OCG) or billing instruction document. Used for cross-referencing with client-issued OCG documents.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the billing rule for reporting and filtering purposes. Segments guidelines into operational categories: timekeeper (rate and staffing rules), expense (disbursement rules), invoice_format (LEDES/UTBMS formatting), matter_budget (budget and cap rules), task_code (UTBMS task code restrictions), narrative (time entry description requirements).
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the billing rule being enforced. Defines the nature of the compliance requirement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_cap|timekeeper_approval|task_code_restriction|narrative_requirement|block_billing_prohibition|expense_limit|staffing_restriction|budget_cap|write_off_threshold|invoice_format_requirement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: timekeeper_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether timekeepers must be pre-approved by the client before their time can be billed under this guideline. When True, any time entry from a non-approved timekeeper is flagged as non-compliant during prebilling review.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: timekeeper_level
attributes.description: The seniority or role classification of the timekeeper to which this guideline applies. Used to scope rate caps and staffing restrictions to specific timekeeper grades. 'all' indicates the rule applies universally regardless of timekeeper level.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this billing guideline record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code

attributes.description: The UTBMS activity code (e.g., A101 Plan and Prepare, A102 Research) to which this guideline applies. Used in conjunction with utbms_task_code to restrict or govern specific task-activity combinations in LEDES invoice submissions.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: utbms_task_code

attributes.name: wip_aging_limit_days

attributes.name: client_contact_name

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code

attributes.name: dispute_status

attributes.name: disputed_amount

attributes.name: ebilling_platform

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_flag

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type

attributes.references: AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) governance; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: invoice_amount
attributes.description: The total billed amount on the original invoice at the time the dispute was raised. Provides denominator context for calculating the dispute percentage and realization rate impact.

attributes.name: lpp_flag

attributes.name: received_timestamp

attributes.name: resolution_date

attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance

attributes.name: resolution_notes

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the outcome of the dispute resolution process: whether the firm accepted the full disputed amount, a partial reduction, rejected the dispute, issued a credit note, wrote off the amount, or the client withdrew the dispute.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this dispute record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by the disputed invoice. Provides temporal context for the dispute and supports period-based realization rate and WIP (Work in Progress) analytics.

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: timekeeper_id

attributes.name: accepted_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount accepted by the client e-billing portal from this submission. For partially accepted submissions, this is less than total_amount. Used for accounts receivable posting and WIP clearance.

attributes.name: accepted_invoice_count

attributes.name: billing_guideline_validation_status

attributes.name: billing_guideline_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of billing guideline violations detected during pre-submission validation. A count greater than zero with a passed status indicates warnings were overridden. Used for compliance reporting and client relationship management.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Client Outside Counsel Guidelines (OCG); Elite 3E

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this LEDES submission record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this submission (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency billing environments and cross-border client engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Name of the LEDES-formatted file transmitted to the client e-billing portal (e.g., MATTER12345_INV20240101.txt). Supports file-level traceability and resubmission workflows.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; iManage Work Document Management System

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the transmitted LEDES file in bytes. Used for portal upload validation, transmission monitoring, and identifying anomalously large or empty submissions.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: Number of invoices included in this LEDES submission file. A single LEDES file may bundle multiple invoices for the same client portal. Supports reconciliation between submitted invoice count and portal-acknowledged count.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: invoice_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of invoice numbers included in this LEDES submission file. Provides a human-readable reference to all invoices bundled in the submission without requiring a child line table for simple lookups.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: is_resubmission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is a resubmission of a previously rejected or partially accepted LEDES file. True if this is a corrected resubmission; False if this is the original submission attempt.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E

attributes.name: ledes_format_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Format Version
attributes.description: The LEDES file format version used for this submission (e.g., 1998B, XML 2.0). Determines the file structure, field layout, and portal compatibility requirements. Critical for portal-specific compliance validation.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee (LOC) LEDES 1998B Standard; LEDES XML 2.0 Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the billing team regarding this submission, such as manual override justifications, client communication references, or escalation context. Supports billing team workflow and audit documentation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: portal_code
attributes.description: Reference to the client e-billing portal to which this submission was directed (e.g., TyMetrix 360, Legal Tracker, Passport, BillerXpert). Portal-specific rules govern accepted LEDES versions, UTBMS codes, and billing guideline enforcement.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: portal_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the client e-billing portal to which this submission was directed (e.g., TyMetrix 360, Legal Tracker, Passport). Retained for reporting and troubleshooting without requiring a portal lookup join.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: portal_response_code
attributes.description: Machine-readable response code returned by the client e-billing portal upon processing the submission (e.g., ACK-200, REJ-401, PARTIAL-206). Portal-specific codes used for automated workflow routing and rejection handling.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Client e-billing portal technical specifications

attributes.name: portal_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the client e-billing portal returned a processing response (acceptance, rejection, or partial acceptance) for this submission. Used to measure portal processing SLA compliance.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Client e-billing portal SLA agreements

attributes.name: portal_submission_reference
attributes.description: The unique confirmation or tracking reference number assigned by the client e-billing portal upon receipt of the submission. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution with the client.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Client e-billing portal SLA agreements

attributes.name: rejected_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount rejected by the client e-billing portal from this submission. For partially accepted submissions, this is the difference between total_amount and accepted_amount. Drives write-off or resubmission decisions.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: rejected_invoice_count
attributes.description: Number of invoices within this submission that were rejected by the client e-billing portal. Used for collections workflow prioritization and billing guideline compliance reporting.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the primary reason for rejection or partial rejection by the client e-billing portal (e.g., INVALID_UTBMS_CODE, RATE_EXCEEDS_GUIDELINE, MISSING_TIMEKEEPER_ID, DUPLICATE_INVOICE). Drives resubmission workflow and billing guideline compliance remediation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INVALID_UTBMS_CODE|RATE_EXCEEDS_GUIDELINE|MISSING_TIMEKEEPER_ID|DUPLICATE_INVOICE|INVALID_MATTER_ID|BILLING_GUIDELINE_VIOLATION|MISSING_NARRATIVE|INVALID_DATE_FORMAT|UNAUTHORIZED_TIMEKEEPER|EXCEEDS_BUDGET — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); Client billing guidelines

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the rejection or partial rejection reason as returned by the client e-billing portal. Supplements the rejection_reason_code with human-readable detail for billing team remediation.

attributes.name: resubmission_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of submission attempts for the same invoice set to the same portal (1 = original, 2 = first resubmission, 3 = second resubmission, etc.). Used to track persistent rejection patterns and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Client billing guidelines

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this LEDES submission (e.g., SUB-2024-001234). Used for tracking and reconciliation with client e-billing portals and internal billing teams.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the LEDES submission as reported by the client e-billing portal. Drives collections workflow and resubmission actions. Values: pending (awaiting transmission), submitted (transmitted, awaiting portal response), accepted (fully approved by portal), rejected (fully rejected by portal), partially_accepted (some line items accepted, others rejected), withdrawn (recalled before portal processing).

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LEDES file was transmitted to the client e-billing portal. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Grand total amount (fees + disbursements + tax) across all invoices included in this LEDES submission. Used for financial reconciliation and accounts receivable tracking.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Field Specification

attributes.name: total_disbursements_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate disbursements (expenses) amount across all invoices included in this LEDES submission, expressed in the submission currency. Supports financial reconciliation with portal-acknowledged disbursement totals.

attributes.name: total_fees_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate fees amount across all invoices included in this LEDES submission, expressed in the submission currency. Supports financial reconciliation between submitted amounts and portal-acknowledged amounts.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Field Specification

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate tax amount across all invoices included in this LEDES submission. Relevant for VAT/GST-applicable jurisdictions and cross-border billing compliance.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; LEDES XML 2.0 Standard; GDPR; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: Method used to transmit the LEDES file to the client e-billing portal (e.g., API integration, SFTP, email, manual portal upload, EDI). Relevant for troubleshooting transmission failures and portal integration management.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; PCI DSS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this LEDES submission record was last modified. Captures status updates, portal responses, and resubmission events for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: utbms_validation_status

attributes.description: Result of pre-submission UTBMS code validation against the client's approved task and activity code set. Passed = all codes valid; Failed = one or more invalid codes blocking submission; Warnings = non-blocking code issues; Not_validated = validation not performed.

This is the primary operational entity of the conflict domain and the system-of-record entry sourced from Intapp Conflicts.

products.name: conflict_party
products.description: Master registry of all parties — clients, adverse parties, related entities, individuals, and corporate affiliates — indexed in the conflict search universe. Each party record captures name variants, role classification (client, adverse, related entity, guarantor, beneficial owner), entity type (individual, corporation, government, trust, partnership), jurisdiction of incorporation or domicile, KYC/AML flags, and active/inactive status. Serves as the searchable party index used by every conflict check. Distinct from the client domains client record: this product owns the conflict-specific party classification and search indexing; a party here may or may not be a firm client. For multi-jurisdictional firms, party records are subject to data residency requirements — GDPR-regulated party data (EU/UK natural persons) must be stored and processed within compliant regions, with appropriate cross-border transfer mechanisms documented.

attributes.name: retainer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.retainer. Business justification: Retainers are frequently required as a condition of conflict clearance for new clients or high-risk matters. Linking clearance to the retainer that satisfies clearance conditions supports matter intak

attributes.name: search_execution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the conflict search that triggered this clearance workflow. Links to the upstream conflict check process.

attributes.name: adverse_party_identified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an adverse party (opposing party in litigation or transaction) has been identified that creates a conflict with an existing client. True if adverse party conflict exists; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7; Intapp Conflicts System

attributes.name: clearance_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the clearance decision, typically formatted as CLR-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in correspondence and audit trails.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the clearance decision. Pending Review: awaiting partner review; Cleared: no conflict, matter may open; Cleared with Conditions: approved subject to ethical wall or other restrictions; Declined - Conflict Identified: conflict exists and cannot be waived; Deferred Pending Waiver: conflict exists but client waiver is being sought; Withdrawn: intake request was withdrawn before clearance completed.

attributes.name: client_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the client must be formally notified of the conflict and provide informed consent as a condition of clearance. True if client notification and consent are required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7, 1.9; Informed Consent Requirements

attributes.name: client_waiver_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether informed written consent (waiver) has been obtained from all affected clients. True if all required waivers are on file; False if waivers are pending or not obtained.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7, 1.9; Informed Consent Requirements

attributes.name: condition_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which all clearance conditions must be fulfilled before the matter may proceed. Null if no conditions or no specific due date.

attributes.name: condition_fulfilled_date
attributes.description: The date on which all clearance conditions were confirmed as fulfilled and the matter was authorized to proceed. Null if conditions are not yet fulfilled.

attributes.name: condition_fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Overall status of compliance with all imposed clearance conditions. Not Applicable: no conditions imposed; Pending: conditions not yet started; In Progress: conditions being implemented; Fulfilled: all conditions satisfied; Overdue: one or more conditions past due date.

attributes.name: conditions_imposed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the clearance was granted subject to conditions (ethical wall, scope restriction, client notification, periodic review). True if conditions exist; False if unconditional clearance or denial.

attributes.name: conflict_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified conflict, including the nature of the adverse interest, the relationship between parties, and the factual basis for the conflict determination. Confidential business information protected by Legal Professional Privilege (LPP).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.6, 1.7; Legal Professional Privilege

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this clearance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date the authorizing partner or general counsel issued the final clearance decision (cleared, declined, or deferred). This date gates matter opening in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; Elite 3E Matter Management

attributes.name: deferral_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the clearance decision was deferred, including what additional information or client waiver is required before a final decision can be made. Empty if clearance was not deferred.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules 1.7

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the clearance was denied, including the specific conflict identified, the parties involved, and the ethical rule violated. Empty if clearance was approved. Confidential business information protected by Legal Professional Privilege (LPP).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.6, 1.7, 1.9; Legal Professional Privilege

attributes.name: ethical_wall_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an ethical wall (information barrier) must be erected as a condition of clearance. True if ethical wall is mandatory; False otherwise. Ethical walls prevent information flow between conflicted timekeepers and the matter team.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.10; Intapp Conflicts Ethical Wall Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the clearance decision expires and must be re-evaluated. Typically set for time-sensitive matters or when circumstances may change. Null if clearance does not expire.

attributes.name: for_check
attributes.description: FK to conflict.conflict_check.conflict_check_id — Each clearance decision concludes exactly one conflict check. This is the terminal state record for the check lifecycle.

attributes.name: imputed_conflict_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the conflict is imputed to the entire firm under ABA Rule 1.10 (conflicts of interest imputed to all lawyers in the firm). True if conflict is firm-wide; False if conflict is limited to specific timekeepers.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.10; Intapp Conflicts System

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this clearance record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: lateral_hire_screening_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this clearance is part of a lateral hire conflict screening process (evaluating conflicts that a new attorney would bring to the firm). True if lateral hire screening; False for standard new matter clearance.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules 1.9, 1.10

attributes.name: matter_opened_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the matter has been formally opened in Elite 3E following clearance approval. True if matter is open; False if clearance granted but matter not yet opened or clearance was denied.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of the clearance decision. Null if no periodic review is required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special instructions related to the clearance decision. May include guidance for the matter team, reminders for periodic review, or references to related clearances. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final decision outcome of the clearance process. Approved: no conflict, unconditional clearance; Approved with Conditions: clearance granted subject to ethical wall, scope restriction, or client notification; Denied: conflict identified and matter cannot proceed; Deferred: decision postponed pending additional information or waiver.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: periodic_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the clearance decision requires periodic re-evaluation (e.g., quarterly review of ongoing conflict status). True if periodic review is mandated; False for one-time clearance.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules 1.7

attributes.name: relationship_mapping_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether comprehensive relationship mapping (identifying all corporate affiliates, subsidiaries, beneficial owners, and related parties) has been completed as part of the clearance process. True if mapping is complete; False if pending.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: The date the clearance request was formally submitted for review, typically following completion of the conflict search.

attributes.name: scope_restriction_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any scope restrictions imposed as a condition of clearance. Examples: matter limited to specific transaction phase, prohibited from representing client in certain jurisdictions, restricted to advisory role only. Empty if no scope restrictions.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7; Intapp Conflicts System

products.description: Conflict screening record specific to lateral attorney and staff hires. Captures the candidates prior firm, practice group, matters handled at prior firm (as disclosed), parties represented or adverse, the screening questionnaire responses, identified conflicts, and the hiring partners clearance decision. Enforces ABA Rule 1.10(a)(2) lateral hire imputed disqualification analysis. Integrates with SAP SuccessFactors recruitment workflow.

products.name: relationship_map
products.description: Master record capturing known relationships between parties in the conflict universe — corporate family trees (parent/subsidiary), affiliate chains, beneficial ownership structures, joint venture partnerships, and adverse party pairings. Each record defines the two related parties, relationship type, directionality (parent-to-child, peer-to-peer), effective date range, and the source of the relationship data (client disclosure, public registry, KYC/AML review, Companies House filing). Used to expand conflict search scope beyond direct name matches to identify indirect conflicts through corporate affiliations.

products.name: party_judge_appearance
products.description: This association product represents the appearance history between conflict parties and judges. It captures the operational record of which parties have appeared before which judges across matters, supporting conflict screening, recusal analysis, and litigation strategy intelligence. Each record links one conflict party to one judge with relationship metrics that exist only in the context of their appearance history.. Existence Justification: In legal practice, conflict parties (clients, adverse parties, related entities) appear before multiple judges across different matters over time, and judges preside over cases involving multiple parties. Law firms must track this appearance history to support conflict screening (ensuring no conflicts when taking on new matters), lateral hire screening (assessing whether a new attorney brings conflicts based on their prior party-judge relationships), and litigation strategy (understanding judicial familiarity and past outcomes with specific parties).

attributes.name: first_appearance_date
attributes.description: Date of the first recorded appearance of this party before this judge. Establishes the start of the relationship history for conflict screening purposes.

attributes.name: last_appearance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent appearance of this party before this judge. Used to assess recency of relationship for conflict and recusal risk assessment.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this appearance history record. Used for data freshness tracking and conflict screening audit trails.

attributes.name: matter_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct matters in which this party appeared before this judge. Distinct from appearance_count, which may include multiple appearances within the same matter.

attributes.name: outcome_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of outcomes when this party appeared before this judge (e.g., 'Favorable in 8 of 12 matters', 'Mixed outcomes'). Used for litigation strategy and judicial relationship intelligence.

Client indicates the party was represented by the firm; Adverse_Party indicates opposition; Mixed indicates the party appeared in different roles across matters. products.name: party_practice_conflict
products.description: This association product represents the practice-area-specific conflict relationship between a conflict party and a practice area. Legal firms must track conflict status at the granular level of each party-practice area combination because a single party may simultaneously be a client in one practice area (e.g., IP) while being adverse in another (e.g., litigation). Each record captures the conflict severity, relationship type (client/adverse/neutral), and temporal tracking of conflict checks specific to that party-practice area pairing.. Existence Justification: In legal practice, conflict checking must be performed at the granular level of each party-practice area combination because a single party can simultaneously hold different conflict statuses across practice areas. For example, a corporation may be a current client for IP matters while being adverse to another client in litigation, or a related entity in M&A while neutral in employment law. Law firms operationally manage these practice-area-specific conflict relationships as distinct records, each with its own severity assessment, relationship type, conflict check history, and waiver status.

products.name: wall_enforcement
products.description: This association product represents the enforcement relationship between an ethical wall (information barrier) and a specific agreement. It captures the applicability of an ethical screen to a contract artifact, tracking when and why the wall applies to the agreement, enforcement status, and any breach incidents. Each record links one ethical wall to one agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this enforcement relationship.. Existence Justification: In legal practice, one ethical wall can apply to multiple agreements when the conflict or screening trigger affects multiple contracts (e.g., a lateral hires former client has multiple active agreements with the firm). Conversely, one agreement can be subject to multiple ethical walls when different conflicts arise from different sources (e.g., multiple lateral hires with conflicts, or multiple adverse parties). The firm actively manages these enforcement relationships, tracking when each wall applies to each agreement, with specific applicability reasons, dates, and breach monitoring per wall-agreement pair.

attributes.name: predecessor_ownership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous ownership record in the chain of title. Enables reconstruction of the complete ownership history for due diligence purposes.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity that owns or is associated with this IP ownership record. Links to the client master data.

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_register. Business justification: Ownership disputes, chain-of-title defects, unrecorded assignments, and security interests create transaction risks (M&A due diligence failures), enforcement risks (standing challenges), and valuation

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: IP ownership changes trigger regulatory obligations including recordal requirements at IP offices, foreign ownership notifications, security interest filings (UCC), and beneficial ownership disclosure

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ownership rights were assigned or transferred to the current owner. Represents the effective date of the assignment agreement.
attributes.references: Patent Assignment Standards, Trademark Assignment Guidelines

attributes.name: assignment_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system (DMS) link to the legal assignment agreement or deed of assignment that evidences the ownership transfer.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Legal basis or mechanism by which ownership was acquired. Distinguishes between original application, assignment, merger/acquisition, inheritance, court order, license conversion, or other mechanisms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: original_applicant|assignment|merger_acquisition|inheritance|court_order|license_conversion|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Patent Assignment Standards, Corporate Transaction Guidelines

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the beneficial owner (e.g., tax ID, national ID, passport number). Required for KYC and AML compliance.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF), AML Regulations

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the ultimate beneficial owner if different from the legal owner. Required for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Client (KYC) compliance.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF), AML Regulations

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Monetary consideration paid for the assignment or transfer of ownership rights. May be zero for assignments without monetary consideration (e.g., employment agreements).
attributes.references: Contract Law Standards, M&A Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: consideration_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the consideration amount. Required when consideration_amount is non-zero.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which this ownership record is effective. Null for current ownership. Supports temporal tracking of ownership changes and chain of title reconstruction.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ownership record is effective. Supports temporal tracking of ownership changes and chain of title reconstruction.

attributes.name: frand_commitment_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) Commitment Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the FRAND commitment or declaration made to the relevant standards development organization (SDO).
attributes.references: FRAND Guidelines, Standards Development Organization (SDO) Policies

attributes.name: frand_obligation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) Obligation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP asset is subject to Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) licensing obligations, typically for standard-essential patents.
attributes.references: FRAND Guidelines, Standards Development Organization (SDO) Policies

attributes.name: is_current_owner
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this record represents the current owner of the IP asset. True for the active ownership record, false for historical records.

attributes.name: joint_ownership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP asset is subject to joint ownership by multiple parties. True if multiple ownership records exist for the same IP asset.
attributes.references: Joint Ownership Guidelines, Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the jurisdiction in which this ownership record applies. IP ownership may vary by jurisdiction for international assets.

attributes.name: license_back_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment includes a license-back provision allowing the assignor to continue using the IP. Common in employment and M&A contexts.
attributes.references: Patent Licensing Standards, M&A Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: license_back_terms
attributes.description: Summary of the license-back terms if applicable, including scope, duration, and any royalty obligations.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this ownership record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes over time.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the ownership record. May include special conditions, restrictions, or contextual information relevant to the ownership.

attributes.name: of_asset
attributes.description: FK to ip.asset.asset_id — Ownership records establish chain of title for specific IP assets. Essential for assignment tracking and M&A due diligence.

attributes.name: owner_address
attributes.description: Full legal address of the owner entity as recorded with the IP office. Required for official correspondence and recordal purposes.

attributes.name: owner_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for correspondence with the owner regarding this IP ownership record.

attributes.name: owner_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the owner regarding this IP ownership record.

attributes.name: owner_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country of domicile or incorporation of the owner entity.

attributes.name: owner_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the entity or individual that holds ownership rights in the IP asset. May be an individual inventor, corporate assignee, joint owner, or government entity.

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership entity type. Distinguishes between individual inventors, corporate assignees, joint owners, government entities, universities, and trusts.

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ownership record. Tracks whether ownership is active, pending recordal, transferred to another party, terminated, under dispute, or lapsed.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership interest held by this owner in the IP asset. For sole ownership, this is 100.00. For joint ownership, reflects the proportional share.

attributes.name: recordal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ownership assignment was officially recorded with the relevant IP office or registry. Critical for establishing priority and chain of title.
attributes.references: USPTO Assignment Recordation, EPO Recordal Guidelines

attributes.name: recordal_number
attributes.description: Official recordal or registration number issued by the IP office when the ownership assignment was recorded. Used for verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: security_interest_description
attributes.description: Description of any security interest, lien, or encumbrance affecting the IP ownership. Includes details of the secured party and nature of the security.
attributes.references: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), Security Interest Guidelines

attributes.name: security_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP asset is subject to a security interest, lien, or encumbrance that affects ownership rights. True if security interest exists.
attributes.references: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), Security Interest Guidelines

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ownership record was last verified or validated. Critical for due diligence and portfolio audits.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the ownership verification process. Indicates whether the chain of title has been verified, is pending verification, remains unverified, or is disputed.
attributes.references: IP Due Diligence Standards, M&A Guidelines

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that performed the ownership verification. Used for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this ownership record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: inventor
products.description: Master record for individual inventors named on patent applications and grants, maintaining independent lifecycle for inventorship determination, derivation proceedings, and assignment chain management. Captures inventor full name, nationality, residence address, employer at time of invention, invention disclosure date, assignment executed flag, oath or declaration status, inventor contribution description, joint inventor flag, and employment agreement reference. Supports inventorship disputes, correction of inventorship filings, assignment chain integrity verification, and derivation proceeding risk management. Linked to patents via many-to-many relationship reflecting that inventors may appear on multiple patent applications.

attributes.name: inventor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventor record. Primary key for the inventor entity.

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: FK to ip.patent.patent_id — Inventors are named on specific patent applications. This many-to-many relationship is essential for inventorship determination and assignment chain integrity.

attributes.name: assignment_executed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventor has executed a formal assignment of patent rights to the employer or assignee. Critical for chain of title verification.

attributes.name: assignment_execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor signed the patent assignment document transferring rights to the assignee.

attributes.name: assignment_recordation_number
attributes.description: USPTO or patent office recordation number for the assignment document. Used to verify chain of title in patent prosecution and litigation.
attributes.references: 37 CFR 3.11 (Recording of Assignment); USPTO Assignment Database

attributes.name: conception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor conceived the complete and operative invention. Used for priority determination in interference and derivation proceedings.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 102 (Conditions for Patentability); Hybritech Inc. v. Monoclonal Antibodies, Inc.

attributes.name: contribution_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the inventor's specific contribution to the conception of the claimed invention. Used for inventorship determination and correction of inventorship proceedings.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 116 (Inventors); Pannu v. Iolab Corp. (inventorship standard)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventor record was first created in the IP management system.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the inventor record originated (e.g., patent docketing system, invention disclosure system, HR system).

attributes.name: deceased_date
attributes.description: Date of death of the inventor, if applicable. Triggers substitute statement requirements for pending applications.

attributes.name: derivation_proceeding_number
attributes.description: USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) proceeding number for any derivation proceeding involving this inventor.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for inventor correspondence regarding patent prosecution, inventorship disputes, and assignment execution.

attributes.name: employer_at_invention
attributes.description: Name of the organization employing the inventor at the time the invention was conceived. Critical for determining assignment rights and work-for-hire status.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 261 (Ownership and Assignment); Employment Agreement IP Clauses

attributes.name: employment_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the employment agreement containing IP assignment provisions. Used to verify pre-invention assignment obligations.

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Last or family name of the inventor. Used for structured name parsing in international patent filings.

attributes.name: full_legal_name
attributes.description: Complete legal name of the inventor as it appears on patent applications and grants. Used for inventorship determination and official USPTO/EPO/WIPO filings.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 115 (Inventor's Oath or Declaration); PCT Rule 4.5

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: First or given name of the inventor. Used for structured name parsing in international patent filings.

attributes.name: invention_disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor formally disclosed the invention to the employer or patent counsel. Establishes priority date for derivation proceedings and assignment chain.

attributes.name: inventor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventor record. Affects ability to obtain signatures for continuation applications and assignment documents.

attributes.name: inventorship_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventor is involved in an inventorship dispute, derivation proceeding, or correction of inventorship petition.

attributes.name: joint_inventor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventor is one of multiple joint inventors on one or more patent applications. Joint inventors must each contribute to the conception of at least one claim.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventor record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: legal_representative_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal representative (executor, administrator, guardian) authorized to act on behalf of a deceased or incapacitated inventor.

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the inventor's nationality. Required for PCT applications and determines eligibility for certain patent prosecution highways.

attributes.name: oath_declaration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor executed the oath or declaration for the patent application.

attributes.name: oath_declaration_status
attributes.description: Status of the inventor's oath or declaration required for patent application filing. Indicates whether the inventor has sworn to the accuracy of the application.

attributes.name: orcid_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: ORCID (Open Researcher and Contributor ID) Identifier
attributes.description: Unique persistent digital identifier for the inventor as a researcher. Facilitates disambiguation of inventor names across patent offices and academic publications.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the inventor. Used for urgent patent prosecution matters and inventorship verification.

attributes.name: prior_art_disclosure_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventor has an ongoing duty to disclose known prior art material to patentability under the duty of candor.
attributes.references: 37 CFR 1.56 (Duty to Disclose Information Material to Patentability)

attributes.name: residence_address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the inventor's residence. Required for inventor oath or declaration filings.

attributes.name: residence_address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line of the inventor's residence (apartment, suite, building number).

attributes.name: residence_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the inventor's residence address.

attributes.name: residence_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the inventor's country of residence at time of invention. Determines applicable patent law jurisdiction and filing requirements.

attributes.name: residence_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the inventor's residence address.

attributes.name: residence_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the inventor's residence address.

products.name: patent_family
products.description: Master record grouping related patent applications and grants that share a common priority claim into a patent family. Captures family identifier, priority application reference (earliest filing), priority date, family type (simple/Paris Convention, extended/INPADOC, complete), member jurisdiction count, technology area (IPC/CPC based), strategic importance rating, family status, and continuation/divisional chain indicators. Enables portfolio-level analysis, freedom-to-operate assessments, patent landscape mapping, and coordinated multi-jurisdictional prosecution strategy.

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patent family record. Primary key.

attributes.name: attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney or patent agent) responsible for managing prosecution and strategy for this patent family. Links to the timekeeper master data product.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct, USPTO 37 CFR 11

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter under which this patent family is managed. Links to the matter master data product for billing, timekeeper assignment, and matter-level reporting.
attributes.references: LEDES Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard, ABA Matter Management Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity that owns or controls this patent family. Links to the client master data product.

attributes.name: abstract_text
attributes.description: Brief technical summary of the invention from the priority or representative application. Typically 150-300 words describing the technical problem, solution, and key features.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements, USPTO MPEP 608.01(b)

attributes.name: active_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family record is currently active in the system. True for active records, False for archived or soft-deleted records. Used for data retention and reporting filters.

attributes.name: annuity_payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of annuity (maintenance fee) payments across all family members. Current (all fees paid), Overdue (payment missed but within grace period), Grace_period (in statutory grace period), Lapsed (patent rights lost due to non-payment).
attributes.references: EPC Rule 51 Renewal Fees, USPTO 37 CFR 1.362 Maintenance Fees

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the applicant (assignee) for the priority application. Typically the corporate entity owning the IP rights. Business-confidential.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements, Paris Convention Article 4ter

attributes.name: continuation_chain_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family includes continuation, continuation-in-part, or divisional applications. True if continuation chain exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: USPTO MPEP Chapter 200 - Types and Status of Application, 35 USC 120

attributes.name: cpc_class
attributes.description: Primary CPC classification code. Joint classification system developed by EPO and USPTO providing more granular technical categorization than IPC.
attributes.references: Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) Scheme, EPO/USPTO Joint Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent family record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, GDPR Article 5 Data Accuracy

attributes.name: divisional_chain_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family includes divisional applications filed to pursue distinct inventions disclosed in a parent application. True if divisional chain exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EPC Article 76 Divisional Applications, USPTO MPEP 201.06

attributes.name: docketing_system_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier in the IP docketing system (e.g., CPI, Foundation IP, Alt Legal) used for deadline management and prosecution tracking. Enables cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: family_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the patent family, typically assigned by the IP management system or patent office. Used for cross-system reference and client communication.

attributes.name: family_status
attributes.description: Current overall status of the patent family. Active (at least one granted and in-force patent), Pending (applications under prosecution), Expired (all patents reached end of term), Abandoned (all applications withdrawn or rejected), Lapsed (all patents lapsed due to non-payment).
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Register Standards, USPTO Patent Status Definitions

attributes.name: family_type
attributes.description: Classification of the patent family structure. Simple (Paris Convention family sharing same priority), Extended (INPADOC family including all related applications), Complete (all documents sharing technical content).
attributes.references: INPADOC Family Classification Standards, EPO Patent Family Definitions

attributes.name: frand_obligation_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) Obligation Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family is subject to FRAND (Fair, Reasonable, and Non-Discriminatory) licensing obligations due to standard-essential patent (SEP) declarations. True if FRAND-encumbered, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ETSI IPR Policy, IEEE Patent Policy, ISO/IEC Patent Policy

attributes.name: freedom_to_operate_status
attributes.description: Status of freedom-to-operate analysis for this patent family. Clear (no blocking patents identified), Risk_identified (potential infringement risk found), Under_review (FTO analysis in progress), Not_assessed (no FTO performed). Business-confidential strategic information.
attributes.references: ABA IP Section FTO Best Practices

attributes.name: invention_title
attributes.description: The title of the invention as disclosed in the priority or representative application. Used for quick identification and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements

attributes.name: inventor_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of inventor names as disclosed in the priority application. May be business-confidential depending on client agreement and jurisdiction disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements, 35 USC 115

attributes.name: ipc_class
attributes.description: Primary IPC classification code assigned to this patent family. Hierarchical classification system used worldwide for categorizing patent documents by technical field.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent family record was last updated. Critical for change tracking, audit compliance, and data synchronization.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, GDPR Article 5 Data Accuracy

attributes.name: licensing_status
attributes.description: Current licensing posture of this patent family. Unlicensed (no active licenses), Exclusively_licensed (single licensee with exclusive rights), Non_exclusively_licensed (multiple licensees), Cross_licensed (licensed as part of cross-license agreement).
attributes.references: WIPO Licensing Guide for Universities, ABA IP Licensing Standards

attributes.name: litigation_involvement_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family is currently or has been involved in patent litigation, opposition, or inter partes review proceedings. True if litigation history exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: USPTO PTAB Proceedings, EPO Opposition Proceedings

attributes.name: member_jurisdiction_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct jurisdictions (countries or patent offices) where patent applications or grants exist as members of this family. Indicates geographic breadth of protection.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Statistics Standards

attributes.name: next_annuity_due_date
attributes.description: Earliest upcoming annuity or maintenance fee due date across all active family members. Critical for IP docketing and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: EPC Rule 51 Renewal Fees, USPTO 37 CFR 1.362 Maintenance Fees

attributes.name: opposition_count
attributes.description: Total number of opposition or post-grant review proceedings filed against patents in this family. Indicator of competitive interest and patent strength.
attributes.references: EPC Article 99 Opposition, USPTO AIA Post-Grant Review

attributes.name: pct_application_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family includes a PCT international application. True if PCT route was used, False otherwise. Critical for understanding prosecution strategy and timeline.

attributes.name: portfolio_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of this patent family based on valuation methodology (cost, market, income approach). Used for portfolio management, licensing negotiations, and financial reporting. Business-confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 10668 Brand Valuation, AICPA Valuation Standards

attributes.name: pph_eligibility_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family is eligible for accelerated examination under Patent Prosecution Highway agreements based on allowance in a participating office. True if eligible, False otherwise.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) Program, IP5 PPH Guidelines

attributes.name: priority_application_number
attributes.description: The application number of the earliest filing (priority application) that establishes the priority date for this patent family. Format typically includes country code and serial number.
attributes.references: Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property Article 4, WIPO Standard ST.13

attributes.name: priority_country_code
attributes.description: ISO country code of the jurisdiction where the priority application was filed. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, WIPO Standard ST.3

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: The earliest filing date claimed by any member of this patent family. Critical for determining patent term, prior art cutoff, and prosecution strategy across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: Paris Convention Article 4, Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Article 8

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this patent family record originated (e.g., Elite 3E, IP docketing system, patent office data feed). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Data Management Standards, DAMA-DMBOK Data Lineage

attributes.name: standard_essential_patent_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family has been declared as essential to one or more technical standards. True if declared as SEP, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ETSI IPR Database, IEEE SA Standards Board Bylaws

attributes.name: strategic_importance_rating
attributes.description: Business assessment of the strategic value of this patent family to the client's IP portfolio. Used for prioritization of prosecution spend, licensing strategy, and portfolio pruning decisions.

attributes.name: technology_area
attributes.description: Primary technology domain or field of invention based on International Patent Classification (IPC) or Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) codes. Used for portfolio segmentation and landscape analysis.
attributes.references: WIPO International Patent Classification (IPC), Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC)

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the portfolio valuation amount.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the portfolio valuation was performed or last updated. Critical for financial reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 10668 Brand Valuation, AICPA Valuation Standards

products.name: asset_precedent_usage
products.description: This association product represents the usage event between an IP asset and a precedent document. It captures when and how a specific precedent template was applied during the lifecycle of an IP asset, including which sections were used, how they were adapted, and effectiveness ratings for knowledge management feedback loops. Each record links one IP asset to one precedent with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific usage instance.. Existence Justification: In legal practice, a single IP asset (patent, trademark, copyright) progresses through multiple lifecycle stages (filing, prosecution, assignment, licensing, maintenance) and may reference different precedent templates at each stage—a patent might use a filing template, then a prosecution response template, then an assignment agreement template. Conversely, a single precedent template (e.g., a standard office action response template) is reused across hundreds or thousands of IP assets. The relationship is operationally managed by knowledge management teams who track which precedents are used, how they are adapted, and their effectiveness to continuously improve the precedent library.

products.name: asset_contact_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the role-based assignment between contacts and IP assets. It captures the operational relationship where contacts serve specific functions (inventor liaison, business owner, licensing manager, billing contact) for IP assets under management. Each record links one contact to one IP asset with role, notification preferences, authority level, and temporal validity that exist only in the context of this assignment.. Existence Justification: In legal IP practice management, a single IP asset requires multiple contacts serving different operational roles (inventor liaison for technical queries, business owner for strategic decisions, licensing manager for commercialization, billing contact for invoicing). Conversely, a single contact—especially in-house counsel or portfolio managers—is routinely assigned responsibility for multiple IP assets across a clients portfolio. This is an operational assignment that IP practice managers actively create, update, and terminate based on client organizational changes, matter staffing, and portfolio restructuring.
