products.name: patent_prosecution_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of timekeepers to patent prosecution matters. It captures the role-based participation of attorneys, patent agents, paralegals, and support staff in patent prosecution work. Each record links one patent to one timekeeper with attributes that exist only in the context of this working relationship, including prosecution role, time allocation, responsibility designation, and engagement period.. Existence Justification: Patent prosecution is a team-based legal process where multiple timekeepers (lead attorneys, associate attorneys, patent agents, paralegals, technical specialists) collaborate on a single patent application over its multi-year lifecycle, and each timekeeper typically works on dozens to hundreds of patents simultaneously. Law firms actively manage these assignments for staffing optimization, workload balancing, billing allocation, and expertise matching. The relationship itself carries operational data including prosecution role, hours worked, responsibility designation, and engagement period that cannot be attributed to either the patent or the timekeeper alone.

products.name: agreement_type_clause_policy
products.description: This association product represents the clause playbook policy between agreement types and clause library entries. It captures the knowledge management rules that define which clauses are mandatory, recommended, or optional for each agreement type. Each record links one agreement type to one clause with policy attributes that govern clause selection and usage during contract drafting and negotiation.. Existence Justification: This is a genuine operational M:N relationship representing the Agreement Type Clause Playbook, a core knowledge management concept in legal contract lifecycle management. Law firms actively maintain policy rules that define which clauses are mandatory, recommended, or optional for each agreement type. Knowledge management teams update these playbooks when regulations change (e.g., requiring specific clauses in all NDAs) or when court rulings affect clause risk profiles. This is distinct from template composition—it is the policy layer that governs clause selection during contract drafting.

products.name: template_clause
products.description: This association product represents the composition relationship between contract templates and clause library entries. It captures which approved clauses are included in which contract templates, along with sequencing, optionality, and jurisdiction-specific overrides. Each record links one contract template to one clause with attributes that govern how that clause is used within that specific template context.. Existence Justification: Law firms actively manage template composition as a core knowledge management process. Knowledge management teams curate which approved clauses belong in which contract templates, attorneys review and approve clause selections for specific template types, and compliance teams audit template composition for regulatory adherence. This is not a derived correlation but an operational business process where the firm maintains explicit clause-to-template assignments with sequencing, optionality rules, and jurisdiction-specific overrides.

domains.name: trust
domains.description: Dedicated domain for client trust account management in strict compliance with IOLTA rules and jurisdiction-specific trust accounting regulations. Owns trust ledger entries, three-way reconciliations, client fund segregation records, disbursement authorizations, and regulatory trust account reporting. Operationally distinct from the billing domain — trust owns fiduciary client funds; billing owns firm revenue.
domains.references: IOLTA Regulations; ABA Model Rules 1.15; SRA Accounts Rules

products.name: account
products.description: Master record for each client trust account maintained by the firm in compliance with IOLTA rules and jurisdiction-specific trust accounting regulations. Captures account type (IOLTA pooled, individual client trust, escrow, retainer), account status, designated financial institution, account number, jurisdiction, opening and closing dates, responsible attorney, and regulatory classification. Serves as the SSOT for all fiduciary client fund accounts — operationally distinct from billing accounts which track firm revenue.

attributes.name: account_name

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trust account. attributes.name: audit_frequency

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent three-way reconciliation performed for this trust account. Trust accounts must be reconciled monthly, comparing bank statement balance, trust ledger balance, and client ledger balances.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, State Bar Trust Account Regulations

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trust account record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute of the trust account is changed. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the trust account was opened at the financial institution. Marks the beginning of the accounts operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: purpose_of_account

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of trust account reconciliation compliance. attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: regulatory_classification

attributes.name: source_of_funds

products.name: ledger_entry
products.description: Granular double-entry ledger record for every debit and credit movement within a client trust account. The single source of truth (SSOT) for all trust fund transactions — no other product in this domain records financial movements. Covers all transaction types including: receipts (advance retainers, settlement proceeds, escrow deposits, court-ordered funds) with source-of-funds, payment method, client authorization reference, and AML screening attributes; disbursements (third-party payments, fee transfers to operating, settlement distributions, filing fees, expert witness payments) with payee, disbursement category (UTBMS cost code), signatory attorney, and authorization status; transfers between accounts; interest credits; and bank charge reversals. Captures transaction date, value date, transaction type, direction (debit/credit), amount, running balance, matter reference, counterparty identity, payment method (wire, cheque, ACH, SWIFT), authorization reference, and LEDES coding where applicable. Receipt entries include source-of-funds classification and AML screening outcome. Disbursement entries link to disbursement_authorization for approval workflow. The atomic unit of trust accounting — every three-way reconciliation, client balance, and regulatory report is built from these entries.

attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.description: Indicator of whether written client authorization for trust fund handling is on file. Required for compliance with engagement letter and trust accounting requirements.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this trust balance record was first created in the system. Represents the inception of trust accounting for this client-matter.
attributes.references: Data governance and audit trail standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the trust balance (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency trust accounting in international practices.

attributes.name: current_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current available trust balance for the client-matter combination as of the balance_as_of_date. Represents funds available for authorized disbursements.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: dormancy_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days without activity after which the trust balance is considered dormant and subject to escheatment review. Varies by jurisdiction (typically 180-365 days).
attributes.references: State escheatment laws, unclaimed property regulations

attributes.name: escheatment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the trust balance is eligible for escheatment to the state due to dormancy and inability to locate the client. True triggers escheatment reporting and remittance process.
attributes.references: State escheatment laws, unclaimed property regulations

attributes.name: escheatment_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the trust balance was last reviewed for escheatment eligibility. Required for compliance with unclaimed property reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: State escheatment laws, unclaimed property regulations

attributes.name: held_balance_amount
attributes.description: Amount of trust funds held pending disbursement authorization or clearance. Represents funds committed but not yet disbursed (e.g., checks issued but not cleared, pending wire transfers).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: interest_disbursed_amount
attributes.description: Total interest disbursed to the client from this trust balance. Used to reconcile interest earned vs. interest paid out.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: interest_earned_amount
attributes.description: Total interest earned on this client trust balance if held in an individual interest-bearing account (not pooled IOLTA). Interest belongs to the client and must be tracked separately.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, IOLTA regulations

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: State, province, or country code governing the trust account regulations applicable to this balance. Determines which bar association rules and IOLTA regulations apply.
attributes.references: State Bar Association trust accounting rules, IOLTA regulations by jurisdiction

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent trust activity (deposit, disbursement, or transfer) for this client-matter. Used to identify dormant accounts subject to escheatment or closure.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, State escheatment laws

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date when this trust balance was last audited by internal compliance or external auditors. Used to track audit coverage and schedule future reviews.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, State Bar Association audit requirements

attributes.name: last_deposit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent deposit into trust for this client-matter. Used to identify dormant accounts and trigger escheatment reviews.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: last_disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent disbursement from trust for this client-matter. Used to identify dormant accounts and assess matter closure readiness.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this trust balance record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Data governance and audit trail standards

attributes.name: last_reconciled_balance_amount
attributes.description: Trust balance amount as of the last completed three-way reconciliation (bank statement, trust ledger, client sub-ledger). Used to detect discrepancies and ensure compliance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, State Bar Association reconciliation requirements

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date of the last completed three-way trust account reconciliation for this client-matter balance. Regulatory requirement for monthly reconciliation in most jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, State Bar Association reconciliation requirements

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required_amount
attributes.description: Minimum trust balance amount required to be maintained for this client-matter per engagement terms or regulatory requirements. Used to trigger alerts for low balance conditions.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: negative_balance_date
attributes.description: Date when the trust balance first went negative, if applicable. Used for regulatory reporting and disciplinary investigation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: negative_balance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the trust balance has ever gone negative, which is a serious ethical violation. True indicates a historical or current negative balance condition requiring immediate remediation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Initial trust balance amount when the client-matter trust sub-ledger was established. Represents the first deposit or transfer into trust for this matter.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this trust balance record originated (e.g., Elite 3E, Aderant Expert). Used for data lineage and reconciliation with upstream systems.
attributes.references: Data governance and data lineage standards

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this trust balance requires special regulatory reporting (e.g., large cash transactions, suspicious activity, cross-border transfers). True triggers compliance review and reporting workflow.
attributes.references: AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations, FATF guidelines, State Bar Association reporting requirements

attributes.name: total_deposits_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all deposits into trust for this client-matter since inception. Used for reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: total_disbursements_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all disbursements from trust for this client-matter since inception. Used for reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: trust_account_type
attributes.description: Type of trust account holding the funds: pooled IOLTA account for multiple clients, individual client trust account, or escrow account for specific transactions.
attributes.references: IOLTA regulations, State Bar Association trust accounting rules

attributes.name: trust_accounting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special trust accounting considerations, client instructions, or regulatory exceptions applicable to this balance. Used for audit trail and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: aml_screening_status

attributes.name: dual_signatory_threshold_amount

attributes.name: final_authorization_date

attributes.name: final_authorization_timestamp

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: managing_partner_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the managing partner approved the disbursement. Null if not required, not yet approved, or rejected.

attributes.name: managing_partner_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time of managing partner approval. Required for high-value disbursements exceeding dual-signatory threshold.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the disbursement authorization was rejected. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the rejecting approver for denying the disbursement authorization. Required for audit trail and process improvement.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for rejection. Used for reporting and trend analysis of authorization failures.

attributes.name: rejection_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the disbursement authorization was rejected by an approver in the authorization chain.

attributes.name: request_date

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the disbursement authorization request was submitted. Required for audit trail and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: supervising_partner_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supervising partner approved the disbursement. Null if not yet approved or if rejected.

attributes.name: supervising_partner_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time of supervising partner approval. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to supporting documentation stored in the document management system. Links authorization to invoices, receipts, or court orders.

products.name: three_way_reconciliation
products.description: Periodic three-way reconciliation record that validates agreement between the firms trust ledger balance, the client sub-ledger total, and the bank statement balance for each trust account. Header captures reconciliation period (monthly mandatory), bank statement balance, book balance, client ledger total, identified variances, variance resolution notes, reconciliation status (in-progress, completed, exception), preparer, reviewer, and sign-off date. Reconciling items (modeled as detail records within this product) capture: item type (outstanding cheque, deposit in transit, bank error, ledger error, timing difference), amount, originating transaction reference, expected clearance date, resolution status, and resolution date. Mandatory under ABA Model Rules and SRA Accounts Rules. Provides the complete audit trail required to clear reconciliation exceptions and satisfy regulatory examination.

attributes.name: three_way_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the three-way reconciliation record. Primary key for the reconciliation entity.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules on Client Trust Accounts

attributes.name: approver_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner or designated trust account signatory who provided final approval and sign-off on the reconciliation. Required under most jurisdictions.

attributes.name: bank_statement_id
attributes.description: FK to trust.bank_statement.bank_statement_id — Each reconciliation references the specific bank statement used as the external balance source. Critical for audit trail.

attributes.name: compliance_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_control. Business justification: Three-way reconciliation is a key detective control tested under compliance frameworks (SRA, ABA Model Rules). Control testing samples reconciliations for completeness, timeliness, and review evidence

attributes.name: primary_three_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (typically accounting staff or trust accountant) who performed the reconciliation. Links to workforce.attorney_profile or staff record.

attributes.name: reconciliation_checklist_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to knowledge.checklist. Business justification: Three-way reconciliation procedures follow standardized process checklists (bank statement matching, ledger verification, client balance confirmation). Critical for regulatory compliance and audit rea

attributes.name: reviewer_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior staff member or partner who reviewed the reconciliation for accuracy and completeness. Segregation of duties required.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approver provided final sign-off on the reconciliation. Completes the reconciliation lifecycle and establishes regulatory compliance date.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation (bank statements, ledger reports, reconciliation worksheets) stored in the document management system. Required for regulatory examination.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number for the trust account being reconciled. Masked or encrypted in reporting; full number required for audit trail.

attributes.name: bank_errors_total
attributes.description: Total amount of errors identified on the bank statement (incorrect charges, duplicate transactions, posting errors). Requires bank correction and documentation.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution holding the trust account (e.g., JPMorgan Chase, HSBC). Required for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: bank_statement_balance
attributes.description: The ending balance reported on the bank statement for the trust account as of the reconciliation period end date. First leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The statement date printed on the bank statement used for this reconciliation. Typically matches reconciliation_period_end_date but may differ for mid-month reconciliations.

attributes.name: book_balance
attributes.description: The trust ledger balance per the firm's accounting system (Elite 3E GL trust account) as of the reconciliation period end date. Second leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: client_ledger_total
attributes.description: The sum of all individual client sub-ledger balances as of the reconciliation period end date. Third leg of the three-way reconciliation. Must equal book_balance when no variances exist.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this reconciliation (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Trust accounts are typically single-currency.

attributes.name: deposits_in_transit_total
attributes.description: Total amount of deposits recorded in the trust ledger but not yet reflected on the bank statement as of the reconciliation date. Reconciling item between book and bank balances.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: The number of reconciling items (outstanding checks, deposits in transit, errors) identified during this reconciliation. Zero indicates clean reconciliation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction governing this trust account (e.g., USA state code, GBR for England and Wales). Trust accounting rules vary by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation record was last updated. Tracks changes during the reconciliation lifecycle (in_progress to completed).

attributes.name: ledger_errors_total
attributes.description: Total amount of errors identified in the firm's trust ledger (posting errors, incorrect amounts, duplicate entries). Requires correcting journal entries and audit trail.

attributes.name: outstanding_checks_total
attributes.description: Total amount of checks issued from the trust account that have not yet cleared the bank as of the reconciliation date. Reconciling item between book and bank balances.

attributes.name: prior_period_unresolved_variance
attributes.description: The unresolved variance amount carried forward from the previous reconciliation period. Should be resolved in current period or escalated.

attributes.name: reconciliation_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the reconciliation: manual (spreadsheet-based), semi_automated (system-assisted with manual review), fully_automated (system-generated with exception-only review).

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the reconciliation record, typically formatted as RECON-YYYYMM-NNNN for monthly reconciliations.

attributes.name: reconciliation_performed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation work was completed by the preparer. Must be within regulatory timeframes (typically within 30 days of period end).

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the period covered by this reconciliation, typically the last day of the month. Mandatory monthly reconciliation under most jurisdictions.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the period covered by this reconciliation, typically the first day of the month.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reconciliation process: in_progress (reconciliation being performed), completed (reconciliation finished with no exceptions), exception (variances identified requiring resolution), under_review (submitted for partner review), approved (final sign-off completed).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this reconciliation was submitted to the regulatory authority, if required. Null if no filing is required or filing is pending.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation must be submitted to the regulatory authority (e.g., annual IOLTA report, SRA accountant's report). True if filing is required.

attributes.name: review_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reviewer completed their review of the reconciliation. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: timing_differences_total
attributes.description: Total amount of legitimate timing differences between book and bank that will self-resolve in subsequent periods (e.g., end-of-month transactions posted next business day).

attributes.name: total_variance_amount
attributes.description: The net difference between the three reconciliation legs. Calculated as (bank_statement_balance + outstanding_items) - book_balance. Zero indicates perfect reconciliation.

attributes.name: unresolved_exception_count
attributes.description: The number of reconciling items that remain unresolved as of the current date. Non-zero values require follow-up and escalation.

attributes.name: unresolved_variance_amount
attributes.description: Amount of variance that remains unexplained after all reconciling items have been identified and documented. Non-zero values require escalation and investigation.

attributes.name: variance_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explaining identified variances, root cause analysis, corrective actions taken, and resolution status. Required for regulatory examination audit trail.

products.name: reconciliation_item
products.description: Individual reconciling item identified during a three-way reconciliation that explains a variance between the trust ledger, client sub-ledger, or bank statement. Captures item type (outstanding cheque, deposit in transit, bank error, ledger error, timing difference), amount, originating transaction reference, expected clearance date, resolution status, and resolution date. Provides the audit trail required to clear reconciliation exceptions and satisfy regulatory examination.

attributes.name: reconciliation_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reconciliation item. Primary key for the reconciliation item entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trust bank account where this reconciliation item was identified. Links to the master trust account register.

attributes.name: ledger_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the correcting journal entry or ledger adjustment that resolved this reconciliation item. Null until adjustment is posted. Links to trust ledger entry for full audit trail.

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific legal matter associated with this reconciliation item. Enables matter-level trust fund tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: primary_reconciliation_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trust accounting staff member or attorney responsible for investigating and resolving this reconciliation item. Enables workload tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client whose funds are affected by this reconciliation item. Required for client sub-ledger reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules for Client Trust Account Management

attributes.name: three_way_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent three-way reconciliation process that identified this item. Links this item to the specific reconciliation run.

attributes.name: actual_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when this reconciliation item was actually resolved or cleared. Null until item status moves to resolved. Used for reconciliation cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: adjustment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation item requires a correcting journal entry or ledger adjustment. True for ledger errors; false for timing differences that will self-resolve.

attributes.name: aging_days
attributes.description: Number of days since this reconciliation item was first identified. Calculated as current date minus identified date. Used for aging reports and escalation of overdue items.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: Date of the bank statement on which this reconciliation item was identified. Links the item to a specific statement period for audit trail.

attributes.name: cheque_number
attributes.description: Cheque number for outstanding cheque reconciliation items. Enables tracking of uncleared cheques and matching with bank clearances.

attributes.name: client_notified_date
attributes.description: Date when the client was notified of this reconciliation item, if notification was required. Null if notification not required or not yet completed. Part of ethical compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this reconciliation item record was first created in the trust accounting system. Part of the audit trail for regulatory examination.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the variance amount. Required for multi-jurisdiction trust accounting.

attributes.name: deposit_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for deposits in transit. Links to deposit slip or wire transfer confirmation for clearance tracking.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the reconciliation item, including the nature of the discrepancy, root cause analysis, and any corrective actions required. Critical for audit trail and regulatory examination.
attributes.references: IOLTA Trust Accounting Rules, ABA Model Rules for Client Trust Account Management

attributes.name: expected_clearance_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when this reconciliation item is expected to clear or resolve. Used for aging reports and escalation triggers for overdue items.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when this reconciliation item was first identified during the three-way reconciliation process. Critical for aging analysis and regulatory compliance timelines.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reconciliation item. Tracks progression from identification through resolution and regulatory clearance.

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciling item that explains the variance between trust ledger, client sub-ledger, or bank statement. Determines the nature of the discrepancy and the required resolution action.
attributes.references: IOLTA Trust Accounting Rules, ABA Model Rules for Client Trust Account Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this reconciliation item record was last updated. Tracks all changes to status, resolution notes, and other fields for complete audit trail.

attributes.name: ledger_entry_date
attributes.description: Date of the corresponding trust ledger entry related to this reconciliation item. Used to calculate timing differences between ledger and bank.

attributes.name: originating_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the underlying trust transaction that caused this reconciliation item. May reference a cheque number, deposit slip, wire transfer ID, or ledger entry number.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Name of the payee for outstanding cheques or recipient of funds. Used for matching and clearance verification. Business-confidential client transaction data.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this reconciliation item based on materiality, aging, and regulatory risk. Critical items require immediate partner attention and may trigger regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_side
attributes.description: Indicates which side of the three-way reconciliation this item affects. Determines whether the variance is a bank-side or ledger-side adjustment.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when this reconciliation item was reported to the regulatory authority, if reporting was required. Null if not reportable or not yet reported. Critical for compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: IOLTA Trust Accounting Rules, State Bar Trust Account Rules

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable

attributes.name: requires_client_notification

attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, State Bar Trust Account Rules

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting how this reconciliation item was resolved, including actions taken, approvals obtained, and final disposition. Required for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when this reconciliation item was reviewed and approved by a supervisor. Part of the required dual-control audit trail for trust account management.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules for Client Trust Account Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System or source from which this reconciliation item originated. Identifies whether the discrepancy was detected in the trust ledger, client sub-ledger, or bank statement comparison.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discrepancy identified during reconciliation. Positive values indicate amounts on bank statement not yet in ledger; negative values indicate ledger entries not yet cleared by bank.

products.name: bank_statement
products.description: Imported or manually entered bank statement record for each trust account covering a defined statement period, including header-level summary and all constituent line items. Header captures financial institution name, account number, statement period start and end dates, opening balance, closing balance, total credits, total debits, statement source (electronic feed, PDF import, manual entry), and import timestamp. Line items (modeled as detail records within this product) capture transaction date, posting date, description, debit amount, credit amount, running bank balance, transaction reference number, and matching status to a trust_ledger_entry. Enables automated matching during reconciliation and identification of unmatched bank transactions requiring investigation. Serves as the external reference leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank statement record. Primary key for the bank statement entity.

attributes.name: regulatory_return_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_return. Business justification: Bank statement data (interest earned, average balances, transaction counts) feeds regulatory returns (IOLTA reports, client money reports). Source data relationship for regulatory reporting. Links sta

attributes.name: average_daily_balance
attributes.description: The average daily balance for the trust account during the statement period as calculated by the financial institution. Used for interest calculation verification.

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: The branch or office code of the financial institution where the trust account is held. May be used for multi-branch reconciliation.

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the end of the statement period as reported by the financial institution. This is the external reference balance for three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement. Typically USD for US-based IOLTA accounts.

attributes.name: discrepancy_amount
attributes.description: The net difference between the bank statement closing balance and the trust ledger balance at the end of the statement period. Zero indicates a balanced reconciliation.

attributes.name: financial_institution_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the bank or financial institution that issued this statement.

attributes.name: import_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement was imported or entered into the trust accounting system.

attributes.name: interest_earned
attributes.description: The total interest earned on the trust account during this statement period. Critical for IOLTA reporting and remittance to state bar foundations.

attributes.name: iolta_reporting_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts (IOLTA) Reporting Period
attributes.description: The IOLTA reporting period identifier (e.g., Q1-2024, 2024-01) to which this statement belongs. Used for regulatory reporting aggregation.

attributes.name: is_final_statement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final statement for a closed trust account. Used for account closure workflows and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state or jurisdiction code where this trust account is registered and regulated. Critical for jurisdiction-specific IOLTA compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the beginning of the statement period as reported by the financial institution.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this bank statement was successfully reconciled and approved. Null if reconciliation is not yet complete.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the three-way reconciliation process for this bank statement. Tracks whether the statement has been matched against trust ledger and client balances.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit ABA routing number for the financial institution. Used for electronic funds transfer and account identification.

attributes.name: service_charges
attributes.description: The total bank fees and service charges deducted during the statement period. Must be tracked separately for IOLTA compliance.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The official statement date as printed on the bank statement by the financial institution. Typically the same as the statement period end date.

attributes.name: statement_file_hash
attributes.description: The cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the original statement file. Ensures document integrity and detects tampering for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: statement_file_path
attributes.description: The storage location or document management system path where the original bank statement file is archived. Used for audit retrieval.

attributes.name: statement_format
attributes.description: The file format or data standard of the original statement document. Used for parsing and validation logic.

attributes.name: statement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this bank statement. May include reconciliation notes, exception explanations, or special instructions.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: The unique statement number or reference assigned by the financial institution for this statement period.

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date covered by this bank statement period.

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date covered by this bank statement period.

attributes.name: statement_source
attributes.description: The method by which this bank statement was imported or entered into the system. Indicates data provenance for audit purposes.

attributes.name: total_credit_count
attributes.description: The number of credit transactions posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_credits
attributes.description: The sum of all credit transactions (deposits, interest, reversals) posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debit_count
attributes.description: The number of debit transactions posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debits
attributes.description: The sum of all debit transactions (withdrawals, fees, disbursements) posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: unmatched_transaction_count
attributes.description: The number of bank statement line items that have not been matched to a corresponding trust ledger entry. Used to identify reconciliation exceptions.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this bank statement record. Required for audit trail and compliance.

products.name: bank_statement_line
products.description: Individual line item from an imported bank statement for a trust account. Captures transaction date, posting date, description, debit amount, credit amount, running bank balance, transaction reference number, and matching status to a trust_ledger_entry. Enables automated matching during reconciliation and identification of unmatched bank transactions that require investigation.

attributes.name: bank_statement_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank statement line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trust account to which this bank statement line belongs. Enables filtering and reconciliation by specific IOLTA or client trust account.
attributes.references: IOLTA Rules, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: bank_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent bank statement document from which this line was imported. Links to the bank_statement header entity.

attributes.name: duplicate_of_line_bank_statement_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original bank statement line if this line is marked as a duplicate. Null if not a duplicate. Supports duplicate resolution and audit trail.

attributes.name: matched_trust_ledger_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trust ledger entry that has been matched to this bank statement line during reconciliation. Null if unmatched or under review.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reconciliation period (typically monthly) during which this bank statement line was processed. Enables period-based reconciliation reporting and audit.

attributes.name: bank_transaction_code
attributes.description: The bank-specific transaction type code (e.g., CHK for check, DEP for deposit, FEE for bank fee, INT for interest). Used to classify transaction types during import.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number if this transaction represents a cleared check. Extracted from transaction description or provided as a separate field by the bank. Used to match against disbursement records.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The amount credited to the trust account for this transaction. Null if the transaction is a debit. Represents inflows such as client deposits, interest, or transfers in.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The amount debited from the trust account for this transaction. Null if the transaction is a credit. Represents outflows such as disbursements, fees, or transfers out.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the nature of the exception, investigation findings, and resolution actions. Supports audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: exception_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why this bank statement line is flagged as an exception or remains unmatched. Used for exception reporting and root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: amount_mismatch|date_mismatch|missing_ledger_entry|duplicate_bank_entry|unidentified_transaction|bank_error|timing_difference — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: import_batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch import process that loaded this bank statement line. Used for traceability, error investigation, and re-import scenarios.

attributes.name: import_source_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the source file (e.g., bank statement CSV, BAI2, or OFX file) from which this line was imported. Supports audit trail and source verification.

attributes.name: import_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement line was imported into the system. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting import issues.

attributes.name: is_duplicate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank statement line has been identified as a duplicate of another line (e.g., due to overlapping statement imports). Used to prevent double-counting in reconciliation.

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank statement line has been fully reconciled and approved as part of the three-way reconciliation process. True when reconciliation is complete and signed off.
attributes.references: Trust Accounting Standards, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank statement line has been voided (e.g., due to bank error correction or reversal). Voided lines are excluded from reconciliation totals.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement line record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this line within the parent bank statement. Used to preserve the original bank statement line order for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: matched_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement line was matched to a trust ledger entry. Used for reconciliation audit trail and performance metrics.

attributes.name: matching_confidence_score
attributes.description: Automated matching algorithm confidence score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the likelihood that the matched trust ledger entry is correct. Used to prioritize manual review of low-confidence matches.

attributes.name: matching_method
attributes.description: The method by which this bank statement line was matched to a trust ledger entry. Supports audit trail and matching algorithm performance analysis.

attributes.name: matching_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank statement line has been successfully matched to a trust ledger entry during reconciliation. Unmatched lines require investigation.
attributes.references: Trust Accounting Standards, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: payee_payor_name
attributes.description: The name of the party to or from whom the funds were transferred. Extracted from bank transaction description or provided as a structured field. Used in matching and audit trails.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank posted the transaction to the account ledger. Used for reconciliation timing differences and float analysis.

attributes.name: reconciled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement line was marked as reconciled. Used for compliance reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: running_balance
attributes.description: The cumulative account balance after this transaction as reported by the bank. Used as a control total during three-way reconciliation to verify that all transactions are captured.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this transaction. Typically matches the trust account base currency but may differ for foreign currency transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transaction occurred according to the bank. This is the business event date and may differ from the posting date.

attributes.name: transaction_description
attributes.description: The narrative description of the transaction as provided by the bank. Contains payee/payor information, check numbers, wire references, and other identifying details used in matching.

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference or confirmation number assigned by the bank to this transaction. Used for tracing and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: value_date

products.name: trust_control_test
products.description: This association product represents the testing event between trust_account and compliance_control. It captures the execution of a specific compliance control test against a specific trust account, recording test methodology, results, exceptions, and review evidence. Each record links one trust_account to one compliance_control with attributes that exist only in the context of this testing relationship.. Existence Justification: In legal practice, compliance controls are tested across multiple trust accounts as part of regulatory assurance programs (SOX, SRA, IOLTA compliance). Each control (e.g., three-way reconciliation, dual authorization, segregation of duties) is executed and tested against multiple trust accounts, and each trust account is subject to multiple controls. The business actively manages control testing as a distinct operational activity, recording test-specific evidence, results, exceptions, and remediation for each control-account combination.

attributes.description: Total amount of bank-initiated adjustments (fees, interest, corrections, NSF charges) identified during reconciliation that require corresponding trust ledger entries.

attributes.description: The statement date of the bank statement used for this reconciliation period. Typically matches the period end date but may differ if statements are received on non-standard cycles.

attributes.name: bank_statement_ending_balance
attributes.description: The ending balance reported on the bank statement for the trust account as of the statement date. First component of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: book_adjustments_total
attributes.description: Total amount of book-side adjustments (posting errors, reclassifications, corrections) identified during reconciliation that require trust ledger corrections.

attributes.name: client_ledger_total_balance
attributes.description: The sum of all individual client subsidiary ledger balances as of the period end date. Third component of the three-way reconciliation. Must equal bank and trust ledger balances when reconciled.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reconciliation period was formally closed and locked from further modifications.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the three-way reconciliation was completed and all discrepancies resolved. Nullable until reconciliation is finalized.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation period record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The regulatory or firm-mandated deadline by which the three-way reconciliation must be completed and approved. Typically 10-30 days after period end depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last date (inclusive) covered by this reconciliation period. Defines the end of the transaction window for three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month (1-12) to which this reconciliation period belongs, used for monthly reconciliation cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1-4) to which this reconciliation period belongs, used for quarterly regulatory reporting where required.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this reconciliation period belongs, used for annual reporting and compliance aggregation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this reconciliation period is currently active and available for selection in operational workflows. Inactive periods are retained for historical reference but not displayed in active dropdowns.

attributes.name: is_balanced
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the three-way reconciliation is balanced (all three components agree after adjustments). True when reconciliation_variance equals zero.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (state, province, or country code) whose trust account rules govern this reconciliation period. Critical for multi-jurisdiction firms with varying IOLTA requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation period record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting unusual circumstances, discrepancies investigated, adjustments made, or other relevant information about this reconciliation period. Used for audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reconciliation period was opened and made available for reconciliation work.

attributes.name: outstanding_checks_total
attributes.description: Total amount of checks or disbursements recorded in the trust ledger but not yet cleared the bank as of the reconciliation date. Reconciling item between book and bank balances.

attributes.name: outstanding_deposits_total
attributes.description: Total amount of deposits recorded in the trust ledger but not yet reflected on the bank statement as of the reconciliation date. Reconciling item between book and bank balances.

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the reconciliation period, typically formatted as YYYY-MM or YYYY-QN for monthly or quarterly periods.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the reconciliation period (e.g., 'January 2024', 'Q1 2024').

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation period frequency: monthly for standard monthly reconciliations, quarterly for jurisdictions requiring quarterly cycles, annual for year-end reconciliations, ad_hoc for unscheduled reconciliations triggered by events, or special for regulatory audits.

attributes.name: reconciliation_method
attributes.description: The reconciliation methodology applied: three_way (bank statement to trust ledger to client subsidiary ledgers - gold standard), bank_to_book (bank to trust ledger only), client_ledger_only (internal client ledger verification without bank statement).

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance
attributes.description: The net variance (if any) between the three reconciliation components after adjustments. Must be zero for a completed reconciliation. Non-zero values indicate unresolved discrepancies requiring investigation.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required regulatory trust account report was filed with the governing body. Nullable if no filing is required or if not yet filed.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: The confirmation or reference number assigned by the regulatory body upon submission of the trust account reconciliation report.

attributes.name: requires_regulatory_filing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this reconciliation period requires submission of a regulatory report to the state bar, IOLTA program, or other governing body. Typically true for annual or quarterly periods in certain jurisdictions.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first date (inclusive) covered by this reconciliation period. Defines the beginning of the transaction window for three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: trust_ledger_ending_balance
attributes.description: The ending balance in the firm's trust ledger (general ledger trust account) as of the period end date. Second component of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the partner, compliance officer, or authorized user who approved the reconciliation. Required for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: prepared_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the accounting staff member or trust accountant who prepared the reconciliation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reconciliation period: draft (period defined but not started), open (available for reconciliation entries), in_progress (reconciliation work underway), pending_review (awaiting partner or compliance review), completed (three-way reconciliation balanced and approved), closed (finalized and locked), archived (moved to long-term storage per retention policy).

products.name: knowledge_asset
products.description: Unified master catalog and registry of all knowledge assets managed within the knowledge domain, serving as the single entry point for cross-asset search, governance, analytics, and contribution tracking regardless of asset type. Each type-specific product (precedent, practice_note, clause, form_template, checklist, research_memo) holds a foreign key to this catalog. Captures asset type, source system (iManage, NetDocuments, Practical Law, LexisNexis), access classification (restricted/confidential/internal/public), LPP flag, retention schedule, lifecycle status, and full contribution workflow (contributor timekeeper reference, asset type submitted, submission date, reviewer assignment, review status, approval/rejection outcome, CPD/CLE credit eligibility, contribution history). Enables NLP-driven retrieval, knowledge contribution governance, and portfolio-level analytics.

products.name: asset_usage

Tracks timekeeper, matter reference, asset reference, usage type (view, download, adapt, cite, apply), timestamp, source system, relevance rating, and linking context. Enables usage analytics for knowledge asset curation prioritization, matter-level knowledge reuse tracking, post-matter knowledge harvesting, and ROI measurement of knowledge investments.

products.name: impact_assessment
products.description: This association product represents the impact assessment workflow between legal_update and practice_note. It captures the knowledge management process of evaluating and tracking how legislative, regulatory, and case law developments affect specific practice notes. Each record links one legal_update to one practice_note with workflow attributes that exist only in the context of this impact relationship, including review priority, status tracking, and action documentation.. Existence Justification: In legal knowledge management operations, a single legal update (statute amendment, new regulation, landmark judgment) routinely impacts multiple practice notes across different practice areas and jurisdictions, and conversely, a single practice note may require review and amendment in response to multiple legal developments over time. products.name: control_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the control relationship between knowledge assets and risk categories in the firm's integrated risk management and knowledge governance framework. It captures which knowledge assets (precedents, templates, checklists, practice notes) serve as controls or mitigations for specific risk categories (professional indemnity, data privacy, conflicts, AML). Each record links one knowledge asset to one risk category with attributes that document control effectiveness, deployment patterns, and compliance mapping required for ISO 27001, professional indemnity audits, and regulatory risk reporting.. Existence Justification: In legal risk management, a single knowledge asset (e.g., conflicts of interest checklist) serves as a control for multiple risk categories (conflict of interest risk, reputational risk, regulatory breach risk), and conversely, a single risk category (e.g., data breach risk) is mitigated by multiple knowledge assets (data processing agreement template, data retention checklist, breach response playbook, encryption policy). Risk managers actively maintain a control matrix mapping which assets control which risks, with effectiveness ratings, deployment patterns, and compliance references required for ISO 27001 certification and professional indemnity audits.

products.name: precedent_risk_mitigation
products.description: This association product represents the risk mitigation relationship between precedent documents and risk categories. It captures which precedent documents (templates, clauses, agreements) are designed to mitigate which specific risk categories, along with the effectiveness of that mitigation, clause coverage metrics, and usage tracking. Each record links one precedent to one risk category with attributes that exist only in the context of this mitigation relationship. This mapping is actively used in matter risk profiling workflows, precedent approval processes, and knowledge management governance to ensure precedents adequately address firm risk exposure.. Existence Justification: In legal services firms, precedent documents (templates, agreements, clauses) are explicitly designed to mitigate multiple risk categories (e.g., a SaaS agreement addresses IP infringement, data breach, and payment default risks), and each risk category is addressed by multiple precedents (e.g., data breach risk is mitigated by DPAs, SaaS agreements, and vendor contracts). Knowledge management teams actively maintain precedent-risk mappings with effectiveness ratings, clause coverage metrics, and usage tracking to support matter risk profiling and precedent approval workflows. This is an operational relationship managed as part of knowledge governance, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: authorized_representative_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the request is being made by an authorized representative on behalf of the data subject (e.g., parent, guardian, attorney, executor).

attributes.name: complaint_lodged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has lodged a formal complaint with the supervisory authority (ICO, CNIL, etc.) regarding the handling of their request.

attributes.name: complaint_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the complaint lodged with the supervisory authority, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_subject_address
attributes.description: Postal address of the data subject. Used for identity verification and postal correspondence.

attributes.name: data_subject_identifier
attributes.description: Internal firm identifier for the data subject (e.g., client ID, contact ID, employee ID) if the individual is known to the firm.

attributes.name: data_volume_pages
attributes.description: Total number of pages of personal data provided to the data subject in response to the request.

attributes.name: data_volume_records

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_flag

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for escalating the data subject request, such as legal complexity, high-profile client, or potential regulatory complaint.

attributes.name: exemption_applied
attributes.description: Legal exemption applied to withhold or redact certain data from the response, such as Legal Professional Privilege (LPP), third-party rights, or ongoing litigation.

attributes.name: extended_deadline_date
attributes.description: Extended deadline date if an extension has been granted. GDPR allows up to 2 additional months; CCPA allows up to 45 additional days.

attributes.name: extension_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm has applied for and communicated an extension to the statutory deadline due to complexity or volume.

attributes.name: extension_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided to the data subject for extending the statutory deadline, such as complexity or volume of requests.

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the data subject's identity was successfully verified.

attributes.name: identity_verification_method

attributes.name: identity_verification_status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this data subject request record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lpp_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Legal Professional Privilege exemption was applied to withhold privileged communications between lawyer and client.
attributes.references: DPA 2018 Schedule 2 Part 2, ICO Guidance on LPP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the handling of the data subject request, including internal communications, decisions, and special circumstances.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the data subject request after processing and response.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(4), ICO SAR Code of Practice

attributes.name: processing_time_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days taken to process and respond to the data subject request, from receipt to response.

attributes.name: receipt_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the data subject request was received by the firm.
attributes.references: ICO Guidance on SARs, GDPR Article 12

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the data subject request was received by the firm. Used to calculate statutory response deadline.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the data subject request was received, including time zone. Used for audit trail and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: refusal_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason for refusing the data subject request, if applicable. Must be communicated to the data subject with information about complaint rights.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction

attributes.name: representative_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative making the request on behalf of the data subject, if applicable.

attributes.name: representative_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the authorized representative to the data subject.

attributes.name: request_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-facing unique reference number provided to the data subject for tracking purposes. Format: DSR-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(6), ICO Guidance on SARs

attributes.name: request_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope of the data subject request, including specific data categories, time periods, or systems requested by the data subject.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 15, ICO SAR Code of Practice

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the data subject request in the DPO workflow. attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Type of data subject rights request under GDPR/CCPA/DPA. Subject Access Request (SAR) is the most common type.

attributes.name: response_date

attributes.name: response_method

attributes.name: third_party_data_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the request involves personal data of third parties that must be redacted or exempted from disclosure.

products.name: privacy_breach
products.description: Records of personal data breaches as defined under GDPR Article 4(12), including accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, or unauthorised disclosure of PII. Captures incident date, discovery date, breach type, affected data categories, number of data subjects impacted, risk assessment to data subjects, ICO/supervisory authority notification requirement flag, notification date, remediation actions, and post-incident review outcome. Owned by the DPO/compliance function.

attributes.description: Primary key for privacy_breach

attributes.name: attorney_profile_id

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the client matter associated with the breach, if the breach relates to client data processed in the context of a specific legal matter.

attributes.name: primary_data_privacy_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.data_privacy_register. Business justification: Privacy breaches occur in the context of specific processing activities. N:1 relationship (many breaches per processing activity). Strengthens connections for data_privacy_register. No columns to remo

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the client whose personal data was affected by the breach, if applicable.
