attributes.name: timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the compliance or IT staff member assigned as the incident owner responsible for coordinating the breach response.

attributes.name: affected_data_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured description of the categories of personal data affected by the breach (e.g., names, contact details, financial information, special category data under GDPR Article 9).

attributes.name: affected_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IT system, application, or platform from which the breach originated or which was compromised.

attributes.name: breach_cause
attributes.description: Root cause category of the breach incident. Used for trend analysis and preventive control design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_error|system_failure|malicious_attack|third_party_failure|physical_loss|unauthorised_access|misconfiguration — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: breach_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the nature of the breach, including circumstances, systems affected, and how the breach occurred.

attributes.name: breach_location
attributes.description: Physical or logical location where the breach occurred (e.g., office location, system name, third-party processor).

attributes.name: breach_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the breach incident in the firm's incident response workflow.

attributes.name: breach_type
attributes.description: Classification of the breach according to GDPR Article 4(12) categories: accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to, personal data.

attributes.name: containment_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach was successfully contained and no further data loss was occurring.

attributes.name: containment_measures_taken
attributes.description: Description of immediate actions taken to contain the breach and prevent further data loss or unauthorised access.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this breach incident record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: data_records_count
attributes.description: Approximate or exact number of personal data records affected by the breach. May differ from data subjects count if multiple records per subject exist.

attributes.name: data_subject_notification_date
attributes.description: Date and time when affected data subjects were notified of the breach. Required without undue delay under GDPR Article 34(1).

attributes.name: data_subject_notification_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify affected data subjects of the breach (e.g., direct email, postal mail, public communication if individual contact is disproportionate).

attributes.name: data_subject_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct notification to affected data subjects is required under GDPR Article 34. True if the breach is likely to result in high risk to data subjects.

attributes.name: data_subjects_count
attributes.description: Approximate or exact number of data subjects (individuals) whose personal data was affected by the breach. Required for regulatory notification under GDPR Article 33(3)(b).

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach was first discovered or became known to the firm. Critical for calculating the 72-hour notification window under GDPR.

attributes.name: discovery_method
attributes.description: How the breach was identified: through internal monitoring, external notification, audit, or other means.

attributes.name: dpo_notification_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the DPO was notified of the breach incident.

attributes.name: dpo_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm's Data Protection Officer (DPO) was notified of the breach. True if DPO was notified.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach incident occurred or is estimated to have occurred. This is the actual event timestamp, distinct from discovery or reporting dates.

attributes.name: incident_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to the breach incident for tracking and communication purposes. Used in regulatory notifications and internal reporting.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a claim was filed under the firm's professional indemnity or cyber insurance policy for costs related to the breach. True if claim was filed.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the insurance claim filed in relation to the breach incident, if applicable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this breach incident record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: post_incident_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-incident review or lessons-learned analysis has been completed. True if review is complete.

attributes.name: post_incident_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the post-incident review was completed and findings documented.

attributes.name: post_incident_review_outcome
attributes.description: Summary of findings, lessons learned, and recommendations from the post-incident review. Used to improve controls and prevent recurrence.

attributes.name: preventive_controls_implemented
attributes.description: Description of new or enhanced controls implemented as a result of the breach to prevent similar incidents in the future.

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty or fine imposed by the supervisory authority as a result of the breach, if any. Null if no penalty was imposed.

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the regulatory penalty amount (e.g., GBP, EUR, USD).

attributes.name: remediation_actions_taken
attributes.description: Description of measures taken or proposed to address the breach and mitigate its possible adverse effects, as required under GDPR Article 33(3)(d).

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date and time when all remediation actions were completed and the incident was fully resolved.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the risk assessment conclusion, including factors considered such as nature of data, likelihood of misuse, and potential consequences to data subjects.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_to_data_subjects
attributes.description: Assessment of the likely risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects as a result of the breach. Determines notification obligations under GDPR Article 34.

attributes.name: special_category_data_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the breach involved special categories of personal data as defined in GDPR Article 9 (racial/ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, health data, biometric data, etc.). True if special category data was affected.

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the supervisory authority to which the breach was notified (e.g., Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), CNIL, BfDI).

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_notification_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach was notified to the supervisory authority. Must be within 72 hours of discovery unless delay is justified under GDPR Article 33(1).

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether notification to the supervisory authority (ICO in UK, or relevant EU DPA) is required under GDPR Article 33. True if notification is mandatory.

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference or case number assigned by the supervisory authority upon receipt of the breach notification.

attributes.name: created_by_user_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this breach incident record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this breach incident record. Audit trail field.

products.name: regulatory_return
products.description: Regulatory returns, periodic filings, and breach notifications submitted to governing bodies such as the SRA, Legal Services Board, ABA, state bar associations, and financial regulators. Covers routine returns (SRA Annual Report, COFA certificate, accountants report) and event-triggered filings (regulatory breach notifications, remediation plans). Captures return/filing type, reporting period, submission details, regulatory body, preparer, reviewer, approval status, breach severity and root cause where applicable, and any regulatory findings or queries raised. Serves as the SSOT for all firm-level regulatory submissions and compliance incident reporting.

products.name: compliance_control_test
products.description: Records of individual control testing activities performed against compliance controls, including design effectiveness testing and operating effectiveness testing. Captures test date, tester, test methodology (walkthrough, sample testing, re-performance), sample size, exceptions identified, exception rate, overall test conclusion (effective/ineffective), remediation required flag, and linkage to the parent compliance control. Supports SOX, ISO 27001, and SRA compliance assurance programmes.

products.name: audit_scope
products.description: This association product represents the scoping relationship between audit engagements and regulatory obligations. It captures which specific regulatory obligations are included in the scope of each audit engagement, along with the compliance assessment results, findings, and test outcomes specific to that obligation within that audit. Each record links one audit engagement to one regulatory obligation with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit-obligation pairing.. Existence Justification: Audit engagements are explicitly scoped to cover multiple regulatory obligations, and each regulatory obligation is audited repeatedly across multiple audit engagements over time. Audit teams actively manage the scoping process during audit planning, defining which obligations are in-scope for each engagement. The relationship carries significant operational data including compliance assessment results, findings counts, test results, and risk ratings that are specific to each obligation-engagement pairing.

products.name: policy_acknowledgement
products.description: This association product represents the formal acknowledgement event between client_profile and policy. It captures the regulatory requirement for clients to acknowledge and accept specific compliance policies as part of the client onboarding and ongoing compliance management process. Each record links one client to one policy version with the date acknowledged, acceptance status, attestation method, and next renewal date. This is a critical audit trail for regulatory compliance and risk management.. Existence Justification: Legal services firms are required by regulators to obtain and track client acknowledgement of multiple compliance policies (AML, conflicts of interest, data protection, engagement terms, etc.). Each client must acknowledge multiple policies, and each policy must be acknowledged by multiple clients. The business actively manages this relationship through onboarding workflows, renewal cycles, and audit trail maintenance for regulatory examinations.

attributes.description: The unique registration or license number issued by the bar association or regulatory authority upon admission. This is the externally-known identifier for the attorney in that jurisdiction.

attributes.name: cle_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attorney is in compliance with the CLE or CPD requirements for this jurisdiction. Compliant indicates all requirements are met; non-compliant indicates requirements are not met; pending verification indicates CLE credits are submitted but not yet verified; exempt indicates the attorney is exempt from CLE requirements.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) CLE Compliance Standards

attributes.name: cle_hours_completed_current_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Completed Current Period
attributes.description: The number of CLE or CPD hours the attorney has completed in the current reporting period for this jurisdiction. Used to track compliance with mandatory continuing education requirements.

attributes.name: cle_hours_required_annual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Required Annual
attributes.description: The number of Continuing Legal Education (CLE) or Continuing Professional Development (CPD) hours required annually by this jurisdiction to maintain the bar admission in good standing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bar admission record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_count
attributes.description: The total number of formal disciplinary actions taken against this attorney by the bar association in this jurisdiction over the lifetime of the admission. Used for risk assessment and matter staffing decisions.

attributes.name: disciplinary_standing
attributes.description: The current disciplinary status of the attorney with the bar association. Good standing indicates no disciplinary issues; under investigation indicates an active disciplinary inquiry; probation indicates the attorney is under disciplinary probation; suspended indicates temporary disciplinary suspension; disbarred indicates permanent revocation of the license to practice.

attributes.name: eligibility_for_matter_staffing_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this bar admission qualifies the attorney to be staffed on matters in this jurisdiction. True indicates the attorney is eligible (active status, good standing, no practice restrictions); False indicates the attorney is not eligible due to inactive status, disciplinary issues, or practice restrictions. Critical for conflict checking and resource allocation.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the annual fee amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD).

attributes.name: fee_payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of the annual bar membership fee. Current indicates fees are paid and up to date; overdue indicates fees are past due; waived indicates fees have been waived by the bar association; exempt indicates the attorney is exempt from fees (e.g., retired status, pro bono service).

attributes.name: governing_bar_association
attributes.description: The name of the bar association or regulatory authority that governs this bar admission and enforces professional conduct rules (e.g., State Bar of California, New York State Bar Association, Solicitors Regulation Authority, Law Society of England and Wales).

attributes.name: last_disciplinary_action_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal disciplinary action taken against this attorney by the bar association in this jurisdiction. Null if no disciplinary actions have been taken.

attributes.name: last_fee_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent bar membership fee payment was received and processed by the bar association.

attributes.name: malpractice_insurance_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attorney is in compliance with professional liability insurance requirements for this jurisdiction. Compliant indicates insurance is current; non-compliant indicates insurance is lapsed or insufficient; exempt indicates the attorney is exempt from the requirement; not required indicates the jurisdiction does not mandate insurance.

attributes.name: malpractice_insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this jurisdiction requires attorneys to maintain professional liability (malpractice) insurance as a condition of bar membership. True indicates insurance is required; False indicates it is not required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this bar admission. May include details about conditional admissions, pending appeals, special accommodations, or historical context.

attributes.name: practice_restriction_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any practice restrictions or limitations associated with this bar admission. Examples include limited to corporate in-house counsel, limited to federal practice, limited to specific counties, or subject to supervision requirements.

attributes.name: practice_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this bar admission has any practice restrictions or limitations imposed by the bar association (e.g., limited to in-house counsel work, limited to specific practice areas, geographic restrictions). True indicates restrictions exist; False indicates no restrictions.

attributes.name: pro_hac_vice_expiration_date
attributes.description: For pro hac vice admissions, the date on which the temporary admission expires. Typically tied to the conclusion of the specific matter. Null for permanent bar admissions.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 11

attributes.name: reciprocity_source_jurisdiction
attributes.description: For admissions granted by reciprocity or motion, the name of the jurisdiction whose bar membership served as the basis for admission without examination. Null for admissions by examination.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the bar admission must be renewed to maintain active status. Most jurisdictions require annual or biennial renewal with payment of fees and completion of Continuing Legal Education (CLE) requirements.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency with which this bar admission must be renewed. Annual indicates yearly renewal; biennial indicates every two years; triennial indicates every three years; not required indicates jurisdictions with no periodic renewal requirement.

attributes.name: status_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current admission status became effective. Used to track when status changes occurred (e.g., when a suspension began, when an attorney went inactive).

attributes.name: trust_account_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this jurisdiction requires attorneys to certify compliance with Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts (IOLTA) or client trust account rules as part of bar membership. True indicates certification is required; False indicates it is not required.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules on Client Trust Accounts

attributes.name: trust_account_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attorney is in compliance with IOLTA or client trust account certification requirements for this jurisdiction. Compliant indicates certification is current; non-compliant indicates certification is missing or deficient; exempt indicates the attorney is exempt; not applicable indicates the attorney does not handle client funds.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules on Client Trust Accounts

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bar admission record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bar admission status and details were last verified with the governing bar association. Used to ensure data accuracy and compliance with regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the bar admission status and details. Manual lookup indicates direct verification with the bar association website or records; API integration indicates automated verification via bar association API; attorney self-certification indicates the attorney provided the information; third party service indicates verification through a legal credentialing service.

attributes.name: years_practice_at_admission
attributes.description: The number of years the attorney had been practicing law at the time of admission to this jurisdiction. Used for admissions by motion or reciprocity where prior practice experience is a requirement.

attributes.name: bar_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the attorney or legal professional who holds this bar admission. Links to the timekeeper master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, AUS). Used for international bar admission tracking and cross-border practice analysis.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: The name of the jurisdiction where the bar admission is held (e.g., State of California, New York State, England and Wales, Federal District Court Southern District of New York).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: The category of jurisdiction for this bar admission. Distinguishes between state-level bar associations, federal court admissions, international bars, territorial bars, and tribal court systems.

products.name: cle_requirement
products.description: Defines the CPD/CLE compliance requirements applicable to each attorney by jurisdiction and reporting period. Stores jurisdiction, reporting cycle start and end dates, total hours required, ethics hours required, technology CLE hours required, pro bono hours credit allowed, carry-over rules, and compliance deadline. Enables the firm to track each attorneys obligations across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously. Sourced from state bar and SRA regulatory mandates.

attributes.name: cle_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CLE/CPD requirement record. Primary key for the cle_requirement data product in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the attorney or timekeeper to whom this CLE/CPD requirement applies. Links to the workforce attorney master record in SAP SuccessFactors.

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — CLE requirements are tracked per attorney per jurisdiction. The link to timekeeper identifies which attorney must fulfill which requirement.

attributes.name: accredited_provider_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction requires CLE/CPD hours to be earned exclusively from accredited providers. When True, only courses from approved providers count toward the requirement.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: bias_inclusion_hours_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bias and Inclusion Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Required
attributes.description: The minimum number of CLE/CPD hours that must be earned in implicit bias, diversity, equity, and inclusion topics as mandated by certain jurisdictions (e.g., California, New York).
attributes.references: State Bar Associations (CA, NY); ABA Resolution 109

attributes.name: carryover_expiry_months
attributes.description: The number of months after the end of the current reporting period within which carried-over CLE/CPD hours must be applied before they expire. Null if the jurisdiction does not impose a carry-over expiry.

attributes.name: carryover_hours_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of excess CLE/CPD hours earned in the current reporting period that may be carried forward and credited toward the next reporting period, as permitted by the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: compliance_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which the attorney must certify completion of all required CLE/CPD hours to the licensing jurisdiction. May differ from period_end_date where a grace period is granted.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the attorney against this CLE/CPD requirement for the reporting period. Drives firm-wide compliance dashboards and escalation workflows. [MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS]
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction governing this CLE/CPD requirement (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR'). Supports multi-national firm reporting and GDPR/DPA compliance scoping.

attributes.name: cpd_scheme_name
attributes.description: Name of the CPD/CLE scheme or programme under which this requirement is administered (e.g., 'SRA CPD Scheme', 'New York Continuing Legal Education Program'). Relevant for multi-jurisdictional firms operating under different CPD frameworks.
attributes.references: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); State Bar Associations; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: The recurrence pattern of the CLE/CPD reporting cycle as mandated by the jurisdiction. Drives automated generation of future requirement records.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this version of the CLE/CPD requirement definition became effective. Supports versioning and historical audit of regulatory rule changes. [MASTER_RESOURCE EFFECTIVE_FROM]
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: ethics_hours_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ethics Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Required
attributes.description: The minimum number of CLE/CPD hours that must be earned in legal ethics, professional responsibility, or professionalism topics as mandated by the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: exemption_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attorney may be eligible for a full or partial exemption from CLE/CPD requirements for this period (e.g., inactive status, judicial appointment, hardship). Triggers a review workflow.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: The category of exemption applied to this CLE/CPD requirement record when exemption_eligible_flag is True. Null or 'none' when no exemption applies.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the licensing jurisdiction (state bar, SRA, or other regulatory body) that mandates this CLE/CPD requirement. Examples: CA, NY, TX, ENGLAND_WALES. An attorney admitted in multiple jurisdictions will have one record per jurisdiction per reporting period.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the licensing jurisdiction that mandates this CLE/CPD requirement (e.g., 'State Bar of California', 'Solicitors Regulation Authority – England and Wales'). Complements jurisdiction_code for reporting and display purposes.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: late_filing_penalty_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the penalty or consequence imposed by the jurisdiction for failure to certify CLE/CPD compliance by the compliance_deadline_date (e.g., 'Administrative suspension', '$100 late fee'). Supports risk management and attorney communications.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: new_attorney_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement record reflects a newly-admitted attorney (bridge-the-gap or transition) CLE/CPD requirement, which typically differs in hours and subject matter from the standard requirement.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, special conditions, or jurisdiction-specific nuances associated with this CLE/CPD requirement that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., transitional provisions, grandfathering clauses).
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: online_hours_cap
attributes.business_glossary_term: Online / Self-Study Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Cap
attributes.description: The maximum number of CLE/CPD hours that may be earned through online, on-demand, or self-study formats within the reporting period, as restricted by the jurisdiction. Null if no cap applies.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the CLE/CPD compliance reporting cycle for this jurisdiction and attorney. Hours earned after this date count toward the next cycle.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the CLE/CPD compliance reporting cycle for this jurisdiction and attorney. Defines the window within which qualifying hours must be earned.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: practice_area_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies any practice-area-specific CLE/CPD sub-requirements mandated by the jurisdiction (e.g., 'Tax practitioners must complete 3 hours of tax law update'). Null if no practice-area restriction applies.

attributes.name: pro_bono_credit_hours_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of CLE/CPD credit hours that may be satisfied through qualifying pro bono legal service activities in lieu of formal coursework, as permitted by the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CLE/CPD requirement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. [MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED]

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CLE/CPD requirement record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_body_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific regulatory or licensing body that issued this CLE/CPD mandate (e.g., 'ABA', 'SRA', 'CALBAR', 'NYSBA'). Enables multi-jurisdictional reporting and regulatory body-level analytics.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); State Bar Associations; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: regulatory_body_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regulatory or licensing body that issued this CLE/CPD mandate (e.g., 'State Bar of California', 'Solicitors Regulation Authority'). Complements regulatory_body_code for display and reporting.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); State Bar Associations

attributes.name: reporting_period_label
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the CLE/CPD compliance reporting cycle (e.g., '2024–2025 Biennial', 'FY2024 Annual'). Used for display in dashboards and compliance reports.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: requirement_source_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the official regulatory body publication or rule document that defines this CLE/CPD requirement. Provides an audit trail back to the authoritative source.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: requirement_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this CLE/CPD requirement definition, reflecting updates issued by the regulatory body (e.g., '2024.1'). Enables tracking of rule changes over time and audit of which version governed a given period.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: self_study_subject_restriction
attributes.description: Describes any subject-matter restrictions on self-study or on-demand CLE/CPD hours imposed by the jurisdiction (e.g., ethics hours may not be earned via self-study in some jurisdictions). Null if no restriction applies.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of this CLE/CPD requirement record as it exists in the originating system of record (SAP SuccessFactors Learning). Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system.

attributes.name: substance_abuse_hours_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Substance Abuse / Mental Health Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Required
attributes.description: The minimum number of CLE/CPD hours that must be earned in attorney wellness, substance abuse, or mental health topics as mandated by certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; ABA National Task Force on Lawyer Well-Being

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this version of the CLE/CPD requirement was superseded by a newer version. Null if this is the current active version. [MASTER_RESOURCE EFFECTIVE_UNTIL]
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: technology_hours_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Technology Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Required
attributes.description: The minimum number of CLE/CPD hours that must be earned in legal technology topics (e.g., cybersecurity, AI in law, eDiscovery) as mandated by the jurisdiction. Reflects ABA Comment 8 to Rule 1.1 on technological competence.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1 Comment 8; State Bar Associations

attributes.name: total_hours_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Hours Required
attributes.description: The total number of CLE/CPD credit hours the attorney must complete within the reporting period as mandated by the jurisdiction. Includes all sub-category requirements.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); ABA Model Rules for Minimum Continuing Legal Education

attributes.name: cle_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — CLE requirements are tracked per attorney per jurisdiction. The requirement must link to the timekeeper to determine individual compliance status.

products.name: cle_completion
products.description: Transactional record of each CPD/CLE course or activity completed by an attorney. Captures course title, provider, delivery format (in-person, webinar, self-study), completion date, credit hours earned, ethics credit flag, technology credit flag, accreditation status, certificate number, and the reporting period to which the credit applies. Supports compliance reporting to state bars, SRA, and IBA. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Learning module.

attributes.name: cle_completion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CLE/CPD completion record in the Silver layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: knowledge_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to knowledge.knowledge_asset. Business justification: Internal CLE courses (webinars, training sessions, practice notes) are knowledge assets. Linking enables CPD credit allocation, knowledge reuse metrics, and compliance reporting for jurisdictions requ

attributes.name: learning_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the course or learning item catalogue record in SAP SuccessFactors Learning. Enables linkage to the course master for provider, accreditation body, and curriculum metadata.

attributes.name: primary_cle_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.cle_requirement. Business justification: CLE completions should link to the specific requirement record they satisfy. This enables tracking compliance against jurisdiction-specific CPD/CLE requirements. The cle_completion table currently has

attributes.name: to_cle_requirement_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.cle_requirement.cle_requirement_id — Each completion record satisfies credits toward a specific CLE requirement (jurisdiction + reporting period). This link enables compliance gap analysis.

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each CLE completion event is performed by a specific attorney/timekeeper. Required for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: accreditation_number
attributes.description: Unique accreditation or approval number assigned to this course by the accrediting bar association or regulatory body. Required for bar compliance submissions and audit verification.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Accreditation status of the course or activity as determined by the relevant bar association or regulatory body. Only accredited completions count toward mandatory CLE/CPD requirements. 'pending' indicates the firm has applied for accreditation but approval has not yet been received.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Accreditation Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: accrediting_body
attributes.description: Name of the bar association, regulatory body, or professional organisation that accredited this CLE/CPD activity (e.g., 'New York State CLE Board', 'State Bar of California', 'Solicitors Regulation Authority', 'International Bar Association'). A single completion may be accredited by multiple bodies; this field captures the primary accrediting body.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Accreditation Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: achieved_score
attributes.description: The actual score (as a percentage) achieved by the timekeeper on the course assessment. Null if no assessment is required. Used to validate completion eligibility and track learning effectiveness.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; State Bar Association CLE Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: bar_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or acknowledgement number returned by the bar association or regulatory body upon successful receipt of the CLE/CPD completion report. Provides audit evidence that the credit has been officially recorded by the regulator.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or completion reference number issued by the course provider to the individual timekeeper upon successful completion. Used for audit evidence and bar compliance verification.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the attorney or professional staff member completed the CLE/CPD course or activity. This is the principal real-world event date used for bar compliance reporting and CPD cycle calculations. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) CPD Requirements; International Bar Association (IBA) CPD Policy

attributes.name: completion_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this completion record, typically generated by SAP SuccessFactors Learning or the accrediting body. Used for audit trails, bar reporting submissions, and certificate cross-referencing. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CLE/CPD completion record within the learning management workflow. 'completed' indicates credit is earned and reportable; 'pending_approval' indicates awaiting accreditation body or firm administrator sign-off. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1; Law Society CPD Regulations

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred by the firm for this CLE/CPD completion, including registration fees, materials, and any associated expenses. Used for workforce development budget tracking and cost-per-credit analytics. Expressed in the firm's base currency.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost amount (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Required for multi-currency firms operating across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the CLE/CPD course content area as defined by the accrediting body or firm taxonomy. Used for workforce development analytics, skills gap analysis, and compliance sub-category tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: substantive_law|ethics_professionalism|skills|practice_management|technology|diversity_equity_inclusion|wellbeing — promote to reference product if additional categories are required]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1; State Bar Association CLE Category Standards; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: course_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total instructional duration of the CLE/CPD course in minutes as recorded by the provider. Used to validate credit hour claims (typically 60 minutes = 1.0 credit hour) and detect discrepancies between claimed and actual seat time.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Credit Hour Calculation Rules; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: course_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CLE/CPD course or activity commenced. For multi-day programmes, this is the first day of instruction. Distinct from completion_date; used to calculate course duration and validate credit hour claims.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: Full title of the CLE/CPD course or activity as provided by the course provider or accrediting body. Used for compliance reporting submissions to state bars, SRA, and IBA, and for knowledge management analytics.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CLE completion record was first captured in SAP SuccessFactors Learning or ingested into the Silver layer. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Total number of Continuing Legal Education (CLE) or Continuing Professional Development (CPD) credit hours earned by the timekeeper for this completion. Expressed in decimal hours (e.g., 1.50 = 90 minutes). Used to calculate compliance against annual or biennial bar requirements.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: delivery_format
attributes.description: Method by which the CLE/CPD activity was delivered to the participant. Some jurisdictions impose caps on self-study or on-demand credits; this field enables compliance validation against those rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_person|webinar|self_study|on_demand|blended|podcast — promote to reference product if additional formats are required]
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1

attributes.name: diversity_equity_inclusion_credit_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) CLE Credit Hours
attributes.description: Subset of total credit hours that qualify as diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) credits. A growing number of state bars (e.g., California, New York) mandate DEI-focused CLE credits per reporting period. Enables compliance tracking against DEI credit sub-requirements.
attributes.references: State Bar Association DEI CLE Requirements; California State Bar Rule 2.72; New York CLE Board Rules

attributes.name: ethics_credit_hours
attributes.description: Subset of total credit hours that qualify as ethics or professional responsibility credits. Most state bars and the SRA mandate a minimum number of ethics credits per reporting period; this field enables compliance tracking against those sub-requirements.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Ethics Credit Requirements; SRA CPD Requirements; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: is_diversity_equity_inclusion_credit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) Credit Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any portion of this CLE/CPD activity qualifies as a diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) credit. Enables rapid filtering for DEI credit compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State Bar Association DEI CLE Requirements; California State Bar Rule 2.72

attributes.name: is_ethics_credit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any portion of this CLE/CPD activity qualifies as ethics or professional responsibility credit. Provides a quick filter for ethics compliance dashboards without requiring a numeric threshold check.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Ethics Credit Requirements; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: is_firm_sponsored
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the firm paid for or sponsored this CLE/CPD activity. False indicates the attorney self-funded the course. Used for workforce development budget reporting and reimbursement processing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this CLE/CPD activity was designated as mandatory by the firm, practice group, or regulatory body (as opposed to elective). Used to distinguish required training completions from voluntary professional development in compliance and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: is_pro_bono_credit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this activity qualifies for pro bono CLE credit. Some jurisdictions (e.g., New York) allow attorneys to earn CLE credit for qualifying pro bono legal services. Enables compliance tracking for pro bono credit sub-requirements.
attributes.references: New York CLE Board Rules; State Bar Association Pro Bono CLE Credit Policies

attributes.name: is_technology_credit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any portion of this CLE/CPD activity qualifies as a technology competency credit. Enables rapid filtering for technology credit compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State Bar Association Technology CLE Requirements; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1 Comment 8

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City where the in-person CLE/CPD event was held. Applicable for in-person and blended delivery formats. Used for travel expense reconciliation and geographic analytics on CLE attendance patterns.

attributes.name: location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the in-person CLE/CPD event was held (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'AUS'). Used for international compliance reporting and travel analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, exceptions, or administrative remarks related to this CLE/CPD completion record (e.g., reasons for a conditional accreditation status, details of a credit hour adjustment, or notes from the bar reporting submission). Populated by firm administrators or the learning management system.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: pass_score
attributes.description: The minimum passing score threshold (as a percentage) required by the course provider or accrediting body for this CLE/CPD activity. Applicable for courses with a formal assessment component. Null if no assessment is required.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; State Bar Association CLE Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: practice_area
attributes.description: Legal practice area or subject matter covered by the CLE/CPD course (e.g., 'Corporate M&A', 'Intellectual Property', 'Employment Law', 'Litigation', 'Regulatory Compliance'). Enables analytics on attorney skill development aligned to firm practice group strategy.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1

attributes.name: provider_code
attributes.description: Accreditation or registration code assigned to the course provider by the relevant bar association or regulatory body (e.g., MCLE provider number issued by a state bar). Required for automated compliance submissions.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the organisation or institution that delivered the CLE/CPD course or activity (e.g., PLI, ALI CLE, Law Society, IBA). Used to verify accreditation status and track preferred provider relationships.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: reported_to_bar_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CLE/CPD completion was formally reported to the relevant bar association or regulatory body. Null if not yet reported. Used to track submission status and ensure timely compliance filings.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The bar association jurisdiction or regulatory body to which this completion is being reported (e.g., 'NY', 'CA', 'TX', 'SRA-England-Wales', 'IBA'). An attorney admitted in multiple jurisdictions may have the same completion reported to several bodies; this field identifies the primary reporting jurisdiction for this record.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The compliance reporting period to which this CLE/CPD credit applies, expressed as a calendar year (e.g., '2024') or biennial period (e.g., '2023-2024') depending on the jurisdiction's cycle. Credits must be allocated to the correct reporting period for bar compliance submissions.
attributes.references: State Bar Association CLE Reporting Standards; SRA CPD Requirements; IBA CPD Policy

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors Learning completion ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation, re-processing, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or ingestion channel for this CLE completion record. 'SAP_SuccessFactors' is the primary system of record; 'manual_entry' indicates a firm administrator entered the record directly; 'provider_feed' indicates an automated data feed from the course provider; 'bar_portal' indicates import from a bar association reporting portal.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: technology_credit_hours
attributes.description: Subset of total credit hours that qualify as technology competency credits. Several state bars (e.g., Florida, North Carolina) require attorneys to complete technology-focused CLE credits per reporting period. Enables compliance tracking against technology credit sub-requirements.
attributes.references: State Bar Association Technology CLE Requirements; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1 Comment 8

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CLE completion record was last modified in the source system or Silver layer. Tracks corrections, status changes, and credit hour adjustments. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: cle_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the attorney, paralegal, or professional staff member who completed the CLE/CPD activity. Links to the workforce timekeeper master record. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1

products.name: billing_rate
products.description: Master rate schedule defining the standard, negotiated, and matter-specific billing rates for each timekeeper by effective date range. Stores rate type (standard, client-negotiated, AFA blended, matter-specific), currency, hourly rate amount, LEDES rate code, rate approval status, and the approving partner. Supports LEDES billing exports and AFA arrangements. This is the SSOT for timekeeper rate data consumed by the billing domain. Sourced from Aderant Expert Rate Management module.
products.reference: LEDES Rate Schedule / Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: billing_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each billing rate record in the master rate schedule. Primary key for the billing_rate data product.

attributes.name: billing_approving_partner_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equity or billing partner who approved this rate. Required for rate governance and audit trail per firm billing policy.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: billing_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or staff) for whom this billing rate applies. Links to the workforce timekeeper master record.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Practice Management

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific matter for which a matter-specific billing rate applies. Null for standard or client-level rates not scoped to a single matter.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Client/Matter Management

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.practice_group. Business justification: Billing rates are often defined and managed by practice group. The billing_rate table currently has practice_group_code (STRING) but no FK to the practice_group master table. This normalization remove

attributes.name: prior_rate_billing_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding billing rate record that this version supersedes. Enables traversal of the rate version chain for historical billing analysis and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client for whom a client-negotiated or matter-specific rate applies. Null for standard rack rates not tied to a specific client.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Client/Matter Management

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Billing rates are set per timekeeper. This is the critical link enabling the billing domain to resolve rates for time entries.

attributes.name: afa_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) when rate_type is 'afa_blended'. Drives billing logic, WIP recognition, and revenue forecasting for non-hourly engagements.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Rate Management Module

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the approving partner formally approved this billing rate in the system. Distinct from rate_approval_date (day-level) — provides exact time for audit and workflow tracking.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which invoices are generated under this rate arrangement. Relevant for retainer, fixed-fee, and subscription AFA structures. Drives prebill scheduling in Aderant Expert.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Billing

attributes.name: billing_guideline_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the client billing guidelines document that governs this rate (e.g., Outside Counsel Guidelines reference number). Ensures rate compliance with client-mandated billing rules and supports LEDES export validation.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; LEDES 1998B Standard; ACC (Association of Corporate Counsel) Outside Counsel Guidelines

attributes.name: client_agreed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client formally agreed to or acknowledged this billing rate, typically documented in the Letter of Engagement (LOE) or rate agreement letter. Supports billing dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing rate record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for the rate record lifecycle.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the hourly rate amount is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the standard rack rate to derive this negotiated rate. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 = 10%). Used for rate analytics, profitability reporting, and RPE (Revenue Per Equity Partner) calculations.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Billing

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this billing rate becomes effective and may be applied to time entries. Defines the start of the rate's validity window for billing and WIP (Work in Progress) calculations.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing rate expires and is no longer applicable to new time entries. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no scheduled expiry. Supports rate versioning and historical rate lookups.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: hourly_rate_amount
attributes.description: The standard hourly billing rate amount for this timekeeper under this rate record. Represents the principal monetary value of the rate schedule entry. For AFA blended rates, this reflects the blended equivalent hourly rate.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: is_client_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has formally approved or acknowledged this billing rate. True = client has confirmed acceptance; False = rate is pending client acknowledgement. Critical for billing dispute prevention.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: is_default_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is the default billing rate applied to the timekeeper when no client-specific or matter-specific rate exists. True = default fallback rate; False = targeted rate for specific client or matter.

attributes.name: is_pro_bono
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate record applies to pro bono matters. True = pro bono rate (typically zero or nominal); False = commercial rate. Supports pro bono reporting and ABA pro bono commitment tracking.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1 (Pro Bono Publico Service); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/jurisdiction code indicating the legal jurisdiction in which this rate applies. Rates may vary by jurisdiction due to local bar regulations, market conditions, and currency.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; State Bar Associations; Law Society of England and Wales; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this billing rate record. Supports change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: ledes_rate_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Rate Code
attributes.description: The LEDES-compliant rate code assigned to this billing rate for inclusion in LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML electronic billing exports submitted to clients and legal bill review vendors.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard) 1998B; LEDES XML 2.1

attributes.name: matter_phase_code
attributes.description: UTBMS or firm-defined phase code indicating the matter phase to which this rate applies (e.g., discovery, trial, closing). Enables phase-specific rate differentiation under phased AFA or fixed-fee arrangements.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); Aderant Expert Rate Management Module

attributes.name: rate_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approving partner formally approved this billing rate. Required for rate governance, audit trail, and compliance with firm billing policy.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: The fee basis under which this rate is structured. Hourly = time-and-rate billing; fixed_fee = flat fee per matter or phase; contingency = percentage of recovery; retainer = periodic fixed payment; capped = hourly with a maximum ceiling; blended = single rate across multiple timekeepers under an AFA.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Rate Management Module

attributes.name: rate_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum hourly rate ceiling agreed with the client, applicable when rate_basis is 'capped'. Billing above this amount requires explicit client approval. Supports AFA and capped-fee arrangement management.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying this rate record within Aderant Expert Rate Management. Used as the business-facing identifier for rate lookups and LEDES billing exports.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: rate_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about this billing rate, such as negotiation history, special conditions, client-specific restrictions, or approval commentary. Sourced from Aderant Expert rate record comments.

attributes.name: rate_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this billing rate. Supports proactive rate management, annual rate increase cycles, and client relationship management.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Practice Management

attributes.name: rate_schedule_name
attributes.description: The name of the rate schedule or rate card to which this rate belongs (e.g., 'Standard 2024', 'Acme Corp Preferred Rates', 'EMEA Litigation Schedule'). Supports grouping of rates for bulk management and client reporting.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing rate record. Active = currently in use; pending_approval = submitted for partner/management approval; approved = approved but not yet effective; superseded = replaced by a newer rate version; expired = past effective_to_date; rejected = approval denied.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing rate indicating its scope and negotiation basis. Standard = rack rate; client_negotiated = agreed rate for a client; matter_specific = scoped to one matter; afa_blended = blended rate under an Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA); volume_discount = tiered discount rate; pro_bono = zero or reduced rate for pro bono matters.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: rate_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this rate record, incremented each time the rate is revised for the same timekeeper, client, or matter combination. Supports rate history tracking and audit.

attributes.name: source_system_rate_code
attributes.description: The native rate record identifier from the Aderant Expert Rate Management source system. Preserved for lineage tracing, reconciliation, and cross-system audits between Aderant Expert and Elite 3E.

attributes.name: standard_rate_amount
attributes.description: The published standard (rack) hourly rate for this timekeeper before any client or matter-specific discounts are applied. Stored alongside the negotiated rate to enable discount analysis and realisation reporting.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Billing

attributes.name: timekeeper_class
attributes.description: Professional classification of the timekeeper to which this rate applies, reflecting seniority and role tier used in rate scheduling and UTBMS task-based billing.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS task code associated with this rate, enabling task-based billing categorisation for client billing guidelines and legal spend analytics. Aligns with ABA/ACCA UTBMS code sets (L-series for litigation, B-series for business).
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); ABA; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: wip_recognition_method
attributes.description: Specifies how Work in Progress (WIP) is recognised for this rate type. time_and_rate = standard hourly WIP accrual; fixed_fee_milestone = WIP recognised at milestone completion; contingent = WIP held until contingency event; deferred = WIP deferred per agreement terms.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E GL; FASB ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition)

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or jurisdiction to which this rate applies. Rates may differ by office location due to market conditions and local bar requirements.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management Module; Elite 3E Practice Management

products.name: practice_group
products.description: Organizational unit representing a legal practice group or department within the firm (e.g., M&A, Litigation, IP, Employment, Regulatory). Stores practice group name, group code, managing partner, practice area classification (aligned to UTBMS task codes), office or region scope, revenue target, headcount budget, approved FTE count, and active status. Serves as the primary organizational hierarchy for matter staffing, financial reporting by practice, resource allocation, and recruitment planning. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors organizational structure.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the practice group record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key sourced from SAP SuccessFactors organizational unit identifier.

attributes.name: parent_group_practice_group_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent practice group in the organizational hierarchy, enabling multi-level group structures (e.g., 'Disputes' as parent of 'Commercial Litigation' and 'International Arbitration'). Null for top-level groups. Supports hierarchical financial roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Practice groups are organized around practice areas for service delivery alignment, resource allocation, and conflict checking scope. Essential for matter staffing, rate card construction, and P&L rep

attributes.name: primary_practice_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: foreign_key_to

attributes.name: primary_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Default lead timekeeper for this practice group

attributes.name: taxonomy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to knowledge.knowledge_taxonomy. Business justification: Practice groups align to knowledge taxonomy nodes for precedent organization, matter classification, and knowledge management structure. Enables taxonomy-driven resource allocation, knowledge contribu

attributes.name: afa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether matters assigned to this practice group are eligible for Alternative Fee Arrangements (AFA) such as fixed fees, capped fees, contingency, or blended rates. Drives AFA proposal workflows in Elite 3E and client engagement letter templates.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; LEDES

attributes.name: approved_fte_count
attributes.description: Approved Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) count for the practice group, accounting for part-time and flexible working arrangements. Distinct from headcount_budget as it normalizes part-time positions to full-time equivalents. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors workforce planning module.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; ABA FTE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: associate_count
attributes.description: Number of associates (non-partner attorneys) currently assigned to the practice group. Used in leverage ratio calculations (associates per partner), capacity planning, and recruitment pipeline management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: billing_rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the standard billing rate schedule applied to timekeepers in this practice group in Aderant Expert. Determines the default hourly rates for matter billing, AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) baseline calculations, and client rate negotiations.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; Elite 3E Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: cle_requirement_hours
attributes.description: Annual Continuing Legal Education (CLE) / Continuing Professional Development (CPD) hours required for attorneys in this practice group, which may exceed the minimum jurisdictional bar requirement due to practice area specialization (e.g., IP attorneys may require additional patent prosecution training). Tracked in SAP SuccessFactors Learning.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning; ABA CLE Requirements; State Bar Associations; Law Society of England and Wales CPD Requirements

attributes.name: conflict_check_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of conflict checking applied when new matters are opened under this practice group in Intapp Conflicts. 'firm_wide' applies full firm-wide conflict screening; 'group_only' restricts to practice group relationships; 'office_only' restricts to office-level relationships. Drives ethical wall configuration.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code assigned to the practice group in Elite 3E and the firm's general ledger, enabling allocation of overhead costs, attorney compensation, and support staff expenses to the correct organizational unit for profitability reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E General Ledger; SAP SuccessFactors Cost Center Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the practice group record was first created in the source system (SAP SuccessFactors). Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per firm data standards. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Actual current number of active timekeepers and staff assigned to the practice group as of the last data refresh from SAP SuccessFactors. Used to calculate headcount variance against budget and identify open positions requiring recruitment.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: department_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the practice group is a fee-earning (revenue-generating legal practice), business services (support function such as HR, Finance, IT), or hybrid unit. Drives financial reporting segmentation, FTE budgeting, and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; Elite 3E Financial Reporting

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the practice group became operationally active and authorized to accept matter assignments and timekeeper allocations. Supports temporal validity tracking for organizational hierarchy changes and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; Elite 3E Practice Management

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which the practice group ceased to be operationally active (e.g., due to dissolution or merger into another group). Null for currently active groups. Enables point-in-time organizational hierarchy queries and historical matter staffing analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; Elite 3E Practice Management

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in Elite 3E associated with the practice group for revenue recognition, WIP tracking, and financial statement reporting. Enables drill-down from firm-level financials to practice group-level P&L.
attributes.references: Elite 3E General Ledger; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GAAP

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric short code uniquely identifying the practice group across firm systems (e.g., 'MA', 'LIT', 'IP', 'EMP', 'REG'). Used as the business key in Elite 3E matter staffing, billing rate tables, and financial reporting. Aligns with UTBMS task code groupings.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the practice group or department (e.g., 'Mergers and Acquisitions', 'Commercial Litigation', 'Intellectual Property', 'Employment Law', 'Regulatory Compliance'). The primary display label used in client-facing materials, internal directories, and reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; ABA Law Practice Division

attributes.name: headcount_budget
attributes.description: Total approved headcount budget (number of positions) for the practice group in the current fiscal year, including attorneys, paralegals, and dedicated support staff. Used in workforce planning, recruitment authorization, and FTE utilization reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: jurisdiction_primary
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code representing the primary legal jurisdiction in which this practice group operates and advises (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU').
