Drives bar admission requirements for timekeepers, regulatory compliance obligations, and jurisdictional conflict checking in Intapp Conflicts.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; State Bar Associations; Law Society of England and Wales; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the practice group record in the source system (SAP SuccessFactors). Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change detection in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lpp_classification
attributes.description: Indicates the default Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) classification for documents and communications produced by this practice group. 'privileged' indicates all work product is presumed privileged; 'non_privileged' for non-advisory groups; 'mixed' for groups with both advisory and non-advisory functions. Drives document classification in iManage Work and eDiscovery TAR workflows in Relativity.
attributes.references: iManage Work Records Management; Relativity eDiscovery; ABA Model Rules; GDPR Article 9; LPP (Legal Professional Privilege)

attributes.name: matter_count_active
attributes.description: Current number of active matters assigned to this practice group as sourced from Elite 3E matter management. Used in capacity planning, workload balancing, and practice group performance dashboards. This is a point-in-time operational count, not a calculated aggregate.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Matter Management; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, strategic context, or administrative remarks about the practice group (e.g., merger history, planned restructuring, special billing arrangements). Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors organizational unit description or manually maintained by firm administration.

attributes.name: paralegal_count
attributes.description: Number of paralegals and legal assistants currently assigned to the practice group. Used in resource allocation, matter staffing models, and billing rate mix analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: partner_count
attributes.description: Number of equity and income partners currently assigned to the practice group. Used in PPP (Profit Per Partner) and PEP (Profit Per Equity Partner) calculations, partner leverage ratio analysis, and compensation committee reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Law Firm Financial Management

attributes.name: performance_review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency of formal performance reviews for timekeepers assigned to this practice group as configured in SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals. Drives automated review initiation, goal-setting workflows, and compensation adjustment timelines.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: practice_group_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the practice group within the firm's organizational structure. 'active' indicates the group is operational and accepting matter assignments; 'inactive' indicates temporarily suspended; 'pending' indicates newly created but not yet operational; 'dissolved' indicates permanently closed; 'merged' indicates consolidated into another group.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: recruitment_open_positions
attributes.description: Number of currently open and approved recruitment positions for the practice group as tracked in SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting. Used in talent acquisition planning, headcount gap analysis, and lateral hire pipeline management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: region_scope
attributes.description: Geographic or jurisdictional scope of the practice group's operations (e.g., 'North America', 'EMEA', 'Asia Pacific', 'Global', 'United States', 'United Kingdom'). Indicates whether the group operates locally, regionally, or globally. Used in resource allocation planning and cross-border matter staffing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: revenue_target_amount
attributes.description: Annual revenue target (in firm base currency) set for the practice group for the current fiscal year. Used in financial performance dashboards, RPE (Revenue Per Equity Partner) calculations, and partner compensation reviews. Sourced from the firm's annual budgeting process.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Financial Reporting; ABA Law Firm Financial Management

attributes.name: revenue_target_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the revenue target amount (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Required for multi-currency firms operating across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: revenue_target_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2025) to which the revenue target applies. Enables year-over-year comparison of practice group financial performance and target-setting history.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the practice group used in space-constrained UI elements, reports, and dashboards (e.g., 'M&A', 'Litigation', 'IP', 'Employment'). Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors organizational unit short description field.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this practice group record in the originating source system (SAP SuccessFactors organizational unit ID). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: succession_plan_status
attributes.description: Current status of the succession planning process for the practice group's managing partner and key leadership roles in SAP SuccessFactors Succession & Development. Supports firm continuity planning and partner transition management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession & Development; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: timekeeper_class_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of timekeeper classification levels authorized to bill under this practice group (e.g., 'Equity Partner, Income Partner, Senior Associate, Associate, Paralegal, Law Clerk'). Drives billing rate table lookups in Aderant Expert and timekeeper assignment validation in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; Elite 3E Practice Management; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: utbms_task_code_prefix
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code Prefix
attributes.description: The UTBMS task code prefix associated with this practice group, used to align matter billing entries and time records to the industry-standard task-based billing framework (e.g., 'L1' for Litigation, 'B1' for Business/Corporate). Enables LEDES-compliant invoice generation and client billing analytics.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); ABA

attributes.name: wip_write_off_authority_limit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work in Progress (WIP) Write-Off Authority Limit
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount (in firm base currency) that the managing partner of this practice group is authorized to write off from WIP (Work in Progress) without escalation to firm management. Supports financial controls and write-off governance in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Elite 3E WIP Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ABA Law Firm Financial Management

attributes.name: office_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary office or geographic location associated with this practice group. For multi-office groups, this represents the lead or headquarters office. Drives regional financial reporting, resource allocation, and office-level profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; Elite 3E Office Configuration

products.name: matter_assignment
products.description: Association record linking timekeepers to specific matters with defined roles, responsibilities, and time periods. Captures assignment role (lead partner, supervising attorney, associate, paralegal, project manager), assignment start and end dates, budgeted hours, actual hours to date, billing authorization flag, LPM responsibility flag, pro bono matter flag, pro bono hours commitment and delivery tracking, and assignment status. Enables resource utilization tracking, matter staffing analysis, RPE/PPP calculations, and pro bono hours reporting against firm and individual targets. This is the workforce domains authoritative record of who works on what.

attributes.name: matter_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each matter assignment record linking a timekeeper to a specific matter. Primary key of this entity.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the matter-level budget record against which this assignment's budgeted hours and fees are tracked. Supports LPM budget variance reporting and matter profitability analysis.

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the matter to which the timekeeper is assigned. Establishes the core association between workforce and matter management domains.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.practice_group.practice_group_id — Matter assignments are often analyzed by practice group for utilization and staffing balance. The practice group context enables resource allocation reporting.

attributes.name: primary_matter_team_lead_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper designated as the overall matter team lead, which may differ from the responsible attorney or lead partner. Used for LPM reporting and team coordination.

attributes.name: tertiary_matter_supervising_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper who holds supervisory responsibility over this assignment. Supports professional responsibility compliance, associate development, and matter hierarchy reporting. Null for lead partners or independently operating timekeepers.

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each matter assignment associates a specific timekeeper to a matter. This is the core staffing relationship enabling utilization tracking and resource planning.

attributes.name: actual_hours_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative hours recorded by this timekeeper against this matter assignment as of the most recent data refresh. Sourced from Elite 3E time entry records. Enables budget-to-actual variance tracking and Work in Progress (WIP) analysis.

attributes.name: afa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this matter assignment is governed by an Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) such as a fixed fee, capped fee, or blended rate, rather than standard hourly billing. Affects how time entries are treated in billing workflows.

attributes.name: afa_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) applicable to this assignment when afa_flag is True. Drives billing configuration in Elite 3E and Aderant Expert and informs revenue recognition treatment.

attributes.name: assignment_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this matter assignment record was first created in the system of record (Elite 3E or SAP SuccessFactors). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about this matter assignment, such as scope limitations, special instructions, or staffing rationale. Not intended for privileged legal content.

attributes.name: assignment_role
attributes.description: The functional role the timekeeper holds on this matter. Drives billing authority, supervision hierarchy, and resource utilization reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lead_partner|supervising_attorney|associate|paralegal|project_manager|of_counsel|staff — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Elite 3E

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the matter assignment. Active indicates the timekeeper is currently working on the matter; completed indicates the assignment has concluded; withdrawn indicates the timekeeper was removed prior to matter closure.

attributes.name: assignment_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this matter assignment record was most recently modified in the system of record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental load processing.

attributes.name: billing_attorney_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is designated as the Billing Attorney responsible for reviewing and approving prebills and invoices for this matter in Aderant Expert and Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert; Elite 3E; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: billing_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is authorized to record billable time against this matter. When False, time entries may be recorded as non-billable or blocked at prebill stage in Aderant Expert.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: billing_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the billing_rate_override for this matter assignment (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency matter billing in international practices.

attributes.name: billing_rate_override
attributes.description: Matter-specific billing rate override for this timekeeper, expressed in the matter's billing currency. When populated, supersedes the standard timekeeper rate defined in Aderant Expert for this specific matter assignment. Confidential commercial data.

attributes.name: budgeted_fees
attributes.description: The total fee budget allocated to this timekeeper for this matter assignment, expressed in the matter's billing currency. Used for LPM budget tracking, matter profitability analysis, and RPE/PPP calculations.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours
attributes.description: The planned number of billable and non-billable hours allocated to this timekeeper for this matter assignment. Used for Legal Project Management (LPM) budgeting, resource planning, and variance analysis against actual hours.

attributes.name: conflict_clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the conflict of interest check was cleared for this timekeeper on this matter. Supports audit trail requirements for professional responsibility and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7–1.10; Intapp Conflicts; SRA

attributes.name: conflict_clearance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a conflict of interest check has been completed and cleared for this timekeeper on this matter assignment. Sourced from Intapp Conflicts. Mandatory for professional responsibility compliance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7–1.10; Intapp Conflicts; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: cpd_hours_earned
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) / Continuing Legal Education (CLE) hours earned by the timekeeper through work on this matter assignment, where applicable (e.g., pro bono matters qualifying for CLE credit). Tracked in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: ABA CLE requirements; State Bar Association CLE rules; Law Society CPD requirements; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment involves a timekeeper working across jurisdictional boundaries, triggering additional compliance checks for multi-jurisdictional practice rules, tax obligations, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IBA International Principles on Conduct for the Legal Profession; SRA; ABA

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the timekeeper's assignment to the matter concluded or is scheduled to conclude. Null for open-ended assignments. Used for staffing timeline and resource planning.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_date
attributes.description: The projected date by which this timekeeper's work on the matter assignment is expected to be completed. Used for resource capacity planning, LPM milestone tracking, and matter staffing forecasting.

attributes.name: ethical_wall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an ethical wall (information barrier) has been erected around this timekeeper for this matter assignment to prevent conflicts of interest or protect Legal Professional Privilege (LPP). Managed in Intapp Conflicts.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.10–1.11; Intapp Conflicts; SRA; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lpm_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper holds Legal Project Management (LPM) responsibility for this matter assignment, including budget oversight, milestone tracking, and resource coordination.

attributes.name: matter_role_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this timekeeper's role within the matter team, used to distinguish primary from secondary assignments of the same role type (e.g., first associate vs. second associate). Supports matter team hierarchy display and reporting.

attributes.name: originating_attorney_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is the originating attorney who brought the client or matter to the firm. Used for business development credit allocation, compensation calculations, and PPP/RPE attribution.

attributes.name: pro_bono_committed_hours
attributes.description: The number of pro bono hours this timekeeper has committed to deliver on this matter assignment. Populated only when pro_bono_flag is True. Used for tracking individual and firm-level pro bono commitments against ABA Model Rule 6.1 targets.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1; Law Society of England and Wales pro bono guidance

attributes.name: pro_bono_delivered_hours
attributes.description: Actual pro bono hours delivered by this timekeeper on this matter assignment to date. Populated only when pro_bono_flag is True. Enables variance analysis between committed and delivered pro bono hours for regulatory and firm reporting.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1; State Bar Association reporting

attributes.name: pro_bono_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is on a pro bono matter. Drives pro bono hours reporting against firm-wide and individual attorney targets as required by ABA and state bar associations.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1; State Bar Association pro bono reporting requirements

attributes.name: responsible_attorney_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is designated as the Responsible Attorney (RA) for the matter, holding ultimate professional and ethical accountability. Relevant for conflict checking, client relationship management, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Intapp Conflicts; Elite 3E

attributes.name: secondment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is on secondment (temporarily assigned to a client or another office) for this matter. Affects billing treatment, cost allocation, and SAP SuccessFactors workforce records.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this matter assignment record was sourced (e.g., Elite 3E, SAP SuccessFactors). Supports data lineage tracking and Silver layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this matter assignment record in the originating source system (e.g., Elite 3E internal assignment key). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the operational system for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the timekeeper's assignment to the matter became effective. Used for resource utilization analysis, staffing timeline reporting, and RPE/PPP period calculations.

attributes.name: supervision_level
attributes.description: Indicates the degree of supervision under which this timekeeper operates on this matter. Relevant for professional responsibility compliance, associate development tracking, and quality control under ABA Model Rules.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 5.1; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: wip_hours_unbilled
attributes.description: Hours recorded by this timekeeper on this matter that have been entered in Elite 3E but not yet included on a client invoice. Represents the timekeeper's contribution to the matter's Work in Progress (WIP) balance for revenue recognition and collections management.

attributes.name: matter_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Matter assignments link timekeepers to matters. The timekeeper FK is essential for resource utilization tracking and staffing.

attributes.name: office_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.office

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Annual and mid-year performance evaluation records for all timekeepers and staff. Stores review cycle year, review type (annual, mid-year, probationary, promotion), overall rating, billable hours target and achieved, utilization rate target and actual, origination credit, client feedback score, pro bono hours target and delivered, business development hours, leadership and development rating, reviewer identity, review completion date, and narrative comments. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management module. Feeds partnership track, compensation decisions, and utilization variance analysis.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each performance review record in the workforce domain. Primary key for the performance_review data product.

attributes.name: calibration_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the talent calibration session in which this review was discussed and the overall rating was validated against peer group. Calibration sessions ensure rating consistency across practice groups and seniority levels.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.practice_group. Business justification: Performance reviews are conducted within practice group context, with practice group managing partners often serving as reviewers or calibration participants. The performance_review table currently ha

attributes.name: primary_performance_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or staff member) who is the subject of this performance review. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors employee master.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; Elite 3E Timekeeper Management

attributes.name: reviewer_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervising attorney, partner, or manager who authored and submitted this performance review. Typically the direct supervisor or practice group leader.

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each performance review evaluates a specific timekeeper. Required for compensation decisions, promotion tracking, and utilization variance analysis.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the timekeeper formally acknowledged their performance review in SAP SuccessFactors. Provides audit trail for employment law compliance and HR record-keeping.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; Employment Law; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: billable_hours_achieved
attributes.description: The actual billable hours recorded by the timekeeper during the review period, sourced from Elite 3E or Aderant Expert time entry systems. Compared against billable_hours_target to assess performance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Time Entry; Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: billable_hours_target
attributes.description: The annual or period billable hours target assigned to the timekeeper at the start of the review cycle, as set by practice group leadership. A core KPI for attorney performance evaluation and compensation decisions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Timekeeper Management; Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: business_development_hours
attributes.description: Total hours invested by the timekeeper in business development activities (pitches, RFP responses, client entertainment, networking) during the review period. Sourced from non-billable time entries in Elite 3E or Aderant Expert.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Non-Billable Time Entry; Aderant Expert; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: client_feedback_score
attributes.description: Aggregated client satisfaction score for the timekeeper during the review period, typically on a 1.0–5.0 or 1–10 scale derived from client surveys or matter feedback programs. Reflects service quality and client relationship management.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; SRA Code of Conduct; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: collection_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of billed fees actually collected from clients attributable to the timekeeper's work during the review period. Distinct from realization_rate; reflects accounts receivable performance and client payment behavior.
attributes.references: Elite 3E AR Module; Aderant Expert Collections; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: compensation_adjustment_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer has recommended a compensation adjustment (salary increase, bonus, or equity tier change) as an outcome of this performance review. Feeds the compensation decision workflow.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance review was formally completed and signed off by the reviewer. Used to track compliance with firm review deadlines and feeds partnership track timelines.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: cpd_hours_completed
attributes.description: Total Continuing Professional Development (CPD) or Continuing Legal Education (CLE) hours completed by the timekeeper during the review period. Tracked for regulatory compliance with bar admission requirements and firm development standards.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Module; ABA CLE Requirements; SRA CPD Framework; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: cpd_hours_required
attributes.description: The minimum CPD/CLE hours required for the timekeeper during the review period, as mandated by the relevant bar association or regulatory body for their jurisdiction and practice area.
attributes.references: ABA CLE Requirements; SRA CPD Framework; State Bar Associations; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this performance review record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, sourced from SAP SuccessFactors. Provides data lineage and audit trail for the record lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: development_areas_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative authored by the reviewer identifying areas for improvement and development goals for the timekeeper in the next review period. Feeds individual development plans in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; GDPR Article 9; SRA CPD Framework

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the timekeeper has formally acknowledged receipt and review of their completed performance evaluation in SAP SuccessFactors. Required for HR compliance and employment law documentation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; Employment Law; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: fte_status
attributes.description: The Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) employment status of the timekeeper during the review period. Affects billable hours targets, utilization rate calculations, and compensation benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Model Rules; Employment Law

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Numerical rating assessing the timekeeper's leadership contributions, mentoring of junior staff, participation in firm committees, and professional development activities during the review period. Typically on a 1.0–5.0 scale.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; ABA Model Rules on Supervision

attributes.name: matter_count
attributes.description: The total number of active matters on which the timekeeper recorded time or was assigned during the review period. Provides context for workload assessment and resource allocation analysis.

attributes.name: origination_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total value of new business originated by the timekeeper during the review period, expressed in the firm's base currency. Origination credit is a key metric for partnership track and compensation decisions, reflecting business development contribution.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Client/Matter Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Pipeline; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The composite numerical performance rating assigned to the timekeeper for the review period, typically on a 1.0–5.0 scale as configured in SAP SuccessFactors. Drives compensation band placement, partnership track eligibility, and bonus pool allocation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; ABA Model Rules on Competence

attributes.name: overall_rating_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label corresponding to the overall_rating numeric score, as defined in the firm's performance calibration framework. Used in narrative reporting and partnership committee presentations.

attributes.name: partnership_track_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the timekeeper has been identified as eligible for partnership track consideration based on this review cycle's outcomes. Drives succession planning and partnership committee workflows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession Planning; ABA Model Rules; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) has been triggered as a result of this review. Drives HR case management workflows and compliance documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; SRA Code of Conduct; Employment Law

attributes.name: pro_bono_hours_delivered
attributes.description: The actual pro bono hours recorded by the timekeeper during the review period. Compared against pro_bono_hours_target to assess compliance with firm pro bono commitments and ABA aspirational standards.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1; Elite 3E Time Entry; Law Society of England and Wales Pro Bono Protocol

attributes.name: pro_bono_hours_target
attributes.description: The pro bono hours target assigned to the timekeeper for the review period, in alignment with the firm's pro bono policy and ABA Model Rule 6.1 aspirational standard of 50 hours per year.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1 (Voluntary Pro Bono Publico Service); Law Society of England and Wales Pro Bono Protocol

attributes.name: promotion_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer has recommended the timekeeper for promotion (e.g., associate to senior associate, senior associate to counsel, counsel to partner) as an outcome of this review.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: realization_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of the timekeeper's standard billing rate actually collected after write-downs and write-offs during the review period. A key financial performance metric for attorneys, reflecting billing efficiency and client relationship quality.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing; Aderant Expert Collections; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: review_cycle_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year in which this performance review cycle falls (e.g., 2024). Used to group and compare reviews across annual cycles for partnership track and compensation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the performance evaluation period covered by this review. Together with review_period_start_date, defines the measurement window for all quantitative metrics.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the performance evaluation period covered by this review. Defines the window over which billable hours, utilization, and other metrics are measured.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the performance review record within the SAP SuccessFactors performance management cycle. Drives routing, visibility, and downstream compensation processing.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review by its purpose and timing within the HR cycle. Annual reviews drive compensation; mid-year reviews are developmental; probationary reviews assess new hires; promotion reviews support partnership track decisions; exit reviews capture departure context.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; Law Society of England and Wales CPD Framework

attributes.name: reviewer_comments
attributes.description: Overall narrative comments provided by the reviewer summarising the performance evaluation, including context for the overall rating and any specific recommendations. Distinct from strengths and development area narratives.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: self_assessment_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text self-assessment narrative authored by the timekeeper themselves as part of the review process. Captures the employee's own perspective on their performance, achievements, and development needs.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: The timekeeper's seniority classification at the time of the review (e.g., equity partner, counsel, senior associate, associate, paralegal, staff). Used for peer group benchmarking, PPP/PEP calculations, and compensation band assignment.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; Elite 3E Timekeeper Management; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: source_system_review_code
attributes.description: The native performance review identifier as assigned by SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management module. Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; ISO 27001

attributes.name: strengths_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative authored by the reviewer describing the timekeeper's key strengths, accomplishments, and positive contributions during the review period. Stored as sourced from SAP SuccessFactors performance form.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; GDPR Article 9; DPA

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the reviewer submitted the completed performance review in SAP SuccessFactors. Provides audit trail for compliance with firm review submission deadlines.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; ISO 27001

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this performance review record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks changes from SAP SuccessFactors delta loads and supports incremental processing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: utilization_rate_actual
attributes.description: The actual utilization rate achieved by the timekeeper during the review period, expressed as a percentage. Calculated from time entry data in Elite 3E or Aderant Expert. Used in utilization variance analysis and compensation decisions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Time Entry; Aderant Expert; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: utilization_rate_target
attributes.description: The target utilization rate (billable hours as a percentage of total available hours) set for the timekeeper for the review period. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 for 85%). Feeds utilization variance analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E; Aderant Expert; ABA Legal Technology Survey

attributes.name: performance_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Performance reviews evaluate a specific timekeeper. This FK is required for performance history and compensation decisions.

products.name: compensation_record
products.description: Confidential compensation record for each timekeeper capturing base salary, lockstep or merit-based pay band, equity partner tier designation (tier name, points value, profit share percentage, capital contribution), bonus target and actual payout, origination bonus, benefits package tier, effective date, and compensation approval status. Supports PPP, PEP, and RPE financial analytics including partner compensation modeling across equity tiers. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Compensation module. Access is restricted to HR and firm management.

attributes.name: compensation_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each compensation record in the workforce domain. Primary key for the compensation_record data product.

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the firm-defined compensation plan template (e.g., lockstep associate plan, equity partner plan, staff merit plan) under which this record is governed.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.practice_group. Business justification: Compensation structures and pay bands are often defined by practice group. The compensation_record table currently has practice_group_code (STRING) but no FK to practice_group. This normalization esta

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each compensation record belongs to a specific timekeeper. Required for payroll, PPP/PEP calculations, and partner compensation modeling.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compensation record received final management approval. Used for audit trail, governance reporting, and determining when compensation changes become actionable for payroll.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Workflow; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Governance Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of this compensation record within the firm's HR approval process. Tracks progression from draft through management and executive sign-off to final approval or rejection.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Workflow; American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Governance Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the firm management authority (e.g., Managing Partner, Compensation Committee Chair, HR Director) who granted final approval for this compensation record. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Workflow; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Governance Standards

attributes.name: base_salary
attributes.description: Annual base salary amount for the timekeeper in the firm's operating currency. Excludes bonuses, origination credits, and profit share distributions. Core input for PPP and RPE financial analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Compensation Survey Standards

attributes.name: benefits_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the benefits package tier assigned to this timekeeper (e.g., BASIC, STANDARD, ENHANCED, EXECUTIVE). Determines eligibility for health insurance, retirement contributions, professional indemnity coverage, and other firm-provided benefits.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Benefits Guidelines

attributes.name: bonus_actual_amount
attributes.description: Actual bonus amount paid to the timekeeper for the compensation period following performance evaluation and management approval. May differ from the target based on individual and firm performance outcomes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Variable Pay Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Compensation Survey Standards

attributes.name: bonus_target_amount
attributes.description: Target bonus amount established for the timekeeper at the start of the performance period under the applicable bonus plan. Represents the expected payout at 100% performance achievement. Used for compensation modeling and budget forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Variable Pay Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Compensation Survey Standards

attributes.name: capital_contribution
attributes.description: Amount of capital contributed by the equity partner to the firm as required under the partnership agreement. Null for non-equity timekeepers. Used in partner financial modeling and balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Agreement Standards; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Financial Stability Rules

attributes.name: compensation_review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency of the compensation review cycle under which this record was generated. Determines the cadence of pay adjustments and supports scheduling of future review events.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Cycle Configuration; American Bar Association (ABA) Compensation Review Best Practices

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compensation structure applied to this timekeeper. Lockstep advances by seniority year; merit-based is performance-driven; equity and non-equity partner tiers reflect partnership status; staff covers non-attorney personnel.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Law Firm Compensation Guidelines; SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module

attributes.name: compensation_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year to which this compensation record applies. Used to partition historical compensation data for year-over-year PPP, PEP, and RPE trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Annual Compensation Survey

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compensation record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping obligations under applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Record Retention Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary compensation amounts on this record are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-jurisdictional firm operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; International Bar Association (IBA) Cross-Border Practice Standards

attributes.name: deferred_compensation
attributes.description: Amount of compensation deferred to a future period under a firm-sponsored deferred compensation arrangement. Common for equity partners deferring a portion of profit distributions. Supports long-term compensation liability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Partner Compensation Models; SOX Section 409A Deferred Compensation Rules

attributes.name: draw_amount
attributes.description: Monthly or periodic draw amount paid to an equity partner as an advance against their anticipated profit share distribution. Null for non-partner timekeepers. Used in partner cash flow management and year-end reconciliation against actual profit share.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Financial Management Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this compensation record becomes operative for the timekeeper. Used to determine the applicable pay period for billing rate alignment, payroll processing, and PPP/PEP analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; LEDES Billing Standards

attributes.name: equity_partner_points
attributes.description: Numeric points value assigned to the equity partner under the firm's points-based profit sharing system. Determines the partner's proportional share of distributable profits. Null for non-equity timekeepers. Key input for PPP and PEP calculations.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Compensation Models; SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module

attributes.name: equity_partner_tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the equity partner tier assigned to this timekeeper (e.g., Tier 1, Senior Partner, Managing Partner). Null for non-equity timekeepers. Drives profit share and capital contribution calculations for PEP and PPP analytics.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Agreement Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compensation record ceases to be operative. Null for open-ended records. Used to manage compensation history and support point-in-time analytics for PPP and PEP reporting.

attributes.name: external_record_ref
attributes.description: Externally-known reference number or identifier for this compensation record as assigned by SAP SuccessFactors or the firm's HR system of record. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: fte_fraction
attributes.description: Numeric fraction representing the timekeeper's working proportion relative to a full-time position (e.g., 1.0 for full-time, 0.5 for half-time). Used to prorate salary, bonus targets, and billable hour targets for part-time timekeepers.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ISO 30414 Human Capital Reporting

attributes.name: fte_status
attributes.description: Employment basis of the timekeeper indicating whether they are a full-time equivalent (FTE), part-time, contract, or on secondment. Affects compensation proration, benefits eligibility, and FTE headcount reporting for firm management analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; American Bar Association (ABA) Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: is_equity_partner
attributes.description: Indicates whether the timekeeper holds equity partner status in the firm. True for equity partners who participate in profit sharing and capital contributions; False for all other timekeepers. Key filter for PEP and PPP analytics.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Agreement Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the timekeeper as recorded in the HR system of record (e.g., Associate, Senior Associate, Counsel, Partner, Paralegal, Legal Secretary). Used for compensation benchmarking and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; American Bar Association (ABA) Law Firm Titles and Roles

attributes.name: lockstep_year
attributes.description: The seniority year within the firm's lockstep compensation progression at which this timekeeper is placed for the compensation period. Null for merit-based or partner compensation structures. Drives automatic salary advancement in lockstep plans.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Grade Configuration; American Bar Association (ABA) Associate Compensation Standards

attributes.name: merit_increase_pct
attributes.description: Percentage salary increase awarded to the timekeeper based on individual performance evaluation for the compensation cycle. Null for lockstep or partner compensation structures. Supports merit budget analysis and pay equity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance and Compensation Module; ISO 30414 Human Capital Reporting

attributes.name: origination_bonus
attributes.description: Bonus amount awarded to the timekeeper for originating new client business or matters during the compensation period. Reflects the firm's business development incentive structure and is a key component of partner compensation analytics including RPE.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Origination Credit Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module

attributes.name: pay_band_code
attributes.description: Firm-defined pay band or grade code assigned to this timekeeper under the applicable compensation plan (e.g., A1, A2, SA1, P1 for associates and senior associates). Drives lockstep or merit-based salary range boundaries.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Grade Configuration; American Bar Association (ABA) Compensation Survey

attributes.name: pay_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum salary amount defined for the assigned pay band. Used to validate that the timekeeper's base salary does not exceed the approved compensation ceiling and supports pay equity reporting.

attributes.name: pay_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum salary amount defined for the assigned pay band. Used to validate that the timekeeper's base salary falls within the approved compensation range and supports equity analysis.

attributes.name: pay_equity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation record has been flagged for pay equity review, typically triggered when the timekeeper's compensation falls outside the expected range for their grade, gender, or demographic cohort. Supports compliance with pay equity legislation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Standards; ISO 30414 Human Capital Reporting

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Firm-defined performance rating assigned to the timekeeper for the compensation cycle (e.g., Exceeds Expectations, Meets Expectations, Below Expectations). Drives merit increase percentage and bonus payout calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exceeds_expectations|meets_expectations|partially_meets|below_expectations|not_rated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Performance Evaluation Guidelines

attributes.name: profit_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the firm's distributable profits allocated to this equity partner for the compensation period. Derived from the partner's points relative to total firm points but stored as a discrete record for audit and historical reporting. Null for non-equity timekeepers.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Partnership Agreement Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Firm's contribution percentage to the timekeeper's retirement or pension plan as a proportion of base salary. Supports total compensation cost modeling and benefits benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Staff Benefits Standards

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating record in SAP SuccessFactors Compensation module (e.g., the SuccessFactors compensation form ID or employee compensation record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: timekeeper_grade
attributes.description: Seniority or grade classification of the timekeeper within the firm's career framework (e.g., Year 1 Associate, Year 5 Associate, Senior Associate, Counsel, Non-Equity Partner, Equity Partner). Drives pay band assignment and lockstep progression.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Job Classification; American Bar Association (ABA) Career Progression Standards

attributes.name: total_cash_compensation
attributes.description: Total cash compensation for the timekeeper for the compensation period, comprising base salary plus actual bonus payout plus origination bonus. Stored as a discrete field (not computed at query time) to support point-in-time compensation reporting and regulatory pay equity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Compensation Survey; ISO 30414 Human Capital Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compensation record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect changes, support incremental data processing, and maintain audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Record Retention Standards

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or location to which this timekeeper is assigned for compensation purposes. Used to apply jurisdiction-specific pay scales, benefits rules, and local regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; Elite 3E Office Configuration

products.name: recruitment_requisition
products.description: Tracks open and closed attorney and staff recruitment requisitions from job posting through offer acceptance, including the embedded candidate pipeline for each requisition. Stores position title, seniority level, practice group, office location, requisition open date, target start date, approved headcount budget, sourcing channel (lateral hire, law school campus, ALSP, referral), recruiter assigned, interview stages, offer extended flag, offer outcome, and requisition close reason. Candidate pipeline attributes per requisition include candidate name, current employer, law school, years of experience, bar admissions held, application stage, background check status, and conflicts pre-screen status. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting module.

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recruitment requisition record in the workforce data product. Primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: primary_recruitment_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the attorney, partner, or staff manager who initiated and owns the recruitment requisition. Corresponds to the PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Links to the workforce employee/timekeeper master record.

attributes.name: succession_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.succession_plan. Business justification: Recruitment requisitions may be created to fulfill succession plans when a key role needs to be filled. The recruitment_requisition table has succession_plan_flag (BOOLEAN) indicating the requisition

attributes.name: approved_headcount
attributes.description: Number of full-time equivalent (FTE) positions approved for hire under this requisition. Typically 1 for individual hires; may be greater for cohort or class-year campus recruiting campaigns. Drives headcount budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; firm FTE headcount governance

attributes.name: background_check_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether candidates for this requisition are required to complete a background check (criminal, credit, education verification) as part of the pre-employment screening process. Driven by position type, seniority level, and client-facing responsibilities.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; GDPR Article 9; CCPA; FATF AML compliance

attributes.name: bar_admission_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the open position requires the candidate to hold an active bar admission or solicitor qualification. True for attorney and counsel roles; False for paralegal, legal secretary, and business services staff. Drives compliance screening in the candidate pipeline.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: bar_jurisdiction_required
attributes.description: The specific jurisdiction(s) in which the candidate must hold an active bar admission or solicitor qualification (e.g., New York, California, England and Wales). Null for non-attorney positions. Used for compliance screening and lateral hire eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recruitment requisition was formally closed, whether due to being filled, cancelled, or withdrawn. Used to calculate time-to-fill KPIs and recruiter performance metrics.

attributes.name: close_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for closing the recruitment requisition. Distinguishes successful fills from cancellations due to headcount freezes, organisational restructuring, or strategic withdrawal. Critical for workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: compensation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary band and compensation figures associated with this requisition (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-office firms operating across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: conflicts_prescreening_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether candidates for this requisition must undergo a conflicts of interest pre-screen via Intapp Conflicts before progressing to interview stages. Mandatory for attorney and counsel positions to satisfy professional responsibility obligations and ethical wall requirements.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.10; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recruitment requisition record was first created in SAP SuccessFactors. Corresponds to the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Stored in ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: current_pipeline_count
attributes.description: Total number of active candidates currently in the pipeline for this requisition across all interview stages. Provides a real-time snapshot of pipeline depth for recruiter workload management and hiring manager reporting.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement for the open position. Full-time (FTE) positions are tracked against approved headcount budgets; secondments and summer associate roles have distinct billing and supervision requirements.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: interview_stage_count
attributes.description: Total number of defined interview stages configured for this requisition's hiring process in SAP SuccessFactors (e.g., phone screen, first-round, callback, partner interview). Used for process standardisation and time-to-hire analytics.

attributes.name: job_description_url
attributes.description: URL link to the full job description document stored in the firm's document management system (iManage Work or NetDocuments) or careers portal. Provides recruiters and hiring managers with direct access to the approved position specification.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; iManage Work DMS; NetDocuments

attributes.name: job_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position was first published externally on job boards, the firm's careers portal, or law school recruiting platforms. Used to measure sourcing lead time and candidate pipeline velocity.

attributes.name: kyc_aml_check_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Client / Anti-Money Laundering Check Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate must undergo KYC (Know Your Client) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) screening as part of the pre-employment process. Applicable for positions with access to client trust accounts (IOLTA), financial transactions, or regulated activities under FATF guidelines.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF); AML compliance; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module

attributes.name: law_school_target_tier
attributes.description: For law school campus recruiting requisitions, the target law school ranking tier from which the firm is recruiting (e.g., T14 top-14 law schools, Top 25, Top 50, any ABA-accredited school). Not applicable for lateral hire or staff requisitions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA) law school accreditation

attributes.name: offer_accepted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the selected candidate formally accepted the employment offer. Marks the transition from active recruiting to onboarding. Null if offer has not yet been accepted.

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal employment offer was extended to the selected candidate. Used to calculate offer-to-acceptance cycle time and compliance with candidate communication SLAs.

attributes.name: offer_extended_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal offer of employment has been extended to at least one candidate under this requisition. True when an offer letter has been issued; False when no offer has yet been made. Used for pipeline conversion rate reporting.

attributes.name: offer_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent employment offer extended under this requisition. Accepted indicates the candidate accepted the offer; declined indicates candidate rejection; rescinded indicates the firm withdrew the offer. Null when no offer has been extended.

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recruitment requisition was formally opened and approved for sourcing. Represents the principal business event timestamp (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP) for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used to calculate time-to-fill and recruiter SLA metrics.

attributes.name: position_title
attributes.description: Official job title for the open position as defined in the firm's job architecture (e.g., Associate Attorney, Senior Paralegal, Legal Project Manager, Equity Partner). Used in job postings and offer letters.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA) attorney classification standards

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the open position distinguishing attorney roles from paralegal, legal secretary, and business services staff. Determines applicable bar admission requirements and CPD/CLE obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: attorney|paralegal|legal_secretary|staff|partner|of_counsel — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: replacement_or_new_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requisition is for a replacement of a departing employee, a net-new approved headcount position, or a backfill for a temporarily vacated role. Critical for headcount budget reconciliation and workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; firm headcount governance

attributes.name: requisition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special requirements, or internal notes related to the recruitment requisition as entered by the recruiter or HR business partner in SAP SuccessFactors. May include client-specific staffing requirements or practice group preferences.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the recruitment requisition as assigned by SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting. Used in communications with hiring managers, HR business partners, and candidates. Corresponds to the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: requisition_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the requisition by the hiring manager or HR business partner. Critical and high-priority requisitions receive accelerated recruiter attention and may trigger executive escalation if unfilled beyond SLA thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; firm SLA governance

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recruitment requisition. Drives workflow routing, reporting, and headcount budget tracking. Corresponds to the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|on_hold|filled|cancelled|closed — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA) workforce governance

attributes.name: salary_band_max
attributes.description: The maximum base compensation amount for the approved salary band associated with this requisition, expressed in the office location's local currency. Used for compensation benchmarking, budget approval, and pay equity analysis. Classified confidential as it represents sensitive business compensation data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; firm compensation governance; Pay Transparency Act (where applicable)

attributes.name: salary_band_min
attributes.description: The minimum base compensation amount for the approved salary band associated with this requisition, expressed in the office location's local currency. Used for compensation benchmarking and pay equity analysis. Classified confidential as it represents sensitive business compensation data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; firm compensation governance; Pay Transparency Act (where applicable)

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: Seniority classification of the open position within the firm's attorney and staff hierarchy. Drives compensation band selection, PPP/PEP tier assignment, and approval routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|junior|mid|senior|counsel|partner|equity_partner — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: sourcing_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external legal search firm or recruitment agency engaged to source candidates for this requisition (e.g., Major Lindsey & Africa, Lateral Link). Null for internally sourced or campus recruiting requisitions. Used for agency fee tracking and vendor performance management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM vendor management

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which candidates are being sourced for this requisition. Lateral hire indicates experienced attorney recruitment; law_school_campus indicates on-campus recruiting; ALSP (Alternative Legal Service Provider) indicates contract staffing; referral indicates employee referral programme. Used for cost-per-hire and sourcing effectiveness analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA) lateral hiring guidelines

attributes.name: target_start_date
attributes.description: The desired or planned start date for the successful candidate as specified by the hiring manager at the time of requisition creation. Used for workforce planning, matter staffing projections, and bar admission timeline management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the recruitment requisition record in SAP SuccessFactors. Corresponds to the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trails.

attributes.name: years_experience_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of post-qualification or relevant legal experience required for the open position. Used to filter candidate pipelines and benchmark against lateral hire market data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; American Bar Association (ABA) attorney classification

attributes.name: recruitment_practice_group_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.practice_group

attributes.name: office_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the office location of the open position. Used for jurisdiction-specific regulatory compliance, GDPR applicability, and compensation currency determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: The firm office or geographic location for which the position is being recruited (e.g., New York, London, Hong Kong). Used for jurisdiction-specific bar admission requirements and compensation benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Module; Law Society of England and Wales; State Bar Associations

products.name: leave_record
products.description: Tracks all approved and pending leave events for timekeepers including parental leave, sabbatical, medical leave, vacation, and unpaid leave. Stores leave type, request date, approved start date, approved end date, actual return date, leave reason code, coverage arrangement, impact on billable hours target, payroll adjustment flag, and approving manager. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance. Critical for resource planning and matter staffing continuity.

attributes.name: leave_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each leave record in the workforce domain. Primary key for the leave_record data product sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance.

attributes.name: primary_leave_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or staff member) for whom this leave record applies. Links to the workforce.timekeeper master record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; Elite 3E Timekeeper Management

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_covering_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper assigned as primary cover for the absent timekeeper's matters. Populated when coverage_arrangement is internal_cover or shared_cover. Supports matter staffing continuity and conflict checking.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.3; Intapp Conflicts; Elite 3E Matter Management

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each leave record belongs to a specific timekeeper. Required for resource planning, billable hours target adjustment, and matter staffing continuity.

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the timekeeper returned to active work. May differ from approved_end_date due to early return, extended leave, or phased return arrangements. Null until the timekeeper has returned.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FMLA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the approving manager formally approved the leave request in SAP SuccessFactors. Used for SLA measurement of HR approval turnaround time.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance Workflow

attributes.name: approved_duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days covered by the approved leave period, calculated from approved_start_date to approved_end_date inclusive. Used for entitlement balance deduction and payroll adjustment.

attributes.name: approved_end_date
attributes.description: The formally approved last calendar day of the leave period. Nullable for open-ended leaves such as long-term medical or parental leave where return date is not yet confirmed.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: approved_start_date
attributes.description: The formally approved first calendar day of the leave period. Used for matter staffing continuity planning, billable hours target proration, and payroll processing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: bar_compliance_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave event creates a risk of non-compliance with bar admission CPD/CLE requirements (True). Triggers proactive outreach to the timekeeper and bar compliance team.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules for CLE; State Bar Association CPD Requirements; Law Society of England and Wales CPD Rules

attributes.name: billable_hours_target_impact
attributes.description: Reduction in the timekeeper's annual billable hours target (in hours) attributable to this leave event. Used by Legal Project Management (LPM) and practice group leaders to reforecast capacity and matter staffing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Timekeeper Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which an approved or pending leave request was cancelled, either by the employee or HR. Populated only when leave_status is 'cancelled'. Triggers reversal of payroll adjustments and entitlement balance restoration.

attributes.name: coverage_arrangement
attributes.description: Describes the staffing continuity arrangement put in place to cover the absent timekeeper's matters and client responsibilities during the leave period.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.3 (Diligence); SRA Code of Conduct; Elite 3E Matter Management

attributes.name: cpd_impact_hours
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Professional Development (CPD)/Continuing Legal Education (CLE) hours that may be deferred or waived as a result of this leave event. Used by HR to manage bar compliance and CPD exemption applications.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules for CLE; Law Society CPD Requirements; SRA CPD Framework; SAP SuccessFactors Learning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this leave record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer, sourced from SAP SuccessFactors. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (accountability); SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the payroll_adjustment_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-jurisdiction payroll processing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: employee_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes submitted by the timekeeper as part of the leave request, providing context or special instructions. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; DPA 2018; SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: hr_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by HR personnel regarding special circumstances, accommodation arrangements, or case-specific details for this leave record. Classified as confidential due to potential sensitivity of employment-related information.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation); DPA 2018; SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: is_intermittent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently (True) rather than as a continuous block (False). Intermittent leave requires separate scheduling and has different billable hours impact calculations under FMLA.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

attributes.name: is_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is fully paid (True) or unpaid/partially unpaid (False). Drives payroll adjustment processing and IOLTA trust account considerations for partner draws.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; FMLA; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: is_phased_return
attributes.description: Indicates whether the timekeeper is returning to work on a phased/reduced-hours basis (True) rather than full capacity (False). Affects FTE percentage, billable hours target, and matter staffing planning.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; SRA Standards and Regulations; FMLA

attributes.name: leave_balance_after
