attributes.description: The timekeeper's accrued leave entitlement balance in days immediately after this leave event has been applied. Supports entitlement audit and payroll reconciliation.

attributes.name: leave_balance_before
attributes.description: The timekeeper's accrued leave entitlement balance in days immediately prior to this leave event being applied. Supports entitlement audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: leave_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code from SAP SuccessFactors identifying the specific reason for the leave (e.g., FMLA-SELF, FMLA-FAMILY, PERSONAL-ILLNESS, MATERNITY, PATERNITY, SABBATICAL-RESEARCH). Sensitive business data used for HR reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA; GDPR Article 9 (special category data); DPA 2018

attributes.name: leave_request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the leave request as generated by SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance. Used for cross-system reference and employee communications.

attributes.name: leave_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the leave record within the approval and execution workflow. Drives resource planning and matter staffing continuity actions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance Workflow

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave event by its nature and entitlement basis. Drives payroll treatment, billable hours target adjustment, and matter staffing continuity planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|parental|medical|sabbatical|unpaid|bereavement|jury_duty|military|study|compassionate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: matter_impact_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal matter staffing impact assessment has been completed for this leave event (True). Ensures compliance with ABA Rule 1.3 (Diligence) and SRA Code of Conduct obligations for client service continuity.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.3; SRA Code of Conduct; Elite 3E Matter Management

attributes.name: medical_certification_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certification documentation has been received and validated by HR (True). Null or False when medical_certification_required is False.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.306; ADA; GDPR Article 9; DPA 2018

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical certification documentation is required for this leave type and jurisdiction (True). Drives document collection workflow in SAP SuccessFactors and compliance with FMLA/ADA certification requirements.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.306; ADA; GDPR Article 9 (special category health data); DPA 2018

attributes.name: payroll_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the payroll deduction or adjustment resulting from this leave event, expressed in the firm's base currency. Populated only when payroll_adjustment_flag is True. Sensitive compensation data.

attributes.name: payroll_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payroll adjustment is required for this leave event (True) due to unpaid leave, partial pay, or leave without pay arrangements. Triggers downstream payroll processing in SAP SuccessFactors Payroll.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX Section 302 (payroll controls)

attributes.name: phased_return_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the phased return arrangement concludes and the timekeeper resumes full FTE capacity. Null when is_phased_return is False.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: phased_return_fte_percentage
attributes.description: The reduced Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) percentage applicable during a phased return period, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%). Null when is_phased_return is False.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: regulatory_leave_category
attributes.description: The statutory or regulatory framework under which this leave is classified (e.g., FMLA, ADA, UK statutory maternity/paternity, EU Working Time Directive, or firm policy only). Drives compliance reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fmla|ada|state_statutory|firm_policy|uk_statutory|eu_directive|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; ADA; UK Employment Rights Act 1996; EU Working Time Directive 2003/88/EC; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the approving manager when a leave request is rejected. Populated only when leave_status is 'rejected'. Supports employee relations and grievance management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the timekeeper formally submitted the leave request in SAP SuccessFactors. Used to measure advance notice compliance and SLA adherence for HR approval workflows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance to this leave request. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this leave record was most recently modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (accountability); SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: working_days_absent
attributes.description: Number of business working days (excluding weekends and public holidays) within the approved leave period. Used for billable hours target adjustment and FTE capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; Elite 3E Timekeeper Management

attributes.name: leave_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Leave records track absences for a specific timekeeper. Required for resource planning and payroll.

products.name: succession_plan
products.description: Succession planning records identifying key roles at risk and designated successors for critical partner and leadership positions. Stores the incumbent timekeeper, role title, risk level (flight risk, retirement horizon), readiness timeline, designated successor candidates, development actions required, plan review date, and sponsoring partner. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development module. Supports firm continuity and client relationship transition planning.

attributes.name: succession_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the succession plan record. Primary key for the succession_plan data product in the workforce domain.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.practice_group. Business justification: Succession planning is organized by practice group to ensure continuity of practice group leadership and key roles. The succession_plan table currently has practice_group (STRING) but no FK to the pra

attributes.name: primary_successor_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the first-ranked designated successor candidate for the key role. References the timekeeper record of the attorney or professional identified as the primary succession candidate.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: tertiary_succession_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the equity partner or senior leader who sponsors and is accountable for this succession plan. Responsible for overseeing development actions and plan reviews.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each succession plan identifies an incumbent timekeeper in a key role. Required for continuity planning and client relationship transition.

attributes.name: bar_admission_gap
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary successor candidate lacks a required bar admission or jurisdiction-specific licence needed to fully assume the key role. Triggers targeted bar admission development actions.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA); SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: cle_gap_identified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Gap Identified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Continuing Legal Education (CLE) or Continuing Professional Development (CPD) gap has been identified for the primary successor candidate that must be addressed before they are ready to assume the key role.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning; ABA CLE Requirements; State Bar Associations CPD Standards

attributes.name: client_transition_risk
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk to client relationships if the incumbent vacates the role without a prepared successor. Reflects the degree to which key client relationships are concentrated in the incumbent and the potential revenue impact on the firm.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Elite 3E; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this succession plan record was first created in the system. Audit trail field sourced from SAP SuccessFactors. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability); ISO 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the key_client_revenue_at_risk amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency firm operations.

attributes.name: development_actions_required
attributes.description: Narrative description of the key development actions, training programs, mentoring assignments, or experience gaps that must be addressed to prepare successor candidates for the role. May reference CPD/CLE requirements or LPM training.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning and Development; ABA Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Standards; CPD Requirements

attributes.name: estimated_vacancy_date
attributes.description: Projected date on which the incumbent is expected to vacate the role (e.g., planned retirement date, anticipated departure date). Used to set urgency and readiness timelines for successor development.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: external_candidate_considered
attributes.description: Indicates whether external lateral hire candidates are being considered as part of the succession strategy for this role, in addition to or instead of internal successor development.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruitment; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: incumbent_performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent formal performance rating of the incumbent in the key role. Confidential HR data used to assess whether the role vacancy is performance-driven and to calibrate urgency of succession planning.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this succession plan is designated as strictly confidential and restricted to a limited set of firm leadership. When true, access is limited to the sponsoring partner, managing partner, and HR leadership only.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SAP SuccessFactors; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: is_emergency_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan has been designated as an emergency succession plan, activated in response to an unplanned or sudden vacancy (e.g., unexpected departure, incapacitation). Triggers expedited review and activation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: key_client_revenue_at_risk
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue (in the firm's base currency) associated with key client relationships held by the incumbent that could be at risk upon role vacancy. Confidential financial planning data used to prioritize succession investment.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: knowledge_transfer_status
attributes.description: Current status of knowledge transfer activities from the incumbent to designated successor candidates. Tracks progress of client introductions, matter handovers, and institutional knowledge documentation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; Thomson Reuters Practical Law Knowledge Management; iManage Work DMS

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this succession plan record was most recently updated in the system. Audit trail field used to detect stale plans and track plan maintenance activity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this succession plan was most recently formally reviewed and updated by the sponsoring partner or HR leadership. Used to identify stale plans requiring refresh.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: lateral_hire_target_seniority
attributes.description: If an external lateral hire is being considered as part of the succession strategy, the target seniority level for the lateral candidate. Applicable only when external_candidate_considered is true.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Recruitment; American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: lpm_training_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Project Management (LPM) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Legal Project Management (LPM) training has been identified as a required development action for the designated successor(s) to be ready for the key role.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning; ABA Legal Project Management Standards

attributes.name: mentoring_assignment
attributes.description: Description of formal mentoring or coaching arrangements established between the incumbent and successor candidates, or between the sponsoring partner and successors, as part of the development plan.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning and Development; ABA Continuing Legal Education (CLE) Standards

attributes.name: nine_box_rating
attributes.description: Nine-box talent grid position assigned to the primary successor candidate, combining performance and potential dimensions (e.g., 1A, 2B, 3C). Confidential HR assessment used to calibrate succession readiness and development investment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1A|1B|1C|2A|2B|2C|3A|3B|3C — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: plan_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this succession plan became active and operative. Marks the start of the formal succession planning period for the role.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: plan_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this succession plan is scheduled to expire or be superseded. Nullable for open-ended plans. Triggers mandatory review or closure workflow upon reaching this date.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: plan_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to the succession plan, used for cross-system identification and reporting. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: plan_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this succession plan by the sponsoring partner and HR leadership. Ensures plans remain current and development actions are progressing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the succession plan record. Drives workflow routing and reporting visibility. Valid values: draft, active, under_review, on_hold, closed, archived.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: primary_successor_readiness
attributes.description: Individual readiness assessment for the primary successor candidate, indicating how soon they could assume the key role. May differ from the overall plan readiness timeline if multiple candidates are assessed.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: readiness_timeline
attributes.description: Assessed timeframe within which a designated successor will be ready to assume the key role. Drives development action prioritization and urgency of succession planning activities.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: retirement_eligibility_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incumbent becomes eligible for retirement under the firm's partnership agreement or retirement policy. Confidential HR data used to calibrate the succession planning horizon.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; Law Society of England and Wales; State Bar Associations

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Classification of the primary risk driver that makes this role a succession priority. Indicates whether the incumbent is a flight risk (likely to leave for another firm), approaching retirement, or at risk for other reasons. Informs urgency and development timeline.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed severity of succession risk for the role. Critical indicates immediate risk with no ready successor; high indicates near-term risk; medium and low indicate longer planning horizons. Drives prioritization of development investment.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: role_title
attributes.description: Title of the critical role or position being succession-planned (e.g., Managing Partner, Practice Group Leader, Head of Litigation, Chief Legal Officer). Represents the position, not the individual.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; American Bar Association (ABA) Law Firm Governance Standards

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Classification of the role being succession-planned within the firm's partnership and leadership hierarchy. Determines applicable compensation structures (PPP, PEP, RPE) and governance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equity_partner|non_equity_partner|practice_group_leader|managing_partner|of_counsel|senior_associate|department_head|chief_legal_officer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: secondary_successor_readiness
attributes.description: Individual readiness assessment for the secondary successor candidate, indicating how soon they could assume the key role if the primary successor is unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development module to this succession plan. Used for lineage tracing and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: succession_notes
attributes.description: Free-text confidential notes recorded by the sponsoring partner or HR leadership regarding the succession plan, including context on risk factors, candidate assessments, client sensitivities, or special circumstances not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: successor_count
attributes.description: Total number of identified successor candidates associated with this succession plan. A count of zero indicates a critical gap with no identified pipeline for the role.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Succession and Development Module

attributes.name: talent_pool_segment
attributes.description: SAP SuccessFactors talent pool classification assigned to the primary successor candidate. Segments the successor pipeline by potential and performance to prioritize development investment.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Talent Management; IBA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: years_in_role
attributes.description: Number of years the incumbent has held the key role being succession-planned. Used to assess institutional knowledge concentration and urgency of knowledge transfer activities.

attributes.name: succession_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Succession plans identify the incumbent timekeeper whose role is at risk. Essential for plan identification.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: The firm office or geographic location associated with the key role being succession-planned. Used for regional continuity planning and client relationship transition analysis.

products.name: secondment
products.description: Records attorney and staff secondment arrangements where a timekeeper is temporarily placed with a client organization, another firm office, or an international rotation. Stores secondment type (client secondment, inter-office, international rotation), host organization, host contact, secondment start and end dates, cost allocation arrangement (client-funded, firm-funded, split), billing rate during secondment, supervising partner, secondment objectives, and return-to-role plan. Supports client relationship management, cross-border staffing, and resource planning continuity.

attributes.name: secondment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the secondment arrangement record in the workforce data product. Primary key for the secondment entity.

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client matter under which the secondment costs and time are recorded for billing and WIP tracking purposes. Applicable when the secondment is linked to a specific client engagement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each secondment places a specific timekeeper with a client or office. Required for resource allocation and billing rate management during secondment.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date the secondment concluded, which may differ from the scheduled end date due to early termination or extension. Populated upon completion or early termination of the arrangement.

attributes.name: agreement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal secondment agreement between the firm and the host organisation was executed and signed by all parties. Marks the binding commencement of the contractual arrangement.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the secondment arrangement received formal internal approval from the authorised approver. Marks the transition from 'proposed' to 'approved' status.

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the billing rate and cost amounts for this secondment arrangement (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Elite 3E Practice Management; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: billing_rate_during_secondment
attributes.description: The hourly billing rate applied to the secondee's time charged to the host organisation or matter during the secondment period. May differ from the timekeeper's standard rate in the firm's rate schedule. Expressed in the currency defined by billing_currency_code.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert; Elite 3E Practice Management; LEDES Billing Standard; UTBMS

attributes.name: conflict_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the ethical conflict check performed prior to or during the secondment to identify any conflicts of interest between the secondee's firm matters and the host organisation's business. Managed via Intapp Conflicts.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: cost_allocation_type
attributes.description: Defines how the financial cost of the secondment is allocated between the firm and the host organisation. Client-funded: host client bears full cost; Firm-funded: firm absorbs all costs; Split: costs shared under an agreed ratio; Third-party funded: an external body (e.g., government grant) funds the placement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: cost_split_percentage
attributes.description: Where cost_allocation_type is 'split', the percentage of total secondment cost borne by the host organisation. The firm bears the remainder (100 minus this value). Expressed as a percentage between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: cpd_hours_credited
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) or Continuing Legal Education (CLE) hours formally credited to the secondee for the secondment placement, as recognised by the relevant bar association or regulatory body.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; ABA CLE Requirements; SRA CPD Framework; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which the secondment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5(2) (accountability); SAP SuccessFactors HRM

attributes.name: data_protection_agreement_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a data protection agreement or data processing addendum has been executed between the firm and the host organisation governing the handling of personal data accessed by the secondee during the placement.

attributes.name: early_termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the early termination of the secondment before the scheduled end date. Populated only when secondment_status is 'terminated_early'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recall_by_firm|resignation|host_request|performance|health|redundancy|matter_concluded|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which the secondment placement concludes and the timekeeper is expected to return to their substantive role at the firm. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.

attributes.name: ethical_wall_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an information barrier (ethical wall) must be erected to screen the secondee from accessing confidential firm or client information that could create a conflict of interest during the placement.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.10; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: host_bar_admission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the secondee must hold or obtain a bar admission, practising certificate, or equivalent authorisation in the host jurisdiction to perform legal work during the secondment.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales; SRA; State Bar Associations; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: host_bar_admission_status
attributes.description: Current status of the secondee's bar admission or practising certificate in the host jurisdiction. Not Required: no local admission needed; Pending: application in progress; Obtained: admission secured; Waived: exemption granted; Expired: admission lapsed.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA); SRA; State Bar Associations; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: host_city
attributes.description: City where the host organisation's primary office or placement location is situated. Used for resource planning, travel and expense management, and cross-border staffing analytics.

attributes.name: host_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact at the host organisation. Used for secondment coordination, performance review communications, and return-to-role planning.

attributes.name: host_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the host organisation responsible for managing the secondee's day-to-day activities, performance feedback, and administrative matters during the placement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: host_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the host organisation is located. Drives international rotation classification, cross-border tax treatment, work permit requirements, and applicable bar admission rules.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; International Bar Association (IBA); GDPR Article 44 (cross-border data transfers)

attributes.name: host_organisation_name
attributes.description: The legal or trading name of the organisation hosting the secondee, which may be a client entity, another law firm office, a government body, or a non-profit. Sensitive as it reveals client relationship details.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Legal Professional Privilege (LPP)

attributes.name: host_organisation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the host organisation category, used to determine applicable billing arrangements, conflict-check requirements, and regulatory obligations during the secondment.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the secondment arrangement generates billable charges to the host organisation or client. True for client-funded or split arrangements; False for firm-funded or pro bono placements.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; UTBMS

attributes.name: lpp_risk_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk that Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) over communications and work product may be compromised during the secondment, particularly relevant for in-house placements where LPP protections may differ from private practice.
attributes.references: Legal Professional Privilege (LPP); ABA Model Rules; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days' notice required by either party to terminate or recall the secondee from the placement before the scheduled end date, as stipulated in the secondment agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: objectives
attributes.description: Narrative description of the agreed business and professional development objectives for the secondment, including skills to be developed, client relationship goals, and knowledge transfer targets. Used in performance management and CPD planning.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; ABA Model Rules; CPD Framework

attributes.name: performance_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formal performance review for the secondment has been completed and submitted in SAP SuccessFactors. Used to track compliance with the firm's performance management obligations.

attributes.name: performance_review_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which a formal mid-secondment or end-of-secondment performance review must be completed by the supervising partner and host contact, feeding into the timekeeper's annual performance management cycle.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business reference code assigned to the secondment arrangement, used in correspondence with the host organisation, HR documentation, and billing systems. Format: SEC-YYYY-NNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Elite 3E Practice Management

attributes.name: return_to_role_plan
attributes.description: Documented plan outlining the timekeeper's reintegration into their substantive role upon completion of the secondment, including practice group reassignment, matter allocation, and any transitional support arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: secondment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the secondment arrangement. Proposed: under internal review; Approved: authorised but not yet started; Active: timekeeper currently on placement; Extended: original end date extended; Completed: placement concluded as planned; Cancelled: arrangement cancelled before start; Terminated Early: placement ended before scheduled end date. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: proposed|approved|active|extended|completed|cancelled|terminated_early — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: secondment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the secondment arrangement indicating the nature of the placement. Client secondment places the timekeeper at a client organisation; inter-office moves the timekeeper between firm offices; international rotation supports cross-border staffing; pro bono places the timekeeper with a non-profit or legal aid organisation; government secondment places the timekeeper with a regulatory or government body; judicial clerkship places the timekeeper with a court or tribunal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: client_secondment|inter_office|international_rotation|pro_bono|government_secondment|judicial_clerkship — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Law Society of England and Wales; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this secondment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse architecture.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Elite 3E Practice Management; ISO 27001

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the timekeeper formally commences the secondment placement at the host organisation. Used for resource planning, billing commencement, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which the secondment record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change tracking, data synchronisation, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5(2) (accountability); SAP SuccessFactors HRM

attributes.name: work_permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the work permit, visa, or immigration authorisation for the secondment expires. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous legal right to work compliance.
attributes.references: International Bar Association (IBA); SAP SuccessFactors HRM

attributes.name: work_permit_reference
attributes.description: Government-issued reference number for the work permit, visa, or immigration authorisation obtained for the secondee to work in the host jurisdiction. Classified as restricted PII as it is a government-issued personal identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; International Bar Association (IBA); FATF AML Compliance

attributes.name: work_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the secondee requires a work permit, visa, or immigration authorisation to perform the secondment in the host country. Relevant for international rotation and cross-border placements.
attributes.references: International Bar Association (IBA); SAP SuccessFactors HRM; GDPR Article 44

attributes.name: secondment_supervising_partner_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equity or non-equity partner responsible for overseeing the secondment arrangement, managing performance expectations, and maintaining the client relationship during the placement.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: secondment_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or staff member) who is placed on secondment. Links to the workforce.timekeeper master record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HRM; Elite 3E Practice Management

attributes.name: secondment_approved_by_employee_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the firm employee (typically a practice group leader, managing partner, or HR director) who formally approved the secondment arrangement in SAP SuccessFactors.

products.name: disciplinary_record
products.description: Confidential record of internal disciplinary actions and professional conduct matters involving firm timekeepers. Stores incident date, incident type (conduct, performance, ethics, regulatory), description, investigation status, outcome (warning, suspension, termination, no action), bar referral flag, regulatory notification flag, and resolution date. Distinct from bar admission disciplinary standing which is externally held. Access is restricted to HR and firm management. Supports SRA and ABA professional conduct obligations.
products.reference: SRA Code of Conduct / ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: disciplinary_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each disciplinary record within the firm. Primary key for the disciplinary_record data product in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: matter_id

attributes.name: primary_disciplinary_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper (attorney, paralegal, or staff member) who is the subject of this disciplinary record. Links to the workforce.timekeeper product.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: tertiary_disciplinary_hr_case_owner_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR business partner or case manager who owns and administers this disciplinary record within the HR function. Distinct from the investigating officer. Links to the workforce.timekeeper product.

attributes.name: to_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.timekeeper.timekeeper_id — Each disciplinary record pertains to a specific timekeeper. Required for HR case management and regulatory notification obligations.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the formal appeal process if an appeal was filed. Upheld indicates original outcome overturned; partially_upheld indicates outcome modified; dismissed indicates original outcome confirmed; pending indicates appeal in progress. Null if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal was formally resolved and the final outcome confirmed. Null if no appeal was filed or appeal is still pending.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: bar_referral_body
attributes.description: Name of the bar association, regulatory authority, or professional body to which the matter was referred (e.g., State Bar of California, SRA, Law Society of England and Wales). Supports multi-jurisdiction tracking.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 8.3; SRA Standards and Regulations; State Bar Associations; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: bar_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the matter was formally referred to the bar association or regulatory body. Null if is_bar_referral is false or referral has not yet been made.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 8.3; SRA Standards and Regulations; State Bar Associations

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data access classification for this disciplinary record, controlling which firm personnel may view the record. Restricted limits access to HR leadership and managing partners; confidential limits to HR and direct line management; internal is accessible to broader HR team.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Annex A; GDPR Article 5; SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this disciplinary record was first created in the system of record (SAP SuccessFactors). Provides the audit trail creation point for compliance and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: incident_category
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification of the incident within its type, such as billing irregularity, client confidentiality breach, conflict of interest, sexual harassment, substance abuse, or absenteeism. Supports detailed analytics and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_irregularity|confidentiality_breach|conflict_of_interest|harassment|substance_abuse|absenteeism|misrepresentation|data_breach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations; GDPR Article 5; ISO 27001

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The date on which the alleged conduct, performance failure, ethics breach, or regulatory violation occurred or was first identified. This is the principal real-world event date for the disciplinary matter.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 8.3; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the alleged incident, including facts, circumstances, and any relevant context. This field is subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) and is restricted to HR and firm management access.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations; LPP (Legal Professional Privilege)

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the disciplinary incident. Conduct covers behavioural matters; performance covers work quality/output failures; ethics covers breaches of professional duty; regulatory covers violations of bar or regulatory rules; financial covers billing fraud or misappropriation; harassment covers workplace harassment or discrimination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: conduct|performance|ethics|regulatory|financial|harassment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations; FATF AML Guidance; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: investigation_close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal investigation was formally concluded and findings were documented. Null if investigation is still open.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal internal investigation into the disciplinary matter was commenced. Used to track investigation duration and compliance with firm HR policy timelines.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the disciplinary investigation. Pending indicates not yet commenced; open indicates active investigation; under_review indicates findings being assessed; concluded indicates investigation complete pending outcome; closed indicates fully resolved; appealed indicates outcome under appeal.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: is_appeal_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject timekeeper has filed a formal appeal against the disciplinary outcome. True triggers appeal tracking workflow and suspends record finalisation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: is_bar_referral
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disciplinary matter has been or is required to be referred to the relevant state bar association, Law Society, or SRA for professional conduct review. True triggers mandatory regulatory notification workflow.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 8.3; SRA Standards and Regulations; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: is_lpp_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation documents and record contents are subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP), restricting disclosure in litigation or regulatory proceedings. Governs eDiscovery and document production obligations.
attributes.references: LPP (Legal Professional Privilege); ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: is_paid_suspension
attributes.description: Indicates whether a suspension was on full pay (true) or unpaid (false). Relevant for payroll processing and employment law compliance during the suspension period. Null if outcome is not suspension.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; Employment Law (jurisdiction-specific)

attributes.name: is_pii_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident involved a breach or mishandling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or client data, triggering GDPR, CCPA, or DPA notification obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); DPA (Data Protection Act); ISO 27001

attributes.name: is_regulatory_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory notification obligation has been triggered by this disciplinary matter (e.g., GDPR data breach notification to DPA, AML/KYC notification to FATF-aligned authority, or SRA mandatory reporting). Distinct from bar referral.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 33; FATF Recommendations; SRA Standards and Regulations; DPA (Data Protection Act); ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction governing the employment relationship and disciplinary process for this record (e.g., England and Wales, New York, California). Determines applicable employment law, bar reporting obligations, and data retention requirements.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The formal outcome or sanction determined following the investigation. No_action indicates allegations unsubstantiated; verbal_warning/written_warning/final_warning are progressive disciplinary steps; suspension indicates temporary removal from duties; termination indicates employment ended; referral indicates matter referred to bar or regulatory body. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_action|verbal_warning|written_warning|final_warning|suspension|termination|referral|demotion — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: outcome_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disciplinary outcome was formally communicated to the subject timekeeper. Marks the resolution of the disciplinary process for reporting and retention purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: record_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this disciplinary record, used in HR correspondence, investigation files, and regulatory notifications. Format: DR-YYYY-NNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: record_retention_expiry
attributes.description: The date after which this disciplinary record may be purged or anonymised in accordance with the firm's data retention policy and applicable employment law. attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e); DPA (Data Protection Act); SRA Standards and Regulations; ISO 27001

attributes.name: regulatory_body_notified
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority notified (e.g., Information Commissioner's Office, Financial Action Task Force, SRA, relevant DPA). Supports audit trail for multi-regulatory compliance obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 33; FATF Recommendations; SRA Standards and Regulations; ISO 27001

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required regulatory notification was submitted to the relevant authority. Null if is_regulatory_notification is false or notification has not yet been made.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 33; FATF Recommendations; SRA Standards and Regulations; DPA (Data Protection Act)

attributes.name: related_record_reference
attributes.description: Reference to a prior or related disciplinary record for the same timekeeper, enabling tracking of repeat conduct patterns and progressive discipline history. Null if this is a standalone first incident.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required remediation actions were confirmed as completed. Null if remediation is not required or not yet completed.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: remediation_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific remediation actions required as part of the disciplinary outcome, such as mandatory ethics CLE hours, supervised practice period, or performance improvement plan milestones.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; CLE (Continuing Legal Education); CPD (Continuing Professional Development)

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which all required remediation actions must be completed. Used to track compliance with disciplinary outcome conditions and trigger escalation if overdue.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: remediation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disciplinary outcome includes a mandatory remediation action such as additional Continuing Professional Development (CPD/CLE), ethics training, supervision, or a performance improvement plan.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations; CPD (Continuing Professional Development)

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the incident was formally reported to HR or firm management, which may differ from the incident date. Used to track reporting timeliness obligations under SRA and ABA rules.
attributes.references: SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 8.3

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all aspects of the disciplinary matter were fully resolved, including any appeal period expiry, remediation completion, or regulatory notification confirmation. May differ from outcome_date if appeals or remediation actions follow.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessed severity of the disciplinary incident, used to prioritise investigation resources and determine escalation paths. Critical severity incidents trigger immediate bar referral assessment and senior management notification.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Standards and Regulations; ISO 27001 Annex A

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which a suspension sanction ended and the timekeeper was reinstated to duties. Null if outcome is not suspension or suspension is ongoing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations

attributes.name: suspension_start_date

attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Relations; SRA Standards and Regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this disciplinary record was most recently modified in the system of record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.

attributes.name: witness_count

products.name: rfp_team_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of individual timekeepers (attorneys, paralegals, and staff) to RFP pitch teams. It captures the specific role each timekeeper plays in the RFP response effort, their time contribution, section ownership, and the billing rate quoted for their participation. Each record links one timekeeper to one RFP submission with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific pitch team assignment, enabling cost recovery analysis, win/loss performance tracking, and pitch team composition optimization.. Existence Justification: In legal services, RFP responses require multi-attorney pitch teams where each timekeeper contributes specific expertise, hours, and section ownership. A single timekeeper participates in multiple concurrent RFP opportunities throughout the year, and each RFP submission requires multiple timekeepers with distinct roles (lead partner, subject matter expert, pricing analyst, etc.). The firm actively manages these assignments for cost recovery, capacity planning, and win/loss analysis by team composition.

attributes.name: rfp_team_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this RFP team assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: rfp_submission_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rfp Team Assignment - Rfp Submission Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the RFP submission for which this team assignment was made

attributes.name: timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the timekeeper assigned to this RFP pitch team

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this timekeeper was assigned to the RFP pitch team. Used to track team assembly timeline and response preparation duration.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: The current status of this team assignment. Tracks whether the timekeeper accepted the assignment, is actively working, completed their contribution, or withdrew due to conflicts or capacity constraints.

attributes.name: bio_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeepers professional biography was included in the RFP response materials. Used to track which team members were presented to the client.

attributes.name: conflict_cleared_date
attributes.description: The date on which this timekeeper received conflict clearance for this RFP submission.

attributes.name: conflict_cleared_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific timekeeper has been cleared through the conflict check process for this RFP. Required before timekeeper can be included in client-facing proposal materials.

attributes.name: contribution_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours this timekeeper contributed to the RFP response preparation. Used for cost recovery analysis, capacity planning, and pitch team efficiency metrics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was created.

attributes.name: pitch_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the pitch team members assigned to work on the RFP response, including partners, associates, and business development staff. [Moved from rfp_submission: This attribute currently stores a comma-separated list or description of pitch team members in the rfp_submission product. This is a denormalized representation of the many-to-many relationship. The individual team member assignments should be modeled as separate records in the rfp_team_assignment association, each with its own role, hours, and rate attributes. The pitch_team_members attribute becomes redundant once the association product exists and should be removed to eliminate data duplication and maintain referential integrity.]

attributes.name: presentation_section_responsibility
attributes.description: The specific section(s) of the RFP response or pitch presentation for which this timekeeper has primary authorship or delivery responsibility (e.g., 'Executive Summary', 'Technical Approach', 'Pricing Schedule', 'Team Qualifications').

attributes.name: rate_quoted
attributes.description: The hourly billing rate quoted for this specific timekeeper in this specific RFP response. May differ from their standard rack rate due to client negotiations, competitive positioning, or blended rate strategies. Critical for pricing analysis and margin calculation.

attributes.name: rate_quoted_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the quoted rate. Required for multi-jurisdiction RFPs and cross-border engagements.

attributes.name: team_role
attributes.description: The specific role this timekeeper plays in the RFP response effort. Drives responsibility assignment, effort allocation, and performance attribution in win/loss analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was last modified.

attributes.name: cycle_open_date

attributes.name: cycle_type

attributes.name: feedback_delivery_end_date

attributes.name: includes_360_feedback

attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: manager_review_due_date

attributes.name: mandatory_participation

attributes.name: origination_credit_weight

attributes.name: peer_review_count

attributes.name: promotion_eligible
