attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_register. Business justification: Reputational risks should be tracked in the enterprise risk register. Valid business relationship for reputational risk aggregation.

attributes.name: board_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the firm's board of directors or management committee was formally notified about the reputational risk flag.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reputational risk flag was formally closed, either because the risk was mitigated, the engagement was declined, or the matter concluded.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the reputational risk flag was closed, such as risk no longer applicable, engagement declined, matter completed, or false positive determination.

attributes.name: conditions_imposed
attributes.description: Specific conditions or controls imposed if the engagement was accepted despite the reputational risk, such as enhanced due diligence, ethical walls, or senior partner oversight.

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: Name of the counterparty or third party that is the subject of the reputational risk flag.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reputational risk flag record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Final decision or action taken regarding the reputational risk flag: accepted with conditions (engagement proceeds with enhanced monitoring), declined (engagement rejected), monitored (ongoing surveillance), escalated to board for decision, or no action required (risk deemed immaterial).

attributes.name: external_counsel_engaged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external legal counsel was engaged to advise on the reputational risk flag and appropriate firm response.

attributes.name: flag_raised_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or system that raised the reputational risk flag.

attributes.name: flag_raised_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reputational risk flag was first raised and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: flag_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the reputational risk flag, used for tracking and communication.

attributes.name: flag_source
attributes.description: Origin of the reputational risk flag: internal research, third-party screening service, media monitoring tool, regulatory alert, client disclosure, conflict check system output, or manual review by risk team. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal_research|third_party_screening|media_monitoring|regulatory_alert|client_disclosure|conflict_check_system|manual_review — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: flag_source_detail
attributes.description: Additional detail about the source of the flag, such as the name of the screening vendor, media outlet, or regulatory body that issued the alert.

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential impact to the firm if the reputational risk materializes, including potential regulatory scrutiny, client loss, or media attention.

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: Industry sector or business activity associated with the reputational risk, such as arms trade, extractive industries, gambling, or tobacco.

attributes.name: insurance_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the firm notified its professional indemnity insurance carrier about the reputational risk flag.

attributes.name: insurance_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm's professional indemnity insurance carrier was notified about the reputational risk flag due to potential exposure.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the jurisdiction associated with the reputational risk flag, particularly relevant for high-risk jurisdiction flags.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified the reputational risk flag record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reputational risk flag record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: media_exposure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reputational risk flag has resulted in or has potential for adverse media coverage of the firm.

attributes.name: mitigation_actions
attributes.description: Specific actions taken or planned to mitigate the reputational risk, such as enhanced client due diligence, engagement letter modifications, or public relations strategy.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the reputational risk flag is monitored if the disposition is to monitor: continuous, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or as needed based on trigger events.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the reputational risk flag, applicable when ongoing monitoring is required.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body notified about the reputational risk flag, such as Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA), Law Society, or Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the firm notified the relevant regulatory body about the reputational risk flag, if notification was required.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reputational risk flag triggers a mandatory notification to a regulatory body such as the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) or Law Society.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the regulatory body for the notification or investigation related to this reputational risk flag.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reputational risk flag was formally reviewed by the risk committee or designated partner.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reputational risk flag review process: pending review, under review by risk committee, reviewed and decided, escalated to senior management, or closed.
attributes.references: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or committee that conducted the formal review of the reputational risk flag.

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the reputational risk concern, including specific allegations, media reports, or regulatory findings.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessed severity of the reputational risk: low, medium, high, or critical, based on potential impact to the firm's reputation and regulatory standing.

products.name: matter_risk_profile
products.description: Matter-level risk profile aggregating all risk dimensions for a specific legal matter including complexity rating, jurisdictional risk, client credit risk, legal professional privilege (LPP) sensitivity, eDiscovery/ESI volume exposure, regulatory scrutiny level, and overall matter risk tier (green/amber/red). Created at matter intake and updated at key lifecycle milestones (mid-matter review, pre-trial, closure). Provides the consolidated risk view consumed by matter management, billing, and partner review processes.

attributes.name: matter_risk_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the matter risk profile record. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE (risk profile as a managed resource).

attributes.name: appetite_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_appetite. Business justification: Matter risk profiles are evaluated against firm risk appetite thresholds. Valid business relationship for matter acceptance and risk governance.

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal matter to which this risk profile applies. Links this risk profile to the specific case or engagement being assessed.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the practice group responsible for this matter, enabling practice-level risk aggregation and benchmarking.

attributes.name: primary_matter_attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the partner with primary responsibility for matter oversight and risk management decisions.

attributes.name: primary_trust_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trust.trust_account. Business justification: High-risk matters require segregated trust accounting with enhanced controls. Matter risk tier determines trust account monitoring frequency, reconciliation requirements, and authorization thresholds

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the client associated with this matter. Enables client-level risk aggregation and portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: aml_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the matter presents elevated anti-money laundering risk requiring enhanced due diligence, source of funds verification, and suspicious activity monitoring.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - AML Standards

attributes.name: client_credit_risk_rating
attributes.description: Credit risk assessment of the client using standard rating scale, indicating likelihood of payment default and informing billing arrangements and retainer requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: client_payment_history_flag
attributes.description: Historical payment performance indicator for this client based on past matters, informing credit risk and billing strategy.

attributes.name: conflict_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of potential conflicts of interest based on client relationships, adverse parties, and matter subject matter, informing ethical wall requirements and engagement decisions.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct - Rule 1.7 Conflict of Interest

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the matter involves multiple jurisdictions, triggering additional conflict-of-laws analysis and regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: International Bar Association (IBA) Cross-Border Practice Standards

attributes.name: cybersecurity_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of cybersecurity and data breach risk for this matter based on data sensitivity, technology platforms used, third-party access, and threat landscape, informing ISO 27001 controls.

attributes.name: ediscovery_volume_exposure
attributes.description: Assessment of the volume and complexity of Electronically Stored Information (ESI) that may be subject to discovery, impacting matter cost, timeline, and technology-assisted review (TAR) requirements.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 26 - eDiscovery

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the matter was escalated to higher authority for review and approval, if escalation was required.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this matter risk profile requires escalation to senior management, risk committee, or board level due to risk tier or specific risk factors.

attributes.name: esi_volume_gb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronically Stored Information (ESI) Volume in Gigabytes (GB)
attributes.description: Estimated volume of ESI in gigabytes that may be subject to collection, review, and production in this matter, driving eDiscovery cost and resource planning.

attributes.name: estimated_matter_value
attributes.description: Estimated total value at stake in the matter (transaction value, claim amount, or potential liability), used to assess proportionality of risk and insurance coverage adequacy. Expressed in firm base currency.

attributes.name: insurance_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when professional indemnity insurer was notified of this matter, if notification was required.
attributes.references: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) - Professional Indemnity Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: insurance_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether professional indemnity insurer notification is required for this matter based on risk profile and policy terms.
attributes.references: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) - Professional Indemnity Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: jurisdictional_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk rating based on the legal jurisdictions involved, considering political stability, judicial predictability, enforcement mechanisms, and regulatory environment.
attributes.references: International Bar Association (IBA) Jurisdictional Risk Framework

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent risk profile review, typically conducted at matter milestones (mid-matter review, pre-trial, significant developments).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk profile record, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: lpp_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the sensitivity of privileged communications and work product in this matter, driving information security controls and ethical wall requirements.
attributes.references: Law Society of England and Wales - Legal Professional Privilege Guidance

attributes.name: matter_complexity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the legal and factual complexity of the matter considering number of parties, jurisdictions, legal issues, document volume, and expert requirements.

attributes.name: matter_profile_references_risks
attributes.description: FK to risk.risk_register.risk_register_id — Matter risk profiles aggregate risk dimensions that may reference specific risk register items for that matter.

attributes.name: matter_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated matter value (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: media_exposure_likelihood
attributes.description: Probability that the matter will attract media attention or public scrutiny, informing communications strategy and reputational risk management.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory risk profile review, driven by overall risk tier and matter lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional risk assessment notes, context, and qualitative factors not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: overall_risk_tier
attributes.description: Consolidated risk rating for the matter using traffic-light classification: green (low risk), amber (medium risk), red (high risk). Drives partner review frequency and approval thresholds.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct - Risk Management

attributes.name: pii_data_volume_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) Data Volume Category
attributes.description: Classification of the volume of PII involved in the matter, informing GDPR compliance requirements, data breach risk exposure, and data protection impact assessment needs.

attributes.name: primary_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary legal jurisdiction governing this matter (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: professional_indemnity_exposure
attributes.description: Assessment of potential professional liability and malpractice risk exposure for this matter, informing insurance notification requirements and risk mitigation protocols.
attributes.references: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) - Professional Indemnity Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: profile_created_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk profile was initially created, typically at matter intake or new business approval stage.

attributes.name: profile_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this risk profile record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: profile_reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique reference code for this matter risk profile, typically formatted as MRP-YYYYNNNN for external communication and audit trails.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk profile indicating whether it is in draft, actively monitored, under review by risk committee, escalated to senior management, closed upon matter completion, or archived.

attributes.name: regulatory_scrutiny_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the level of regulatory oversight and reporting requirements applicable to this matter, considering industry sector, transaction type, and jurisdictional requirements.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - Risk-Based Approach

attributes.name: reputational_risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of potential reputational harm to the firm from association with this matter, considering client profile, matter type, public visibility, and ethical considerations.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct - Rule 1.2 Scope of Representation

attributes.name: risk_mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Summary of key risk mitigation strategies and controls implemented for this matter, including enhanced supervision, ethical walls, insurance notifications, and client communications.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parties, jurisdictions, or transaction elements require screening against international sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU) to ensure compliance with economic sanctions regimes.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions Programs

attributes.name: special_category_data_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the matter involves GDPR Article 9 special category data (racial/ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, health data, biometric data, genetic data, sex life/orientation), requiring heightened data protection controls.

attributes.name: third_party_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the matter involves third-party service providers (expert witnesses, eDiscovery vendors, co-counsel, ALSPs) requiring vendor due diligence and data sharing agreements.
attributes.references: Law Society of England and Wales - Third Party Risk Management

attributes.name: to_register
attributes.description: FK to risk.risk_register.risk_register_id — Matter risk profiles aggregate risk dimensions that may correspond to registered risks. This enables drill-down from matter risk tier to specific risk items.

attributes.name: to_risk_register
attributes.description: FK to risk.risk_register.risk_register_id — Matter risk profiles aggregate risk items from the register that pertain to a specific matter. This link enables the roll-up view.

products.name: appetite
products.description: Reference record defining the firms risk appetite thresholds by risk category and organizational level (firm-wide, practice group, office). Captures maximum tolerable risk score, escalation trigger score, risk tolerance band (low/medium/high/critical), review frequency, approving governance body (Risk Committee, Managing Partner, Board), and effective date range. Used to evaluate whether assessed risks fall within or outside the firms stated risk appetite.

attributes.name: appetite_id
attributes.description: Primary key for appetite

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_category. Business justification: Risk appetite thresholds are defined per risk category. risk_appetite has risk_category (STRING) which should normalize to risk_category reference table.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the practice group if this threshold applies at practice group level (nullable for firm-wide thresholds).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk appetite threshold was formally approved by the governance body.

attributes.name: approving_governance_body
attributes.description: The governance body or role responsible for approving and maintaining this risk appetite threshold (e.g., Risk Committee, Managing Partner, Board, Executive Committee).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: automatic_escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether risks exceeding the escalation trigger score are automatically escalated to the governance body (true) or require manual review (false).

attributes.name: client_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether client notification is required when a risk exceeds this appetite threshold (relevant for data breach, conflict, or professional indemnity risks).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 34, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk appetite threshold record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial exposure limit (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this risk appetite threshold becomes active and applicable to risk assessments.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk appetite threshold expires or is superseded. Nullable for currently active thresholds.

attributes.name: escalation_trigger_score
attributes.description: Risk score threshold at which escalation to senior management or governance body is automatically triggered. Typically lower than maximum tolerable score.

attributes.name: financial_exposure_limit
attributes.description: Maximum financial exposure (in firm base currency) the firm is willing to accept for risks in this category before mandatory action is required.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether professional indemnity or other insurance coverage is required for risks in this category exceeding the threshold.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk appetite threshold was last reviewed by the governance body.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk appetite threshold record was last modified.

attributes.name: mandatory_mitigation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether risks exceeding this threshold require mandatory mitigation actions (true) or are subject to discretionary treatment (false).

attributes.name: maximum_tolerable_risk_score
attributes.description: The highest risk score the firm is willing to accept before mandatory mitigation or escalation is required. Represents the upper boundary of risk tolerance.

attributes.name: minimum_acceptable_risk_score
attributes.description: The lower boundary of the risk tolerance band. Risks scoring below this threshold are considered within normal operational tolerance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this risk appetite threshold by the governance body.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding this risk appetite threshold, including special conditions or exceptions.

attributes.name: organizational_level
attributes.description: Level of the organization to which this risk appetite threshold applies (firm-wide, practice group, office, or matter-specific).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: regulator_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether regulatory notification (e.g., to ICO, SRA, State Bar) is required when a risk exceeds this appetite threshold.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 33, SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or compliance framework that influences this risk appetite threshold (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, AML, SOX, SRA Code of Conduct).
attributes.references: GDPR, ISO 27001, FATF AML Standards, SOX, SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this risk appetite threshold must be reviewed and reaffirmed (monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually, or ad-hoc).

attributes.name: risk_score_scale
attributes.description: The scoring scale used for risk assessment (e.g., 1-5, 1-10, 1-25, 1-100). Provides context for interpreting threshold scores.

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory or classification within the primary risk category (e.g., GDPR breach, ISO 27001 incident, AML screening failure).

attributes.name: risk_tolerance_band
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the risk tolerance level (low, medium, high, critical) corresponding to the threshold score range.

attributes.name: threshold_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification and rationale for setting this specific risk appetite threshold, including strategic considerations and risk-return trade-offs.

attributes.name: threshold_reference_code
attributes.description: Business-readable unique reference code for the risk appetite threshold (e.g., RAT-FIRM-001, RAT-LITG-002).

attributes.name: threshold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk appetite threshold (draft, active, under review, superseded, expired).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this risk appetite threshold record, incremented with each revision or update.

attributes.name: appetite_attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the individual (partner or executive) who formally approved this risk appetite threshold.

attributes.name: appetite_reviewed_by_attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the individual (partner, risk officer, or executive) who last reviewed this risk appetite threshold.

attributes.name: last_updated_by_timekeeper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the user or system that last updated this risk appetite threshold record.

attributes.name: office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the office if this threshold applies at office level (nullable for firm-wide or practice group thresholds).

attributes.name: superseded_by_threshold_appetite_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the risk appetite threshold record that supersedes this one (nullable for current active thresholds).

products.name: mitigation_action
products.description: Transactional record of each risk mitigation or remediation action assigned to address an identified risk or control deficiency. Captures action description, action owner, assigned date, due date, priority, completion status, completion date, evidence of completion, and residual risk re-assessment trigger. Provides the action tracking layer that drives risk reduction workflows and management reporting.

attributes.name: mitigation_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk mitigation action record. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_category. Business justification: Mitigation actions target specific risk categories. Assuming action_category (STRING) aligns with risk taxonomy and should normalize to risk_category table.

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter associated with this mitigation action, if the risk is matter-specific. Null for enterprise-level risks.

attributes.name: practice_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the practice group responsible for or affected by this mitigation action (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, IP).

attributes.name: primary_mitigation_attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper or workforce member responsible for executing and completing the mitigation action.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client associated with this mitigation action, if the risk is client-specific. Null for enterprise-level risks.

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent risk in the risk register that this mitigation action addresses.

attributes.name: reviewer_attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the timekeeper or workforce member responsible for reviewing and verifying completion of the mitigation action.

attributes.name: risk_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_control. Business justification: Mitigation actions implement, test, or remediate specific controls. Business semantics: 'this action addresses this control.' Creates valid chain: risk_mitigation_action → risk_control → risk_register

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the mitigation or remediation action to be taken, including specific steps, controls, or interventions required.

attributes.name: action_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned as the action owner, denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the mitigation action based on risk severity and urgency: critical (immediate), high (urgent), medium (standard), or low (routine).

attributes.name: action_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference code for the mitigation action, used in reporting and tracking (e.g., RMA-00012345).

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mitigation action: assigned (not started), in_progress (underway), pending_review (awaiting approval), completed (finished), overdue (past due date), or cancelled (no longer required).

attributes.name: action_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the mitigation action for quick identification and reporting.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mitigation action by control type: preventive (avoid risk), detective (identify occurrence), corrective (fix issue), compensating (alternative control), directive (policy/procedure), or recovery (restore after event).

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual financial cost incurred to implement the mitigation action, captured for budget tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: actual_effort_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of hours spent completing the mitigation action, captured for performance tracking and future estimation.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the mitigation action was formally assigned to the action owner.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the mitigation action was completed and closed. Null if action is not yet completed.

attributes.name: completion_evidence
attributes.description: Description or reference to evidence demonstrating completion of the mitigation action (e.g., document reference, system log, attestation, audit report).

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Detailed completion state: not_started (no work done), partial (in progress), complete (finished but not verified), verified (reviewed and approved), or rejected (completion not accepted).

attributes.name: control_effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Post-implementation assessment of how effective the mitigation action was in reducing the risk: effective (fully mitigated), partially_effective (some reduction), ineffective (no impact), or not_tested (not yet evaluated).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this mitigation action record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for estimated and actual cost amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the mitigation action, used for tracking and escalation.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the mitigation action was escalated to senior management or the risk committee. Null if no escalation occurred.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the mitigation action was escalated (e.g., overdue, insufficient resources, control ineffective, regulatory deadline).

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this mitigation action requires escalation to senior management or the risk committee due to delays, resource constraints, or effectiveness concerns.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated financial cost to implement the mitigation action, including internal labor, external counsel, technology, or other resources.

attributes.name: estimated_effort_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of hours required to complete the mitigation action, used for resource planning and capacity management.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this mitigation action record was most recently modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lpp_applies
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Legal Professional Privilege applies to this mitigation action and its associated documentation, restricting disclosure.

attributes.name: pii_involved
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this mitigation action involves processing or handling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII), triggering additional data protection controls.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or governing authority to which this mitigation action must be reported (e.g., ICO, SRA, State Bar, FCA).
attributes.references: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA), Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Applicable regulatory or compliance framework that this mitigation action addresses (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, AML, SOX, SRA Code of Conduct). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GDPR|ISO_27001|AML|SOX|SRA_Code|CCPA|PCI_DSS|FATF|DPA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), ISO 27001, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX), Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether completion or failure of this mitigation action must be reported to a regulatory body or governing authority.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: residual_risk_reassessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the residual risk was reassessed following completion of this mitigation action. Null if reassessment not yet performed.

attributes.name: residual_risk_reassessment_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether completion of this action triggers a formal reassessment of the residual risk rating in the risk register.

attributes.name: review_comments
attributes.description: Comments or notes provided by the reviewer regarding the quality, completeness, or effectiveness of the mitigation action.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the completed mitigation action was formally reviewed and verified by the reviewer.

products.name: third_party_risk
products.description: Third-party and vendor risk record assessing the risk profile of external service providers, ALSPs, technology vendors, and outsourced functions that handle firm or client data. Captures vendor name, service category, data access level (PII, LPP, confidential), due diligence status, ISO 27001 certification status, contractual security obligations, last assessment date, risk tier (critical/high/medium/low), and ongoing monitoring status. Supports SRA outsourcing requirements and GDPR processor obligations.

attributes.name: third_party_risk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the third-party risk assessment record. Primary key for the third_party_risk product.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_category. Business justification: Third-party risks are classified by risk category. Business semantics support this relationship for vendor risk categorization.

attributes.name: escalation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_escalation. Business justification: High-risk third parties may trigger escalations for vendor approval or termination decisions. Valid business relationship for vendor risk governance.

attributes.name: primary_third_agreement_contract_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the master service agreement or contract governing the vendor relationship.

attributes.name: primary_third_attorney_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual responsible for managing and monitoring the vendor risk, typically a partner, general counsel, or risk manager.

products.name: escalation
products.description: Governance escalation and decision record capturing formal risk escalation events from operational teams to Risk Committee, Managing Partner, or Board. Each record documents the escalated risk or event reference, escalation trigger (threshold breach, novel risk type, regulatory inquiry), escalation date, escalating party, receiving governance body, decision outcome (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid, defer), conditions imposed, decision rationale, decision date, and follow-up action references. Provides the governance audit trail required by SRA, ISO 31000, and internal risk governance frameworks to demonstrate that material risks received appropriate senior oversight.

products.name: service_of_process
products.description: Tracks formal service of legal process on parties including complaints, summonses, subpoenas (ad testificandum and duces tecum), arbitration notices, and other compulsory instruments. Records service method (personal, substituted, publication, electronic, Hague Convention), service date, process server identity, party served, document type and reference, proof of service filing date, service validity status, objection status, compliance deadline, and ESI/eDiscovery implications flag. Supports litigation workflow, ensures compliance with jurisdictional service requirements, and links to document management for collection when subpoenas duces tecum are involved.

Captures ADR type, administering institution, seat of arbitration, governing rules version, number of arbitrators, arbitrator appointment dates, claimant and respondent references, claim amount, currency, commencement date, award date, and enforcement status. Distinct from court dockets — ADR proceedings follow separate procedural rules and timelines.

attributes.name: claim_currency

attributes.name: confidentiality_level

attributes.name: emergency_arbitrator_appointed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an emergency arbitrator was appointed under the institutional rules to grant urgent interim relief before the tribunal is constituted. True if emergency arbitrator appointed; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, SIAC Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: enforcement_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The country or jurisdiction in which enforcement of the award is being sought or has been obtained. May be multiple jurisdictions if enforcement is pursued in multiple countries. Null if no enforcement action has been initiated.
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (1958)

attributes.name: enforcement_status
attributes.description: The status of enforcement of the arbitral award. Not applicable: no award issued or settlement reached voluntarily. Pending: award issued, enforcement not yet initiated. In progress: enforcement proceedings underway. Enforced: award successfully enforced. Challenged: enforcement challenged by losing party. Set aside: award set aside by competent court. Refused: enforcement refused by court. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_applicable|pending|in_progress|enforced|challenged|set_aside|refused — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (1958), UNCITRAL Model Law

attributes.name: first_hearing_date
attributes.description: The date of the first substantive hearing or procedural conference in the ADR proceeding. Null if no hearing has been scheduled or held.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The substantive law governing the merits of the dispute (e.g., English law, New York law, Swiss law). Distinct from the procedural law, which is determined by the seat of arbitration.
attributes.references: International Bar Association (IBA) Guidelines, UNCITRAL Model Law

attributes.name: governing_rules
attributes.description: The procedural rules governing the ADR proceeding (e.g., ICC Arbitration Rules 2021, LCIA Arbitration Rules 2020, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules 2013, AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules). Includes version year where applicable.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules, AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: interim_measures_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tribunal or emergency arbitrator granted interim measures (provisional relief) during the proceeding, such as injunctions, asset freezes, or orders for security for costs. True if interim measures granted; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, UNCITRAL Model Law Article 17

attributes.name: lead_counsel_firm
attributes.description: The name of the law firm representing the client (claimant or respondent) as lead counsel in the ADR proceeding. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: number_of_arbitrators
attributes.description: The number of arbitrators constituting the tribunal. Typically 1 (sole arbitrator) or 3 (panel). Occasionally 5 or more for complex multi-party disputes. Null for non-arbitration ADR types.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: opposing_counsel_firm
attributes.description: The name of the law firm representing the opposing party in the ADR proceeding. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: place_of_hearing
attributes.description: The physical or virtual location where hearings are conducted. May differ from the seat of arbitration. Can include multiple locations or indicate 'Virtual' for remote hearings.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: proceeding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ADR proceeding. Initiated: proceeding has been commenced. Constituted: tribunal or mediator appointed. Ongoing: active proceedings. Suspended: temporarily paused. Settled: parties reached agreement. Award issued: final decision rendered. Terminated: proceeding ended without award. Enforcement pending: award issued, enforcement in progress. Enforced: award successfully enforced. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|constituted|ongoing|suspended|settled|award_issued|terminated|enforcement_pending|enforced — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ADR proceeding record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ADR proceeding record was last updated in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: respondent_party_name
attributes.description: The name of the respondent party (or parties) against whom the ADR proceeding is brought. May be a single entity or multiple co-respondents. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: seat_of_arbitration
attributes.description: The legal seat (juridical seat) of the arbitration, which determines the procedural law and supervisory court jurisdiction. Typically a city and country (e.g., London, United Kingdom; New York, USA; Singapore). Critical for enforcement under the New York Convention.
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (1958), UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the parties executed a settlement agreement, if applicable. Null if no settlement was reached.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: settlement_reached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parties reached a settlement during the ADR proceeding, resulting in termination of the proceeding by consent. True if settlement reached; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ADR proceeding was formally terminated, whether by award, settlement, withdrawal, or other means. Null if the proceeding is still ongoing.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for termination of the ADR proceeding. Award issued: tribunal rendered final award. Settlement: parties reached agreement. Withdrawal: claimant withdrew claim. Lack of prosecution: proceeding terminated due to inactivity. Jurisdictional objection sustained: tribunal declined jurisdiction. Other: other reasons.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: tribunal_constitution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the arbitral tribunal was fully constituted (all arbitrators appointed and confirmed). For mediation, the date the mediator was appointed. Null if not yet constituted.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: underlying_contract_type
attributes.description: The type of contract or agreement that is the subject of the dispute (e.g., Share Purchase Agreement (SPA), Joint Venture Agreement, Construction Contract, License Agreement, Distribution Agreement, Employment Agreement). Null if dispute does not arise from a contract.
attributes.references: International Bar Association (IBA), American Bar Association (ABA)

products.name: arbitral_award
products.description: Records final and interim awards issued in arbitration and ADR proceedings. Stores award type (final, partial, interim, consent), issue date, arbitral tribunal composition, awarded amount, currency, interest provisions, cost allocation, enforcement jurisdiction, New York Convention applicability flag, challenge status, and enforcement order reference. Supports post-award enforcement strategy and matter closure.

attributes.name: arbitral_award_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the arbitral award record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trust.trust_account. Business justification: Arbitral awards often require trust accounts for holding award payments pending enforcement, satisfaction, or appeal. Attorneys must track which trust account holds arbitral award proceeds for client

attributes.name: indemnity_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.indemnity_claim. Business justification: Arbitral awards in indemnity matters determine payout and closure; essential for claims management, insurer settlement, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: indemnity_exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.indemnity_exposure. Business justification: Adverse arbitral awards can trigger professional indemnity claims, particularly in international arbitration. Essential for reserve setting and insurer notification in arbitration practice.

attributes.name: legal_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.legal_document. Business justification: Arbitral awards are legal documents requiring secure storage, confidentiality controls, and retention management; link connects award records to document files for enforcement proceedings and New York

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter or case to which this arbitral award pertains.

attributes.name: precedent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to knowledge.precedent. Business justification: Significant arbitration awards, especially published ones, serve as precedents for future ADR proceedings. Captures institutional knowledge from alternative dispute resolution, enables arbitration str

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_profile. Business justification: Arbitral awards directly impact clients financially and operationally. Linking enables financial outcome tracking, enforcement planning, client reporting on award status, and portfolio analysis of arb

attributes.name: regulatory_breach_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_breach. Business justification: Arbitral awards in regulatory disputes determine financial exposure and compliance obligations; critical for breach incident closure and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: adr_mechanism
attributes.description: The specific ADR mechanism under which this award was issued.

attributes.name: arbitral_institution
attributes.description: The name of the arbitral institution administering the arbitration (e.g., ICC, LCIA, AAA, SIAC) or indication of ad hoc arbitration.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC), London Court of International Arbitration (LCIA)

attributes.name: award_reference_number
attributes.description: The official reference or case number assigned to this arbitral award by the arbitral institution or tribunal.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: award_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the arbitral award reflecting enforcement and challenge proceedings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issued|challenged|upheld|set_aside|enforced|partially_enforced|recognition_pending — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards

attributes.name: award_summary
attributes.description: A concise summary of the key findings, rulings, and relief granted in the arbitral award.

attributes.name: award_type
attributes.description: Classification of the arbitral award indicating its nature and finality within the arbitration proceeding.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration, ICC Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: awarded_amount
attributes.description: The principal monetary amount awarded to the prevailing party, excluding interest and costs.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: challenge_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a challenge or application to set aside the award has been filed by any party.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration Article 34

attributes.name: challenge_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which a challenge or set-aside application was filed against the award.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration Article 34

attributes.name: challenge_grounds
attributes.description: Description of the legal grounds cited for challenging or setting aside the arbitral award.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration Article 34

attributes.name: challenge_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome or current status of the challenge proceedings against the award.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration Article 34

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the arbitral award is subject to confidentiality obligations restricting disclosure.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: cost_allocation_basis
attributes.description: Description of the basis or rationale used by the tribunal for allocating costs between parties (e.g., costs follow the event, proportional allocation).
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: costs_awarded_to_claimant
attributes.description: The amount of arbitration costs and legal fees awarded to the claimant party.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: costs_awarded_to_respondent
attributes.description: The amount of arbitration costs and legal fees awarded to the respondent party.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this arbitral award record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the awarded amount.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the full arbitral award document stored in the document management system (DMS).

attributes.name: enforcement_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The jurisdiction or country where enforcement of the award is being sought or has been granted.
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards

attributes.name: enforcement_order_date
attributes.description: The date on which the enforcement or recognition order was issued by the competent court.
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards

attributes.name: enforcement_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or citation of the court order granting enforcement or recognition of the arbitral award.
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The substantive law applied by the tribunal to resolve the dispute.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method specified for calculating interest on the awarded amount.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: interest_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the award includes provisions for interest on the awarded amount.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate percentage awarded, if applicable.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: interest_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which interest begins to accrue on the awarded amount.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the arbitral tribunal issued and signed the award.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this arbitral award record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: matter_closure_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuance of this award triggers closure of the associated legal matter.

attributes.name: new_york_convention_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the award is subject to the New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, facilitating international enforcement.
attributes.references: New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (1958)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, observations, or strategic considerations related to the arbitral award and its enforcement.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the parties were formally notified of the arbitral award.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: presiding_arbitrator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the presiding arbitrator or sole arbitrator who issued the award.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: publication_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the award may be published in redacted or anonymized form for legal research or precedent purposes.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: seat_of_arbitration
attributes.description: The legal seat or place of arbitration which determines the procedural law governing the arbitration.
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: tribunal_composition
attributes.description: Description of the arbitral tribunal composition including number of arbitrators and their appointment method (e.g., sole arbitrator, three-member panel).
attributes.references: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration

attributes.name: arbitral_adr_proceeding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent arbitration proceeding under which this award was issued.
attributes.references: ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: arbitral_award_proceeding
attributes.description: FK to court.adr_proceeding.adr_proceeding_id — Arbitral awards are issued in the context of an ADR proceeding. Required for enforcement workflow and matter closure.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `legal_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_ar_balance`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Accounts receivable aging and collections performance metrics tracking outstanding balances, aging buckets, and collection effectiveness"
  source: "`legal_ecm`.`billing`.`ar_balance`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "collection_status"
      expr: collection_status
      comment: "Current collection status (current, overdue, in collections, legal action)"
    - name: "dispute_flag"
      expr: dispute_flag
      comment: "Whether the AR balance is under dispute"
    - name: "dispute_reason"
      expr: dispute_reason
      comment: "Reason for dispute if flagged"
    - name: "fee_arrangement_type"
      expr: fee_arrangement_type
      comment: "Fee arrangement type for the matter"
    - name: "billing_frequency"
      expr: billing_frequency
      comment: "Billing frequency for the client/matter"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency of the AR balance"
    - name: "credit_terms_days"
      expr: credit_terms_days
      comment: "Credit terms in days (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)"
    - name: "days_outstanding_bucket"
      expr: days_outstanding
      comment: "Days outstanding bucket for aging analysis"
    - name: "due_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', due_date)
      comment: "Month the balance was due"
    - name: "last_payment_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_payment_date)
      comment: "Month of last payment received"
    - name: "iolta_flag"
      expr: iolta_flag
      comment: "Whether balance is subject to IOLTA trust accounting rules"
  measures:
    - name: "total_ar_records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of AR balance records"
    - name: "total_current_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding AR balance across all records"
    - name: "total_original_invoice_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(original_invoice_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total original invoice amount before payments and adjustments"
    - name: "total_payments_applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_payments_applied AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total payments applied to AR balances"
    - name: "total_credits_applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_credits_applied AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total credits applied to AR balances"
    - name: "total_interest_accrued"
      expr: SUM(CAST(interest_accrued AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total interest accrued on overdue balances"
    - name: "total_last_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(last_payment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total of most recent payments received"
    - name: "total_bucket_0_30"
      expr: SUM(CAST(bucket_0_30_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total AR balance aged 0-30 days"
    - name: "total_bucket_31_60"
      expr: SUM(CAST(bucket_31_60_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total AR balance aged 31-60 days"
    - name: "total_bucket_61_90"
      expr: SUM(CAST(bucket_61_90_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total AR balance aged 61-90 days"
    - name: "total_bucket_over_90"
      expr: SUM(CAST(bucket_over_90_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total AR balance aged over 90 days"
    - name: "avg_current_balance"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average outstanding balance per AR record"
    - name: "collection_effectiveness_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(total_payments_applied AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(original_invoice_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of original invoice amount collected"
    - name: "aging_over_90_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(bucket_over_90_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of current AR balance aged over 90 days"
    - name: "disputed_balance_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dispute_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of AR balances under dispute"
    - name: "disputed_balance_amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dispute_flag = TRUE THEN CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total AR balance amount under dispute"
    - name: "distinct_clients_with_ar"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT organisation_id)
      comment: "Number of unique clients with outstanding AR"
    - name: "distinct_matters_with_ar"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_ar_matter_id)
      comment: "Number of unique matters with outstanding AR"
$$
metric_views.description: Accounts receivable aging and collections performance metrics tracking outstanding balances, aging buckets, and collection effectiveness

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `legal_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_collection_action`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Collections effectiveness and recovery metrics tracking collection activities, outcomes, and recovery rates"
  source: "`legal_ecm`.`billing`.`collection_action`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "action_type"
      expr: action_type
      comment: "Type of collection action (call, email, letter, legal, settlement)"
    - name: "action_status"
      expr: action_status
      comment: "Status of collection action (pending, completed, escalated)"
    - name: "outcome"
      expr: outcome
      comment: "Outcome of collection action (payment received, promise to pay, dispute, no response)"
    - name: "contact_method"
      expr: contact_method
      comment: "Method used to contact client (phone, email, letter, in-person)"
    - name: "escalation_flag"
      expr: escalation_flag
      comment: "Whether action was escalated"
    - name: "dispute_flag"
      expr: dispute_flag
      comment: "Whether client disputed the balance"
    - name: "payment_plan_flag"
      expr: payment_plan_flag
      comment: "Whether payment plan was established"
    - name: "write_off_approval_flag"
      expr: write_off_approval_flag
      comment: "Whether write-off was approved"
    - name: "action_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', action_date)
      comment: "Month collection action was taken"
    - name: "resolution_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', resolution_date)
      comment: "Month collection action was resolved"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency of amounts"
    - name: "next_action_type"
      expr: next_action_type
      comment: "Planned next collection action type"
  measures:
    - name: "total_collection_actions"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of collection actions taken"
    - name: "total_amount_recovered"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_recovered AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount recovered through collection actions"
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount written off after collection efforts"
    - name: "avg_amount_recovered"
      expr: AVG(CAST(amount_recovered AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average amount recovered per collection action"
    - name: "avg_days_to_resolution"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(resolution_date, action_date))
      comment: "Average days from action to resolution"
    - name: "recovery_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(amount_recovered AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(amount_recovered AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of targeted amount recovered vs written off"
    - name: "escalated_action_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of actions that were escalated"
    - name: "disputed_action_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dispute_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of actions resulting in dispute"
    - name: "payment_plan_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_plan_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of payment plans established"
    - name: "write_off_approved_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN write_off_approval_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of write-offs approved"
    - name: "resolved_action_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of collection actions resolved"
    - name: "distinct_clients_contacted"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT profile_id)
      comment: "Number of unique clients contacted for collections"
    - name: "distinct_matters_in_collections"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT matter_id)
      comment: "Number of unique matters in collections"
    - name: "distinct_invoices_in_collections"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id)
      comment: "Number of unique invoices in collections"
$$
metric_views.description: Collections effectiveness and recovery metrics tracking collection activities, outcomes, and recovery rates

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `legal_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_invoice`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core invoice performance metrics tracking revenue, collections, and billing efficiency across matters, clients, and practice areas"
  source: "`legal_ecm`.`billing`.`invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "invoice_status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current status of the invoice (draft, sent, paid, disputed, written off)"
    - name: "invoice_type"
      expr: invoice_type
      comment: "Type of invoice (standard, interim, final, supplemental)"
    - name: "fee_arrangement_type"
      expr: fee_arrangement_type
      comment: "Fee arrangement governing this invoice (hourly, fixed, contingency, blended)"
    - name: "invoice_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date)
      comment: "Month the invoice was issued"
    - name: "invoice_year"
      expr: YEAR(invoice_date)
      comment: "Year the invoice was issued"
    - name: "due_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', due_date)
      comment: "Month the invoice payment is due"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency in which the invoice is denominated"
    - name: "billing_office_code"
      expr: billing_office_code
      comment: "Office that issued the invoice"
    - name: "ebilling_submission_status"
      expr: ebilling_submission_status
      comment: "Status of electronic billing submission (accepted, rejected, pending)"
    - name: "is_electronic_billing"
      expr: is_electronic_billing
      comment: "Whether invoice was submitted via electronic billing portal"
    - name: "payment_terms"
      expr: payment_terms
      comment: "Payment terms for the invoice (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)"
  measures:
    - name: "total_invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of invoices"
    - name: "total_fees_billed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fees_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total professional fees billed across all invoices"
    - name: "total_disbursements_billed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(disbursements_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total disbursements and expenses billed"
    - name: "total_tax_billed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount billed"
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net invoice amount (fees + disbursements + tax - discounts)"
    - name: "total_amount_paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_paid AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount collected on invoices"
    - name: "total_outstanding_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding receivables across all invoices"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `legal_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_time_entry`

      expr: fee_arrangement_type

      comment: "Month the work was performed"
    - name: "work_year"
      expr: YEAR(work_date)

      comment: "Office where the work was performed"

    - name: "phase_code"
      expr: phase_code
      comment: "Matter phase code (UTBMS or custom)"
    - name: "utbms_task_code"
      expr: utbms_task_code
      comment: "UTBMS task code for the work performed"
    - name: "utbms_activity_code"
      expr: utbms_activity_code
      comment: "UTBMS activity code for the work performed"
    - name: "pro_bono_category"
      expr: pro_bono_category
      comment: "Pro bono category if applicable"
    - name: "entry_method"
      expr: entry_method
      comment: "Method used to enter time (manual, mobile, voice, AI)"
    - name: "billing_guideline_compliant"
      expr: billing_guideline_compliant
      comment: "Whether time entry complies with client billing guidelines"
    - name: "lpp_protected"
      expr: lpp_protected
      comment: "Whether time entry is protected by legal professional privilege"
  measures:
    - name: "total_time_entries"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of time entries"
    - name: "total_hours_worked"
      expr: SUM(CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total hours worked across all time entries"
    - name: "total_billable_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(billable_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total billable hours recorded"
    - name: "total_wip_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(wip_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total work-in-progress value at standard rates"
    - name: "total_write_down_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_down_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount written down from standard rates"
    - name: "avg_hours_per_entry"
      expr: AVG(CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average hours per time entry"
    - name: "avg_wip_per_hour"
      expr: AVG(CAST(wip_amount AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Average WIP value per hour worked"
    - name: "billable_utilization_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(billable_hours AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of worked hours that are billable"
    - name: "realization_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CAST(wip_amount AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(write_down_amount AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(wip_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of standard WIP value realized after write-downs"
    - name: "billable_entries_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_billable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of billable time entries"
    - name: "non_billable_entries_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_billable = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of non-billable time entries"
    - name: "no_charge_hours"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN no_charge = TRUE THEN CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total hours provided at no charge"
    - name: "guideline_compliant_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_guideline_compliant = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of time entries compliant with billing guidelines"
    - name: "guideline_violation_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_guideline_compliant = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of time entries violating billing guidelines"
    - name: "distinct_timekeepers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_timekeeper_id)
      comment: "Number of unique timekeepers recording time"
    - name: "distinct_matters_worked"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT matter_id)
      comment: "Number of unique matters with time recorded"
    - name: "distinct_clients_served"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT profile_id)
      comment: "Number of unique clients served"
$$
metric_views.description: Timekeeper productivity and billing realization metrics tracking hours worked, billable utilization, and fee realization rates

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `legal_ecm`.`_metrics`.`client_beneficial_owner`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Beneficial ownership transparency metrics tracking ultimate ownership, control structures, and regulatory compliance"
  source: "`legal_ecm`.`client`.`beneficial_owner`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "beneficial_owner_status"
      expr: beneficial_owner_status
      comment: "Current status of beneficial owner record"

      expr: nature_of_control
      comment: "Type of control exercised by beneficial owner"
    - name: "pep_status"
      expr: pep_status
      comment: "Politically Exposed Person status"
    - name: "sanctions_status"
      expr: sanctions_status
      comment: "Sanctions screening status"
    - name: "risk_rating"
      expr: risk_rating
      comment: "Risk rating classification"
    - name: "country_of_residence"
      expr: country_of_residence
      comment: "Country of residence"
    - name: "nationality"
      expr: nationality
      comment: "Nationality of beneficial owner"
    - name: "tax_residence_country"
      expr: tax_residence_country
      comment: "Country of tax residence"
    - name: "verification_method"
      expr: verification_method
      comment: "Method used to verify beneficial ownership"
    - name: "adverse_media_flag"
      expr: adverse_media_flag
      comment: "Whether adverse media was identified"
    - name: "sanctions_list_match"
      expr: sanctions_list_match
      comment: "Sanctions list match result"
    - name: "disclosure_year"
      expr: YEAR(disclosure_date)
      comment: "Year beneficial ownership was disclosed"
    - name: "review_timeliness"
      expr: CASE WHEN next_review_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'Overdue' WHEN next_review_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) THEN 'Due Soon' ELSE 'Current' END
      comment: "Review timeliness status"
    - name: "ownership_tier"
      expr: CASE WHEN ownership_percentage >= 50 THEN 'Majority' WHEN ownership_percentage >= 25 THEN 'Significant' WHEN ownership_percentage >= 10 THEN 'Material' ELSE 'Minor' END
      comment: "Ownership percentage tier classification"
  measures:
    - name: "total_beneficial_owners"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT beneficial_owner_id)
      comment: "Total number of beneficial owner records"
    - name: "pep_identified"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pep_status IN ('Confirmed', 'PEP') THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owners identified as Politically Exposed Persons"
    - name: "sanctions_hits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sanctions_status IN ('Match', 'Hit') THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owners with sanctions list matches"
    - name: "adverse_media_identified"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN adverse_media_flag = TRUE THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owners with adverse media findings"
    - name: "high_risk_beneficial_owners"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_rating IN ('High', 'Critical') THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owners classified as high risk"
    - name: "overdue_reviews"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN next_review_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owner records with overdue reviews"
    - name: "avg_ownership_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(ownership_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average ownership percentage across beneficial owners"
    - name: "majority_owners"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ownership_percentage >= 50 THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owners with majority control"
    - name: "verified_beneficial_owners"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN verification_date IS NOT NULL THEN beneficial_owner_id END)
      comment: "Number of beneficial owners with completed verification"
    - name: "pep_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pep_status IN ('Confirmed', 'PEP') THEN beneficial_owner_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT beneficial_owner_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of beneficial owners identified as PEPs"
$$
